At 4 he started practicing, and at 10 he achieved the 9th stage Dou Zhi Li. At 11 he broke the 10th stage Dou Zhi Li barrier and condensed his Dou Zhi Qi Zu successfully. He became the youngest Dou Zhe in the clan since the past 100 years.

He was reborn into the Xiao Family.

On his finger was a black ring of simple design. The material used to make it was unknown. On it were some markings as well. This was the only present his late mother gave to him before she passed. He started wearing it since the age of 4 and even, 10 years later, he was still wearing. It was a precious gift from his mother and Xiao Yan treasured it dearly.

Though his Dou Zhi Qi was only 3rd stage, his spiritual awareness was akin to that of a 5 star Dou Zhe, perhaps even better.

He fed young Amethyst Winged Lion with laxatives.

Xiao Yan felt heartache by spilling Amethyst Essence so he licked it from the floor.

While he was in Tager Desert he trained by burying head into the hot sand just like an ostrich.

On the night after Xiao Yan had arrived in Rock Desert City, Xiao Yan, who had never touched liquor made an exception and went happily to a liquor stall with Xiao Ding and Xiao Li.

Back then, his persistence on training during the three years in which he had been regarded as a useless person had caused Xiao Yan to stabilize his training foundation until it was extremely firm. Only with this starting point, which was as stable as a rock, could Xiao Yan have the opportunity to continue advancing, building a towering strength which could cause others to be shocked.

His brothers are very protective of him and left the clan to protect him.

When he was 3 he broke a precious vase.

When he was 4 he was peeking at the love letter that Xiao Li was writing to Xiao Lei.

When he was 5 he rubbed chili powder on to Xiao Ding underpants.

Yan Xiao which was his fake name is just his real name flipped backward.

His spirit is quite strong due to the fact that he was reincarnated and with a strong spirit this meant that he can absorb Dou Qi quick fast and in vast amount. This is the cause for his growth.

Xiao Yan always liked to refine medicinal pills in his best condition. Being in his best condition allowed his Spiritual Perception and his degree of flame control to be in their peak states. If he refined medicinal pills at such a moment, it was undoubted that his success rate would reach its highest level.

The Xiao Yan who was holding the Heavy Xuan Ruler was not frightening. The unarmed and barehanded Xiao Yan was a true fighting machine.

He likes to pinch Xiao Xun cheeks.

His name Yan means a fire which represents the phoenix that will rise from the ashes which means he will never give up.

In the light novel he has a habit of brushing his nose.

In the light novel he entered rank 8 and 9 pre Dou Zhe when he was asleep.

Even though officially he is a 2nd Rank Alchemist, he has the ability to create high level pills.

Xiao Yan was reincarnated from Earth

His first official wife was Medusa but he threw a big wedding for both Medusa (Cai Lin) and Xiao Xun.

Regardless of how great one’s talent was, there was a limit to one’s ability. It was impossible for someone to split one’s attention to do other things while focusing on training. While his strength had reached such a stage, his alchemist skill had also reached a level that an ordinary person had difficulty achieving. This was an unbelievable thing from many people’s point of view. The reason was that just any single one of the two would exhaust an incredible amount of effort from a person. If one were able to truly rely on oneself to reach such a stage in both areas, it was likely that the person could only be described by the word ‘monster.’

If one were to talk about it, Xiao Yan could be also considered to possess a body that contained two elemental affinities, fire and wood. Of course, the fire affinity formed the majority of his constitution while wood was only present in a small amount. This was the case for every single alchemist since this was the requirement. A two elemental affinity constitution was not very suitable for training because the elements were not pure. It was still alright for a constitution like that of Xiao Yan. The wood affinity only occupied a small part of his body.

Xiao Yan’s bloodline strength is the merger of the Xiao clan’s bloodline, the Gu clan’s bloodline, and the Dragon Phoenix’s bloodline.

He was considered the most dangerous when he didn't use a weapon.

Pretty much any group, clan or person who had grudges with him are no longer alive.

Through out the Novel he only ever described as wearing Black clothing.

Xiao Yan is a soft-spoken person and he doesn't like noisy places much.

He doesn't like being the center of attention .

He is very gentle and kind to his friends and family.

Him and Cai Lin lost their virginity to each other.

characters.history:
He was abandoned by the Yao clan because he has very thin amount of Dou Di blood within him so he set out to prove the clan wrong and became an alchemist known throughout the central plains.

He founded Falling Star Pavilion along with Feng Xian before going out to adventure.

Yao Chen is betrayed by his first disciple, Han Feng

Yao Chen was murdered by his first disciple Han Feng, who was assisted by the Hall of Souls who wanted to obtain Yao Chen's soul. Back then, not long after his physical body was destroyed, he was surrounded and attacked by them. Although he did finally successfully kill his way out, he was also seriously wounded because of it. It was fortunate, however, that he had luckily obtained an extremely rare ‘Warm Soul Spirit Ring’ when he was helping other people refine medicinal pills back then. In the end, he got someone to help him create the black-colored ring on Xiao Yan's finger. It was because of this that he managed to escape being killed by them. Finally, the ring went in circles and landed in Xiao Yan mother’s hands before finally being passed on to Xiao Yan.
characters.trivia:
He felt the presence of an Fallen Heart Flame within Jia Nan Academy in the past but he could not confirm the location.

He spent 8 years waiting for the Bone Chilling Flame.

It has been hinted that Yao Chen knows who Lu Man is.

He does not have any wives or children.

He dotes on Xiao Xiao a lot and wants to train her as an alchemist.

The first reason given why he wants to quickly revive is actually he does not like to live like this, each day feels fake and empty illusion to him. He still has things that he must personally accomplish, therefore he wishes to leave his spirit state.

The second reason given is he is afraid of the Hall of Souls and has some matters and grudges that he must investigate fully and settle

'Yao Lao' means 'Medicine Old'.

Xiao Yan leaves some Origin Qi with him to advance to Dou Di and follow Xiao Yan in the future. Once he advances it will restore the Yao Clan.

He won first place in a competition held by Pill Tower. He would have been accepted to the inner circle of Pill Tower but declined.

In the past, Yao Chen traveled the world with his friends

Leaving one's name on Yao Clan's Clan Tablet is the lifelong goal of all Yao Clan members. Yao Chen's father and mother spent their lives striving for this. Unfortunately, in the end they could not realize their wish. Leaving the names of his parents on the Clan Tablet became Yao Chen's obsession.

After seeing the level of difficulty the pill Xiao Yan refined was, he was shocked to see the pill had Pill Lines which showed the pill was of high purity.

He  takes him to attend the Initial test for the Grand Alchemy Meeting. When Xiao Yan takes time to come out during the refining of the Black Iron Spiritual Leaf and is relieved when he makes it during the final moments.

He was stunned on seeing Xiao Yan achieve the best result in the refining exam and wonders why Xiao Yan hides his true ability deeply. He agrees to hide information about Xiao Yan's identity.

Afterwards, he meets Frank,Xu Mei and Lin Fei outside the Alchemist Guild. When Xiao Yan says he barely passed the exam, he is stupified thinking if he barely passed, then it would make the others fail. He then announces the result of the exam, greatly shocking the group.

During the day of the Grand Alchemist Meeting,he asks Xiao Yan to perform well and is introduced to Hai Bo Dong. When Hai Bo Dong greets them not too courteously, he stops Lin Fei who was about to chide Hai Bo Dong.

When Hai Bo Dong starts interacting with Fa Ma in a friendly manner, Ao Tuo ponders whether the latter is the Ice Emperor and wonders why Xiao Yan is able to befriend people of such level.

characters.title: Bei Ju
characters.introText: Bei Ju is one of the top 50 students on Strong Ranking of Jia Nan Academy. As the dark horse whose recent limelight had even exceeded that of Xiao Yan’s, he charged into the 33rd position in the ‘Strong Ranking’ from outside of it. Moreover, this fellow appeared to have let out some arrogant words saying that if he was given five days, he would definitely also triumph over Xiao Yan. This caused quite a number of people to admire his pride. However, Xiao Yan did not give a reply to this. The latter was busy with his retreat, and did not have the time to be bothered by some fellows who had just become successful.
characters.personality: Haughty and arrogant.
characters.history:
He draw Zi Yan innfirst round of Strong Ranking Grand Competition. If something must be blamed, he could only blame his poor luck in meeting Zi Yan, who even Liu Qing, Lin Xiuya, and the others avoided at any cost.

With Zi Yan’s strength which was comparable to a Dou Wang, even a mere single strike possessed a strength that could not be underestimated. Hence, even though Bei Ju’s body had Dou Qi Armor protecting him, that tough looking Dou Qi Armor was basically completely smashed apart at a withering pace the moment the two came into contact. Moreover, his armor completely cracked apart in an extremely short time that ferocious force mercilessly penetrated the Dou Qi Armor and collided at a spot between Bei Ju’s legs. Therefore a sharp scream that tore his lungs sounded in the stadium.

As they watched Bei Ju, who was hugging his lower body while his entire body was curled up on the ground like a large prawn, everyone wiped off the cold sweat on their face while looking stunned. Some of the male students held their lower body unconsciously as a reflex. Their bodies became cold. If they were to be struck in this manner it was likely that even if that thing was healed, one would form a phobia in their hearts.
characters.trivia:
Bei Ju (贝崌) is a wordplay on the word bei ju (悲剧) meaning tragedy.

Zi Yan viciously attacked him because he was badmouthing Xiao Yan.

characters.title: Cao Ying
characters.introText: Her entire life has been filled with a legendary hue. When she was born, she already displayed a Spiritual Strength that shocked others. Her mother was nearly killed by the Spiritual Strength that spread from her. When she was seven years old, she had formally become an alchemist. At fifteen, she caught the eye of the Pill Tower and an exception was made to take her in as core disciple of the Pill Tower. She has trained quietly in the Pill Tower for five years. At twenty, she became the youngest tier 7 alchemist in the Cao clan.
characters.appearance:
This lady had a tall and lovely figure. She was wearing a black-colored dress that emitted traces of her cold and haughty demeanor. Her skin was like snow. Her long hair scattered randomly over her shoulders. Her face was thin, but was exceptionally exquisite, appearing just like a porcelain statue, she had a sleek, red, small mouth.

In the Manhua, Cao Ying has long red hair that are being tied into a high ponytail, with loose strands framing her face. She wears a gold, flame-shaped headpiece centered on her forehead and matching gold hair ornaments extending backward. Her eyes are red, and her facial features are sharp with a narrow jawline and light skin tone. She wears long drop earrings with blue accents.

Her outfit consists of a sleeveless white fitted top with blue teardrop patterns on the chest, layered under a red and gold open outer garment with wide sleeves. The sleeves and skirt feature gold trim and cloud-like patterns. A short pleated red skirt with decorative motifs extends to mid-thigh. She wears multiple bracelets in green, blue, and gold on both wrists. Flowing red ribbons or fabric strands extend from her outfit and hair, trailing around her body.
characters.personality: Cao Ying’s outer appearance might be smiling, but her heart was quite cold. Her smile contained a kind of dangerous feeling similar to that of being targeted by a poisonous snake.  She possessed a haughty character that desired to win. Her greatest desire was not to be invisible, but she truly wanted to meet some people who possessed the qualification to be her opponent.

Within the ‘Blazing Sky Qi Refining Tower,’ and even the entire Inner Academy, the position of an Elder was extremely high. In this place, no student would dare to go against what an Elder said. Of course, this was with the exception of some outstanding people. This was because it was very possible for these outstanding people to take on the position of Elder, and become the same level as them. Within the Inner Academy, even the Elders also had to rope in strong people into their camps in consideration of their future.

After all, the Elders in the Inner Academy were not completely of the same faction. In any place, fighting was unavoidable. Perhaps it was because of power, perhaps it was because of profits or perhaps it was because of other things.

characters.introText: Fa Ma is one of the male tritagonists in "Battle Through the Heavens." He is a Tier 6 Alchemist who taught Pill King Gu He and is the chairman of the Jia Ma Empire Alchemist Association.
characters.appearance: There sat an old man wearing a purple colored alchemist robe. He had a dried tree bark like face of the an old man that appeared to be dying. His gaze was somewhat strange.
characters.personality: He is usually found asleep and rarely anything wakes him up.
characters.history:
He was the head of the Jia Ma Empire Alchemist Association.

Back then, when Fa Ma was still young, he had coincidentally met an old man, whose ability was unfathomable, while he was roaming the continent. Due to some reason, the old man and Fa Ma lived together for three days. During those three days, the old man casually imparted some things to him. However, Fa Ma benefited greatly from those things. By borrowing what the old man had taught, the originally unknown Fa Ma returned to the Jia Ma Empire and advanced step by step until this stage today. It was also because he had reached this step that Fa Ma increasingly realized just how terrifying the ability of that mysterious old man back then was.

That old man was Yao Lao.
characters.trivia: When Xiao Yan returned to the Yan alliance he knew that Xiao Yan was going to kill members of the Pill Hall who had committed crimes against the hall and thought it was funny.

characters.appearance:
This lady was wearing a colorful dress, and seemed to emit the aura of a distinguished person at a distant glance. Her face was a little thin and oval in shape. This, along with her purplish-brown gem-like eyes, caused this Miss Feng to appear like the princess of an empire, looking both beautiful and holy. She did not fit well into the scene that was filled with people.

characters.introText: Gu He started out as neutral,  became a minor antagonist and then a supporting male character during both Misty Cloud Sect arc's and the Yan Alliance arc in "Battle Through the Heavens." He is a renowned alchemist in the North-Western Region that is known as the "Pill King".  He was affiliated with the Misty Cloud Sect till it was disbanded and now is the deputy hall chief of the Pill Hall within the Yan Alliance.
characters.appearance: A handsome middle aged man.
characters.personality: Like most Alchemist's he is haughty and arrogant. He found no fault with Yun Shan attacking the Xiao Clan, but fault with Xiao Yan when he came to the Misty Cloud Sect for his Blood Revenge.  He changed somewhat after Xiao Yan didn't kill him during their duel.
characters.history: He was the largest black horse in the Alchemist Grand Meeting two sessions ago. Before that time, not many people knew Gu He’s name. Ever since he revealed his brilliance in the Grand Meeting, he caught the eye of the previous leader of the Misty Cloud Sect. After which, he was invited to become an elder of the Misty Cloud Sect. Back then, Gu He was merely a tier four alchemist. However, during these few years, with the huge wealth of the Misty Cloud Sect behind him, his refining ability has risen by two tiers. In addition, his reputation also changed from not being very well known, into the current Pill-King that everyone respects.
characters.trivia:
He is carrying unrequited feelings towards Yun Yun.

He is the known as sixth ranked Elixir Master. Rumor says even Dou Wang experts are lined up for his elixirs.

In the past there was a family in the Jia Ma Empire that insulted Gu He and he sent four Dou Wang to annihilate the family. They insulted Gu He by targeting his recipes, which is a Receptarier blood and sweat.

Yun Shan planned to recruit Gu He by agreeing to marry him and Yun Yun.

Pill King Gu He, was an extremely influential alchemist within the Jia Ma Empire.

Not only does Gu He have extraordinary talent in alchemy, his own strength is at the level of a Dou Wang and he’s one of the top ten Dou Zhe's in the Jia Ma Empire.

Gu Te is the brother of 'Gu He' but his relationship with his brother is never explained.

characters.title: Gu Ling
characters.introText: Before he achieved becoming a Dou Zun, the great Gu Ling had an earth shaking fight with an enemy of his. During that battle, the great Gu Ling, who was still a five star Dou Zong, may have successfully defeated his opponent but he was also seriously wounded to the point where his strength was scattered. According to common sense, even if he could continue living, his strength would also be reduced but what was that the reality? Seven years after that big battle, the great Gu Ling, who had been missing for a long time, once again appeared on the continent. At this time, his strength had already reached the Dou Zun class. In seven years, he had not only recovered from his serious injuries, but his strength had actually greatly leaped forward, directly advancing from a Dou Zong to a Dou Zun. This speed was really frightening!
characters.history:
Before he achieved becoming a Dou Zun, the great Gu Ling had an earth shaking fight with an enemy of his. During that battle, the great Gu Ling, who was still a five star Dou Zong, may have successfully defeated his opponent but he was also seriously wounded to the point where his strength was scattered. According to common sense, even if he could continue living, his strength would also be reduced but what was that the reality? Seven years after that big battle, the great Gu Ling, who had been missing for a long time, once again appeared on the continent. At this time, his strength had already reached the Dou Zun class. In seven years, he had not only recovered from his serious injuries, but his strength had actually greatly leaped forward, directly advancing from a Dou Zong to a Dou Zun. This speed was really frightening! 

Gu Ling had luckily obtained a ‘Yin-Yang Mysterious Dragon Pill’, which he consumed when he was roaming the continent back then. During those many long years, it had been latent within his body until the moment he was seriously wounded. At that point, the special effect of the ‘Yin-Yang Mysterious Dragon Pill’ was activated: To stand after breaking!

characters.appearance: This person appeared to be around forty years old or so. He looked just like an ordinary middle-aged man. His clothes were ordinary and made of linen. The smile that was appeared on his face caused one to feel somewhat peaceful.
characters.personality: He has a laid back personality for someone who was at the peak of the Dou Sheng class. This throws people off guard around him.
characters.history:
He came to talk to Xiao Yan when the latter was visiting the Gu Realm. He told Xiao Yan as long as Gu Xun Er was willing he will support her and Xiao Yan's relationship, only asking for Xiao Yan not to take her virginity until she reaches the Dou Sheng level to protect her bloodline. He then inquired if Xiao Yan met Xiao Xuan in the Heavenly Tomb and he further explained that Xiao Xuan agreed to become half living to pass on the bloodline of the Xiao Clan to a descendant. He told Xiao Yan that he doesn't know if there is a way to save him and let him leave. The only option he could think of was to become a Dou Di since that is who  created the Heavenly Tomb. Later when Xiao Yan was fleeing from the destruction of the Yao Clan he came to the the Gu Realm and informed them that it was the Hun Clan who was destroying the ancient clans.

He would join forces with the Yan and Lei clan to oppose the Hun Clan. During the final battle they were losing to the Hun Clan after Hun Tiandi stepped into the Dou Di class, but when Xiao Xiao Dou level all of sudden shot up to a seven star Dou Sheng he was relieved that Xiao Yan had also become a Dou Di and told him he would leave the rest to him. He watched the battle as Xiao Yan took the upper hand and sealed Hun Tiandi with all the Heavenly flames to end the calamity. He was present when Xiao Yan opened a tunnel to another dimension and his strength started to grow for the first time in years as there was Origin Qi in the tunnel.  In the final chapter he appears at Xiao Yan mansion as a Dou Di as they prepare to leave for another dimension. He had given the clan head title to Gu Qing Yang as he was ready to have some excitement after all the years as clan head.

characters.title: Hai Bodong
characters.introText: Hai Bo Dong is the one of the founders of the Mite'er Family. His prowess in ice Dou Qi earned him the title Ice Emperor. After breaking the seal that was placed on him by Queen Medusa, he returned to Two-Star Dou Huang Class.
characters.appearance:
His appearance was that of an old man. A frightening scar crossed from his left cheek to the corner of his eye.

When he was first shown, he was a tall old man with long light blue hair and a beard. After eating the modified pill, he turns into a young tanned boy with blue hair.
characters.personality: In the beginning, he was short-tempered and detached from people as he was living in isolation due to the curse Cai Lin put on him. After Xiao Yan released him from the curse, he was ecstatic to finally have his powers back.
characters.history:
As Ice Emperor, he was a member of the previous generation of the Top Ten in the Jia Ma Empire. He was both prideful and introverted while being extremely good at using Ice-type Dou Qi. Once, in anger, he had sealed an entire city in ice. Back then, he was one of the few Dou Huangs among the Ten Strong. Later on, he had a huge fight at the peak of the Misty Cloud Mountain with the previous leader of the Misty Cloud Sect. Although he was finally defeated, his opponent had a very difficult victory. During the last time Jia Ma Empire and Chu Yun Empire held a convention for the strong, he single-handedly fought a Dou Huang and a Dou Wang from the other side and was not defeated, shocking all present.

After the last convention for the strong, Ice Emperor gradually disappeared from the sight of many people. Now, the name Ice Emperor only existed personally in the memories of the older generation. The current generation of the top ten had already replaced their fame and glory.

Back then, after attending the convention between the empires, he came to the Tager Desert. By accident, he obtained the map fragment of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame, but he attracted the emperor of the Snake People, Queen Medusa, who chased him with the intention to kill. The strength of Queen Medusa can be ranked among the peak among the Dou Huangs. If not for the Snake People having only this one strong person, they might have long ago tried to attack the human empires.

In that battle, he was defeated by her hands without question. Although he found a chance to escape in the end, he was struck by her Curse of the Snakes Seal. Not only did his body quickly become old, even his strength was sealed to the level of a Dou Ling.

Hai Bodong has a deep relationship with the Mite'er Family. Additionally, the former leader of the Misty Cloud Sect, Yun Shan, seemed to have a friendship with him in the past.
characters.trivia:
Even though Cai Lin is an ally and Xiao Yan's wife he is still terrified of her, due to her defeating him and sealing his Dou Qi previously.

In the manhua he is called Hai Bodong.

In the light novel, he didn't need the full recovery pill in order to fully regain his peak power. He somehow had eaten that pill in the time period when Xiao Yan goes to the Jia Nan Academy. Xiao Yan didn't know of this so he created this recovery pill as the first 6th grade pill he officially made as a compensation for all the help that Hai Bodong gave to Xiao family.

The white crystal in Breaking Adversity Pill, will conceal itself deep within a human body once it is consumed by someone and it will not have even the slightest unusual action. However, if someone who possesses the ‘Bone Chilling Flame’ was to activate it, these icy bodies would swiftly transform into an extremely destructive ‘Bone Chilling Flame’.

He is the second person to see Yao Lao in his spirit form, the first being Xiao Yan, and the third being Medusa.

Hai Bodong had some psychological trauma after that extremely large scale explosion from the merging of flames done by Xiao Yan, which had nearly caused a few Dou Huang to meet their demise. Therefore, as long as he saw this fellow merging flames, he could not resist having an impulse to disappear somewhere far away.

characters.introText: Han Feng was one of the major antagonists during the Jia Nan Academy arc in "Battle Through the Heavens." He was the first disciple of Yao Lao. Due to his greed and pursuit of power, he murdered his master with the assistance of the Hall of Souls. He was promised the Qi Method Flame Mantra for his betrayal, but his master destroyed it and took it to the grave.
characters.appearance:
The man was wearing a green-colored, long-sleeved garment with a maple leaf sewn on the back of it, and the direction his gaze was drawn in was actually the spot where the energy had suddenly erupted from.

The face of the green-clothed man was quite handsome and outstanding. His long black-colored hair dangled to his shoulders. He also appeared to be carrying a strange medicinal fragrance on his body, causing people to involuntarily have a feeling of wanting to get close to him.

Below is the official Character introduction of Han Feng issued by the Animation Studio.

Character Preview

He had green hair and red eyes, ever since he was a child he had a costume with green colors in it. Almost everything he wore had the color green in it, even his essence flame.
characters.personality: Han Feng was cruel and malicious. He did not care for others, he even tried to kill his own master if it meant becoming stronger. He kidnapped, killed and experimented on innocent humans to see if that could make him stronger. He did not care what the price for power is, as long as it meant power.
characters.history:
Yao Lao, rescued Han Feng from being killed by thugs. Yao Lao took care of Han Feng as if he was his own son. He was a genius, compared to Xiao Yan it was said to be like comparing heaven and earth.

Han Feng studied under Yao Lao for a long time maybe even a year or two. But Han Feng was corrupted, he didn´t understand what was bad about killing those weaker than him. But his master did, and that made him hesitate to teach him the Flame Mantra. Han Feng noticed that his master would not give it to him so Han Feng poisoned him. And it was revealed that Han Feng had acquired help from the Hall of Souls, to become stronger in turn they would take Yao Lao's soul. And Han Feng would get Yao Lao's Qi Accumulation. However Yao Lao put a stop to this by turning into a spirit and blowing up his original body, the Flame Mantra included.

Many years later Han Feng is seen in a building hearing about his masters return.
characters.trivia:
Han Feng is the first disciple of Yao Chen

Han Feng is the 3rd on the Black Ranking in the Black-Corner Region.

Han Feng willingly gave his Sea Heart Flame to Old Mu Gu in order to save himself from the Hall of Souls.

He was hiding in the Black-Corner Region because he was afraid of the Feng Zun-zhe.

After Xiao Yan gave his Soul to Yao Chen it is unknown what happened to him.

In Donghua, after Xiao Yan handed Han Feng's soul to Yao Lao, he crushed Han Feng's soul with his own hand ending the bond as master and disciple.

Old Mu Gu preyed on Han Feng's jealous nature to trick him into secretly betraying Yao Lao by claiming Yao Lao didn't trust him or believe he was good enough to give him the Flame Mantra.

As a tier 6 alchemist, Han Fang could gather strong people to help him under the attraction of refining various pills needed by those experts. On that way he established the Black Alliance.

characters.title: Huan Feng
characters.introText: Huan Feng is one of the two External Elders from the Pill Tower, a highly respected 7 tier alchemist in the hall.
characters.history:
During the test of the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame, he demonstrated his skill by using the Sky Cold Flame, a rare beast flame extracted from the Sky Bone Python. Though it was not a Heavenly Flame, it bore some resemblance to the Bone Chilling Flame. As he summoned his flame, he shaped it into a white-colored fire python and sent it into the silver flame. Unlike the previous participants, whose flames were quickly devoured by the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame. Grandmaster Huan’s fire python managed to resist their onslaught, holding out through sheer resilience. However, despite its ability to endure, it was ultimately inferior to the Nine Dragon Lightning Flame. Just as the dragons were about to consume it, the ten-minute mark arrived, and Grandmaster Huan swiftly recalled his flame, narrowly passing the test. Though he succeeded, his expression remained solemn, acknowledging the overwhelming power of Tang Zhen’s Heavenly Flame.

Together with Xiao Yan, he helped Tang Zhen refine a tier 7 Fire Bodhisattva Pill. He couldn't endure a difficult refining and went unconscious during the refining. Luckily Xiao Yan managed to endure it all by himself. Otherwise pill refining would be completely ruined.

characters.title: Huang Yi
characters.introText: He was hiding when Xiao Yan found the Core Soul Marrow. He came out and told Xiao Yan to hand over half of the Core Soul Marrow and he would allow Xiao Yan to leave. He saw Xiao Yan was only a 4 star Dou Zong and felt he was not a threat to him. Xiao Yan said to him “I have never heard of your name. However, if you wish to get a share of the treasure from me... just who do you think you are?” Xiao Yan then brought out his Earth Demon Puppet and had it attack Huang Yi without saying another word to him.  He was easily defeated by the puppet and he tried to tell Xiao Yan that he was wrong, but he looked and Xiao Yan was not at the place he was previously and Huang Yi tried to hurriedly retreat as he knew he was in danger. He was too late as Xiao Yan appeared behind him and attacked. After he was defeated Xiao Yan made Huang Yi break the Jade Token and leave the Pill Region for trying to snatch Core Soul Marrow from him. He realized that if he didn't Xiao Yan wouldn't hesitate to kill him. As he was leaving Huang Yi asked for Xiao Yan's name which he gave him. Huang Yi stiffened as he heard this name as he had heard about the battle between Xiao Yan and the Ice River Valley and was upset to have run into such a fierce foe soon after entering the Pill Realm.

She is introduced when Xiao Yan went to take the alchemist test in Black Rock City. She misjudged Xiao Yan abilities when she first met him. During the test he took longer to finish then that rest of the testers as the he pill he had to created was an Amassing Strength Pill that is considered a Tier 1 High level pill. She was dismissive till it was revealed the pill formula he was given. She was shocked when he requested to take the Tier Alchemist test right away. She was not allowed to see the test in person and found he passed right away. Ao Tuo and Fu Lan Ke told her there will always be someone that is higher so don't look down on someone like Xiao Yan. He had hide his abilities so the first impression she had about him was wrong.

His character is as straightforward as it had always been.

He had to suffer the fire poison for two years and could not advance and was at the 9th rank of the power ranking.

He has gotten fire poisoned deep into his heart and his mind has been corroding and in exchange for Xiao Yan's help in removing the poison he gave Xiao Yan Green Wood Celestial Wine.

It took around 2 months for the Fire Poison to be completely eliminate. After being in total control of his mind, he became good friends with Xiao Yan and helped him many times.+

He was one of the people that followed Xiao Yan back to the Jia Ma Empire to help him get his revenge against the Misty Cloud Sect.
characters.trivia:
He is ranked 9 in the inner branch.

During his travels he was able to reach the level of a four star Dou Huang, yet his strength had only soared so much because he had accidentally obtained an inheritance from an ancestor.

However a homage the manhua paid to the novel could be seen in the way Ling Ying's Dou Qi as well as attacks were all colored black, probably a reference to his darkness-type element.

He periodically gives information about Xiao Yan to Gu Xun Er.

infobox.Name: Xiao Yi Xian

characters.introText: Little Fairy Doctor is one of the main female deuteragonist in Battle through the Heavens. She was cursed with a poisonous body. Although this body affords her great strength, it will also endanger her with upcoming imminent death and also result in the death of everyone else in her vicinity. Anyone who had a similar fate in the past died painfully when all the poison within their body exploded, destroying everything in a thousand mile radius. Thanks to the information collected by Yao Chen, Xiao Yan was able to help her fully suppress and control the poisonous body.
characters.appearance:
The lady was wearing a pale white dress. She was not extremely beautiful but could be called an uncommon beauty. Her lightly smiling face emitted a fresh aura that was unique and greatly increased her charm.

Xiao Yan’s gaze swept across the lady’s body before finally landing on a narrow waist that was bound by a green belt. Seeing the narrow waist that could not fill a hug, amazement flashed across his eyes.

Amongst the ladies Xiao Yan had come to know, Xun Er was the most enchanting with her beauty and mystery that one could not find fault with. Ya Fei was a stunning, enchanting temptress and Xiao Yu had her long sexy legs which Xiao Yan’s eyes could not help but stare at each time he saw them. The woman in white that was in front of him, on the other hand, was the one with the narrowest and most delicate waist. Although this lady was not extremely beautiful, her gentle and soft demeanor was more than sufficient to sway one’s heart.
characters.personality:
Kind and cheerful person whose smile could warm the heart of every man.

Her encounters during these years had created her somewhat cold and indifferent character. Unless it was someone she was familiar with, she would not take the initiative to make contact or chat with them. After all those things that she had experienced during these couple of years, the current Little Fairy Doctor was clearly no longer that kind and naive girl from back then. Her ruthless character could only surpass Medusa.

Her white clothes caused some ethereal feeling to be added to her extraordinary demeanor. However, it might be because this demeanor was far too intoxicating to other people, but it was likely that no one could imagine that this woman, who seemed warm and moving, would immediately turn from a fairy to a death god that sought lives should she become angry…
characters.history:
The Novel never gives her background.

Yi Xian's mother brought her to a village that specialized in collecting herbs and the village warmly accepted them. Yi Xian was only 3 year old when she was with her mother. One day she had discovered a beautiful flower which was called the money flower although it was extremely beautiful it contains a deadly poison. It had a seductive scent and the 3 year old Yi Xian could not resist the temptation and ate the flower. She did not lose her life, but rather became a demon and murdered all the people who lived in the village, including her mother. Afterwards she was found by Xiao Yao and was adopted by him.
characters.trivia:
The Xiao in her name means "little" while the Xiao in Xiao Yan name means "within". 'Xiao Yi Xian' means 'Little Fairy Doctor'.

She is also known as the Fairy Doctor (Novel only)

She is the fourth woman to fall in love with Xiao Yan.

She had established the Poison Sect back then on a whim. If she was to really discuss about it, the effort that she had put into it was naturally unlike what Xiao Yan did for the Yan Alliance.

characters.appearance:
A lady wearing a snow-fox cashmere dress. The lady had a beautiful appearance. She had a melon face, small cherry mouth, drawing-like eyebrows and watery big eyes. After all, females were the minority within the Inner Academy. Beautiful ladies were all the more sought after by everyone. TL: Melon face - long face

No matter where one was, a beauty would always easily be sought after and favored.

Being surrounded by people, with her at the middle, like a moon being surrounded by stars, this fox cashmere-dressed lady may have a sweet and calm smile on her face for now but one could still see self-satisfaction and vanity within her eyes. This kind of self-satisfaction was the true evaluation that people had about her after going past the aura that the lady exerted from her body.

Vanity was always the thing that a woman could not resist. A woman’s heart would involuntarily feel quiet and self-satisfied when she watched so many men fighting because of her.

After she entered the high grade area, this lady’s pupils gently drifted toward the men whose footsteps had paused because of her. Under her gentle water ripple eyes, the faces of some of the mentally weak people involuntarily reddened. After which, their eyes hurriedly avoided her.

Seeing the gazes of these males students becoming evasive under her watch, the lady laughed softly. Her beautiful smile suddenly caused this sealed interior of the tower to become much brighter.
characters.personality:
Arrogant and wicked person who was the first to swing accusations. She is the type of woman who appears to be gentle, but bones were extremely haughty. 

After learning that there were many people stronger than her cousin brother, whom she thought of as seemingly undefeatable in her heart. This caused her to hold back her unruly self and learn to treat others gently.
characters.history: She is the young mistress of the Liu Clan.

characters.introText: Liu Ling is a third rank Alchemist being trained by the Pill King Gu He. He works under Gu He with an affiliation with Misty Cloud Sect. He meets Xiao Yan as Yan Xiao during the Alchemist competition.
characters.appearance:
His age was also quite young and his figure was tall and straight, appearing only slightly over twenty years old. His handsome face had lines that seemed to be carved by a knife, emitting a somewhat feminine feeling. The gentle smile on his face also had an easy time moving some ladies’ hearts. When comparing the appearance of this person to Xiao Yan’s disguised appearance, it was like two polar regions that were extremely far apart.

Of course, the thing that attracted the most attention was still the alchemist badge on the young man’s chest. On it, three silver colored ripples reflected an eye-piercing glow under the sunlight. Those passersby, whose heart originally had contained a sour feeling because of the other party having the company of such a beautiful woman, felt dull initially upon seeing the three silver colored ripples that represented his status. Immediately, the unhappiness in their eyes automatically turned into one of respect that one used when faced with a strong person.
characters.personality: He was haughty and arrogant as Gu He's disciple. After experiencing this Grand Meeting, his character appeared to have become less haughty.

characters.appearance:
The man who appeared in the battleground had a tall and large body which was not much different from the ape-like body of Yan Hao. He was tall and burly. He wore a Chinese garment, and had a resolute face. His eyebrows were quite thick, and he was carrying a dark-black heavy spear that was as tall as him on his back. This black-colored long spear was longer than any spear Xiao Yan had ever seen before. This spear also carried a sharp tyrant-like aura, much like its owner.

He is not much different from his Light Novel counterpart, but sports a more masculine appearance: prominent scars on his body and wears a partial armed-warrior attire. He also wears large earrings on both ears. Contrary as a spearman, he first fought Xiao Yan with his body and Dou Techniques, like two manly fighting crazy warriors.
characters.personality: Liu Qing has a tendency to fight and will stand up for his favored family members. Compared to his cousin Liu Fei, he was a much better person and was not petty to hold grudges with wins and losses. His temper matured when he became the head of the Liu Clan as he had to think not only for himself but for his clan members too.
characters.history:
Liu Qing is a top expert among the top ten of the ‘Strong Ranking.’ One can count the number of students in the Inner Academy who are able to defeat him with one’s fingers. Additionally, in the Fighting Arena, he was one of the few extremely strong people who had once maintained eight consecutive victories. There are quite a number of people in the Inner Academy who view his name with reverence.

He is the young master and later head of the Liu Clan.

characters.introText: Sinister. Mo Cheng was also known as Executioner Mo after he, by himself, killed everyone in the 'Black Rotary Bandit Troop'.
characters.appearance: A middle-aged man.
characters.personality: Sinister. Mo Cheng was also known as Executioner Mo after he, by himself, killed everyone in the 'Black Rotary Bandit Troop'.
characters.history:
When he was young, he had once joined the Misty Cloud Sect. After that, he left the Misty Cloud Sect in order to manage the matters in the clan. However, that guy can be considered to be intelligent. Although he had left the Misty Cloud Sect, each year, he would pay an extremely large tribute to the Misty Cloud Sect. Additionally, each time the Misty Cloud Sect’s upper echelons had some joyous occasions etc, he would personally go and congratulate them. His personality is extremely sleek. According to rumors, when the Misty Cloud Sect Leader accepted a disciple over ten plus years ago, that guy was also invited. After returning from the Misty Cloud Sect, that guy had continued to talk about it, flaunting it everywhere. Of course, being able to participate in the Misty Cloud Sect Leader accepting disciple ceremony is indeed something that others would be envious about.

Therefore, although this guy had left the Misty Cloud Sect, not only was he not chased after by the enforcement team of the Misty Cloud Sect, but also managed to obtain an ‘External Deacon’ title. In all these years, the reason why no one had come into conflict with him while many strong people come to this north-eastern region, was because they feared the Misty Cloud Sect behind them! Ha ha, after all, that is really a truly enormous monster.
characters.trivia:
The death of Mo Cheng, once it was discovered that he was killed by Xiao Yan, was the trigger that started the blood feud between the Misty Cloud Sect and Xiao Yan.

He was killed by the Bone Chilling Flame in the Novel, but in the Donghua he was killed by the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.

Mo cheng also gained fame after he destroyed the Black Rotary Bandit Troop that had caused havoc and also killed Jia Ma Empire's imperial troops.

characters.introText: Nalan Yanran is the main female antagonist in the Three Year Agreement arc of "Battle through the Heavens." After this she becomes one of the female tritagonist.
characters.appearance:
The lady was wearing a broad sleeved, tight body moon white long robe. Her extremely hug-able waist was tied with a silver colored belt which exactly and perfectly revealed her narrow waist.

The lady’s hands were extremely soft. Her skin was creamy and her small eyebrows revealed a faint otherworldly elegance as she smiled artfully. The smile was seemingly gentle but it had an indifference seeping out that held everyone far away.

A pair of green colored jade earrings hung on the lady’s delicate earlobes. The soft ‘clink’ sound as the jade earrings swayed was like moving music created by the performance of the mountain springs and reefs.

Her appearance in the Donghua is slightly altered but somewhat similar to that of Light novel. Character PV is depicted below.

https://battle-through-the-heavens.fandom.com/wiki/File:Nalan_Yanran_Character_PV.mp4
characters.personality:
She was known to be overly haughty and have a cold personality because of her status as the disciple of Yun Yun and a member of Misty Cloud Sect. As she ages she becomes less haughty and more mature. This causes her to regret the decision to end the marriage with Xiao Yan as he protected her a few times and she liked the feeling of being protect by him.  Her own thoughts "Behind this skinny back, she seemed to be able to completely relax her heart. At one point, she could have enjoyed such a feeling for her entire life. However, it was ultimately destroyed by her...."

After these years of polishment, she was no longer the same arrogant and overbearing person from back then.
characters.history: She is the daughter of Nalan Su and her grandfather, Nalan Jie, had made an marriage agreement with Xiao Yan's grandfather for them to be married.
characters.trivia:
It can be considered poetic justice that Yun Yun and Xiao Yan fall in love with each other after Nalan Yanran broke off the the engagement with him.

In the light novel, she greatly admires his potential and abilities and may have fallen for him due to his performance in the Grand Alchemy Tournament.

In the Light Novel, she is 3 years older than him. As she is 20 and he is 17 at the time of the Three Year Challenge.

Nalan Yanran was the most outstanding person among the younger generation of the Misty Cloud Sect. At the age of thirteen, she agglomerated and formed a vortex, successfully advancing to a Dou Zhe. At sixteen, she climbed to a Dou Shi. At twenty, she had become a Da Dou Shi! A twenty year old Da Dou Shi. Although one would not dare to say that this kind of training speed was the most outstanding one in the many years that the Misty Cloud Sect has existed, it was more than sufficient for her to be ranked among the top ten.

Throughout the Novel after she left the Jia Ma Empire whenever she would meet up with Xiao Yan she would greatly regret cancelling her marriage as she stated " If I hadn't done what I did, I could have been protected behind his back my whole life."

Of course, this Old Ground Demon Ghost’s strength is naturally far inferior to the headmaster’s power. He should possess the strength of a five or six star Dou Zong.

His talent was not considered poor. Otherwise, he would not have reached this level. However, compared to Mang Tian Chi and those old fellows from a similar generation who had left the Black-Corner Region he could be considered the last rank. Now, Mang Tian Chi had long since become an elite Dou Zun. On the other hand, he was still lingering in the Dou Zong class. This point had always been a pain in his heart.

characters.introText: A cow was slowly feeding on the grass in a field thousands of kilometers from the Falling Star Pavilion, there was a man in his teens on the back of the cow. The youth herding the cow swung his whip and the cow slowly headed into the distance.
characters.appearance:
A cow was slowly feeding on the grass in a field thousands of kilometers from the Falling Star Pavilion, there was a man in his teens on the back of the cow. The youth herding the cow swung his whip and the cow slowly headed into the distance.

The person on the bull had a small figure. He was wearing ordinary rough clothes. His eyes were clear, and his face appeared tender. From his appearance, he appeared as though he was a boy in his teens!
characters.history:
The elder who refined the ancestor was one of the founders of the Pill Tower, but that elder person has already died.  A year before he was about to die, he spent all his effort to refine a medicinal pill. This ancestor had been exhausted when the pill formed and ended up quietly dying. However, a tendril of his spirit entered the tier 9 medicinal pill in a strange fashion, causing this tier 9 medicinal pill to undergo a transformation.

Subsequently, this medicinal pill turned into a human form that did not leave the Pill Tower. It remained behind as a guardian of the Pill Tower. From a certain point of view, this ancestor could be described as a unique avatar of that elder, but the control of this avatar is rather complicated. With the flow of time, the ancestor has rescued the Pill Tower from destruction time and time again. In the end, no one could match his status in the Pill Tower, but he was not really interested in this. He would go missing after the Pill Tower stabilized. No one could find him.
characters.trivia:
Unlike almost every other character who is a human or a Magical Beast, the Ancestor is a Tier 9 Mysterious Pill refined by the founder of the Pill Tower, that gained sentience.

He is mentioned multiple times but only appears in the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame arc of the Novel.

His true name is never given if there was one.

If it was someone who did not have a strong mental strength, their legs would involuntarily become limp under these violent gazes that were filled with killing intent.

characters.title: Tian She
characters.introText: It was rumored that this old fellow was not only strong, but had also practiced the Ice Zun Force of the Ice River Valley to a peak level. An ordinary Dou Zong was unable to even last ten exchanges against him. Moreover, each time this person fought, he would not leave anyone alive. Additionally, he relied on the overbearing of his Ice Zun Force to freeze his opponents into life-like ice sculptures, causing one to feel terrified just by looking at it.
characters.appearance:
This old man had white hair and was holding a walking stick with a snake head that appeared to be made from white jade. The snake head’s large, savage mouth was widened, and it had a pair of snake eyes which emitted a dark, cold aura. He appeared exceptionally ordinary compared to the three elders beside him. Not even a little energy seeped out of his body. Even that elderly face appeared exceptionally shriveled. His narrowed eyes appeared turbid. His appearance was no different from that of an ordinary old man.

The thing that surprised others was that this old man, who did not seem special, was actually standing at the middle of this group of people. Even the three white-clothed, old men with majestic auras remained half a step behind him. Their brows revealed a respectful expression.

characters.appearance: A young man wearing yellow with a knife scar on his face.

characters.history: Wang Chen’s name was quite well-known. One could hardly find anyone who was a match for him in the same generation. Moreover, this fellow was bloodthirsty and addicted to fights. Additionally, he had an outstanding training talent and his strength grew extremely quickly. By relying on the strength of the Yellow Spring Pavilion, he liked to fight with some experts of the Dou Zong class. The other person, being afraid of the Yellow Spring Pavilion’s strength, was afraid of really killing him. Hence, Wang Chen’s name became more and more renowned as time passed. In the end, there was even rumors of him possessing the strength to fight with a Dou Zong. No one knew whether this rumor was real

characters.trivia: During his encounter with Zi Yan, the Western Dragon King was nearly sliced in half by a single strike of Dragon Slaying Sword, leaving him with a massive, life-threatening wound.

characters.title: White Tianzun
characters.introText: White Tianzun is an elderly man dressed in white robes, visually contrasting his companion, Black Tianzun.
characters.appearance: White Tianzun is an elderly man dressed in white robes, visually contrasting his companion, Black Tianzun.
characters.personality: Cold, authoritative.
characters.history:
White Tianzun arrives at the Death Soul Mountain Range after Old Ghost Zhai Xing is left heavily crippled by Xiao Yan. He openly mocks Zhai Xing’s greed and failure, making it clear that this disaster could have been avoided had the latter called for help earlier.

White Tianzun then shifts focus entirely to capturing Xiao Yan. When Xiao Yan’s group attempts to escape through a spatial door opened by Zi Yan, White Tianzun reacts instantly, launching an attack alongside Black Tianzun to stop them.
However, Tie Jian zun-zhe’s desperate self-destruction attempt and a spatial interference ultimately allow Xiao Yan’s group to escape.

characters.title: Xia Ao
characters.introText: A large man with thick eyebrows wearing a dark-golden armor.
characters.appearance: A large man with thick eyebrows wearing a dark-golden armor.
characters.personality: Confident in his strength and position, he is bold and confrontational, often looking down on others while strictly following the orders of the Western Dragon King.
characters.history:
Xia Ao leads his army to the Ancient Dragon Island, demanding the Zi Yan. Confident in the Eastern Dragon Island's weakness, he believes his forces will easily secure victory.

During the battle, Xia Sha confronts Hei Qing, who is protecting Xiao Yan. Just as Xia Ao seems to gain the upper hand, Qing Yan from the Northern Dragon Island arrives, complicating the situation further.

Then, Zi Yan awakens as the Dragon Emperor, and her presence instantly commands respect. The power she shows forces everyone, including Xia Ao, to kneel.

Realizing they can’t win against her, Xia Ao and the other commanders retreat. The rise of Zi Yan changes everything, uniting the tribe and challenging the other dragon kings.

characters.title: Xia Mang
characters.introText: His human body and limbs were covered with densely packed black-green scales. The spot where his head was supposed to be located had a savage looking snake head. Its tiny eyes contained a dark coldness and ruthlessness as they stared at the people below.
characters.appearance:
His human body and limbs were covered with densely packed black-green scales. The spot where his head was supposed to be located had a savage looking snake head. Its tiny eyes contained a dark coldness and ruthlessness as they stared at the people below.

Additionally, on the back of this half-human half-snake demon was a pair of black-green Dou Qi wings, that carried a strong wild that swept through the gorge as they flapped.
characters.personality: He is not only greedy, but it is also like a beast in rut when it meets a beautiful woman.
characters.history: He wanted to obtain Han Xue but was stopped by Xiao Yan and fled for his life.

characters.title: Xia Sha
characters.introText: Xia Sha is a member of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe and the fourth commander of the Dragon Armor army.
characters.appearance: Man wearing dark-golden armor, with golden eyes and a faintly fierce face.
characters.history: In this confrontation, Xia Sha is accompanied by forces from both the Western and Southern Dragon Islands, which includes the Dragon Armor Army from the Western Dragon Island and the Barbarian Dragon Army from the Southern Dragon Island. These powerful groups are backing Xia Sha as he demands that Hei Qing hand over Zi Yan. He threatens to cause a massacre on the Eastern Dragon Island if his demands are not met. The battle between Xia Sha and Hei Qing escalates as they exchange powerful attacks, with Xia Sha.

characters.title: Xiao Cai
characters.introText: Small, narrow snake only about two centimeters long. Its body is covered in distinctive tiny tail, vibrant seven-colored scales, and it has captivating pale purple, quartz-like eyes. Despite its small size, it possesses an air of elegance and nobility. It lacks the vicious look of a typical snake, instead appearing beautiful and harmless.
characters.appearance: Small, narrow snake only about two centimeters long. Its body is covered in distinctive tiny tail, vibrant seven-colored scales, and it has captivating pale purple, quartz-like eyes. Despite its small size, it possesses an air of elegance and nobility. It lacks the vicious look of a typical snake, instead appearing beautiful and harmless.
characters.personality: Pure, Innocent, Baby-like consciousness separate from the vicious soul of Queen Medusa
characters.history:
When Queen Medusa attempted to evolve her bloodline using the Heavenly Flame, the process resulted in her soul being temporarily suppressed and her body reverting to a small, beautiful, seven-colored snake.

Queen Medusa’s previous accompanying spirit was the enormous purple snake that you saw just now. That spirit was a Rank 5 Magical Beast, the Quiet Purple Flame Serpent. According to legends, this Quiet Purple Flame Serpent can activate their faint bloodline within their bodies and transform into their ancient ancestor. Naturally, the chances of this happening are extremely meager. They are so meager that it can be simply neglected. That ancient exotic beast that could once contend with those at the Dou Sheng level was called ‘Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python’. Its differentiating point is its seven-colored body, its slight purple pupils, its body fragrance and its overwhelming strength.

The affection and bond the Python consciousness (Xiao Cai) developed for Xiao Yan later became a critical factor. When Queen Medusa's dominant soul occasionally resurfaced, the attachment of the Xiao Cai consciousness would interfere with her intent to kill Xiao Yan, leading to internal conflict and further driving the plot.
characters.trivia:
An ordinary person only knows that the place where a Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python died has a chance of forming a Seven-Colored Origin Stone. However, they are unaware that if a hundred or more Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python die in the same spot, there is a chance an eight-colored or even nine-colored Origin Stone will form, but it is basically impossible for a hundred Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python to die at the same spot. Hence, an ordinary person is only aware of the Seven-Colored Origin Stone not the eight or nine color stones.

Xiao Cai likes eating drops of Amethyst Lion Birth Essence.

The ‘Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python’ originally was only a foot long, but it could turn into a huge being that was tens of feet long in just an instant.

characters.title: Xiao Chen
characters.introText: Xiao Chen possessed a shocking talent. He could be considered a cousin of Xiao Xuan. However, he did not like to be restrained by anything and was a rather temperamental person. An unknown number of experts perished to his axe before he became renowned. In the end, he disappeared without reason. The Xiao clan was unable to find anything about him regardless of how they searched.
characters.appearance: A somewhat skinny figure.
characters.personality:
He was quite and eccentric. He did not say much.

Having survived in the illusion for thousands of years caused Xiao Chen’s temperamental character to become a lot more quiet and lonely. This loneliness had grown even greater after he heard Xiao Yan mention the decline of the Xiao clan. After all, he was no longer someone of this era.
characters.history: Xiao Chen was Xiao Xuan's junior cousin and one of the most feared members of the old Xiao Clan. When the  Xiao Clan left the Central Plains, Xiao Chen was trapped in the illusion of Purifying Lotus Demon Flame so he survived to the Xiao Yan's time. His was a 5 star Dou Sheng when he met Xiao Yan. He was around 4 Stars a thousand years ago but if he hadn't been captured by Purifying Lotus and continued normal training then he could have been 6 Stars, perhaps even 7.
characters.trivia:
He Loves Xiao Xiao so much that he taught her all his Dou Skills and some people thought he was going to give her his Dou Qi.

It can be assumed that he might advance to Dou Di, since Xiao Yan ripped Origin Qi from the tunnel he opened between worlds.

characters.title: Xiao Ding
characters.introText: Xiao Ding is the oldest brother of Xiao Yan. Together with Xiao Li he formed the Desert Metal Mercenary Company so that they can protect Xiao Yan from becoming a servant.
characters.appearance:
A young man seated on the leader’s seat. He was wearing a white robe and was smiling as he watched Xiao Yan enter the room. His eyes which were brighter than ordinary people’s carried a wisdom.

Although this man’s legs were currently crippled, everyone would involuntarily feel some chillness for some unknown reason when they looked at the face where a faint smile was hung.
characters.personality:
He was a person who had always knew how to endure. After coming out and polishing himself for so many years, his endurance had already reached perfection. In the Rock Desert City, the names of the cunning fox Xiao Ding and the vicious wolf Xiao Li would leave their opponents extremely worried.

Among the three brothers of the Xiao clan, Xiao Ding was calm, wise and farsighted, Xiao Li was sinister and vicious, while Xiao Yan was mysterious and unpredictable. The three of them had different characters but they were able to cause their opponents to feel uneasy and turn their hearts cold.
characters.history: He is the eldest Xiao Brother and was the temporary leader of the clan till Xiao Yan returned to the Jia Ma Empire.
characters.trivia:
Xiao Yan expelled the poison from Xiao Ding legs . The poison from Hun clan that made his legs unable to move before.

He became an elder of Yan alliance .

characters.personality: His nickname in the clan was, Cold hearted Xiao Han. This old guy, even if it was to his own Xiao Zhan, would still talk in a foreign manner.
characters.history: He was in charge of the Qi Method Pavilion, his position in Xiao clan was comparable to that of one of the 3 elders.

He was not mentioned in the Novel after Xiao Yan returned to destroy the Misty Cloud Sect. So, it is unknown if he was still alive.

He was only in Chapter 51

If someone offended him, he was the fierce type who would strike back even if he was dying.

His character was vicious and cautious. He basically did not trust anyone other than a couple of relatives.

characters.personality: Xiao Mei's personality represents the "fickle nature of fair-weather friends".
characters.history:
Xiao Yan and Xiao Mei were close when they were young and she was on par with Gu Xun Er with her feelings towards Xiao Yan at that time. When Xiao Yan lost his talent, she was like most of the clan who had the attitude of 'don't waste your time with a cripple'. She began to ignore and distance herself from him. She could be considered as the 4th most talented person in the Xiao Yan generation. The first one is Xiao Yan, followed by Xun Er and Xiao Ning.

She is regarded as the second most attractive woman in the Xiao Clan, behind Gu Xun Er, and was a close friend of Xiao Yan before he lost his talent. Due to his talent loss, she decided to distance herself from him. After his talent was restored, she made an effort to invite him to learn skills from her father but Gu Xun Er intervened and informed her that she had a date with Xiao Yan, so he couldn't accompany her. She came to the realization that she could compete with any other female member of the clan, but ultimately lost to Gu Xun Er. She would attempt to mend her relationship with Xiao Yan, but he would only treat her as a family member and didn't show any chance for the relationship to return to what it was before.

When he came to the Jia Nan Academy he pulled her aside and explained the situation of the clan and told her to stay in the academy and not return to the Jia Ma Empire until he resolved the issue with the Misty Cloud Sect. As he made his way back to the Jia Ma Empire to destroy the Misty Cloud Sect. She saw Xiao Yu and him hugging, she wished for him to show her affection and like her. As Xiao Yan prepared to leave after saying goodbye to both Xiao Yu and her, she ultimately couldn't contain her regret and saying 'sorry'. Xiao Yan didn't mind and simply said that he had forgotten about the matters from back then and that she was still his cousin sister, and quickly rushed away. She had a faint understanding that Xiao Yan may have forgiven her, but he would never truly forgive those who abandoned him at his lowest point, and she would never again have a place in his heart.

She was last seen when Xiao left to deal with the Misty Cloud Sect and at Jia Nan Academy. She did not reappear in the novel after that.
characters.trivia:
She had a spot in Xiao Yan's heart, just like Gu Xun Er did. After becoming crippled, she decided to distance herself from Xiao Yan, much to her regret later on.

Unlike her Manhua counterpart she appeared in chapter 1 of the light novel.

Unlike the events in the Manhua, Xiao Yan does not directly forgive her for her actions but does break the barrier for her.

characters.history:
Xiao Xuan was one of the ancestors of the Xiao clan (before its decline), and one of four peak existences during his time (9-star Dou Sheng with half a step into the Dou Di class). He is the ancestor of Xiao Yan and creator of the Skyfire Three Mysterious Change Secret Technique (which is actually a method to create the Xiao clan tattoo). When he met with Xiao Yan in the Heavenly Tomb in the Gu Realm, he claimed that he had possessed 3 Heavenly Flames to make up the Skyfire Three Mysterious Change Dou skill without the use of a Qi method such as the Flame Mantra (basically through sheer will alone).

At the time, Xiao Xuan and the Xiao clan Elders realized that the Dou Di bloodline in their clan was diminishing, and in an attempt to replenish the bloodline, they agreed to give Xiao Xuan the Dou Di bloodline of everyone in the clan to allow him to breakthrough to the Dou Di class (and thus why the current Xiao family has no trace of Dou Di blood in their bodies). However, while breaking through, he was ambushed by the Hun clan (including one of the other 4 peak existences at the time), leading to his death, though he forcefully detonated his three Heavenly Flames and was able to severely injure the Hun clan peak Dou Sheng.

He requested members of the Gu Clan to bring his soul back to the Heavenly Tomb after his death, where he remained for centuries. He had his body taken to the Heavenly Tomb in order to wait for an Xiao Clan member who was worthy enough to inherit the remaining Xiao Clan Bloodline. He waited 1000 years before Xiao Yan arrives.
characters.trivia:
He was the only person who had nearly managed to kill Hun Tiandi in the many years that had passed!

He made a comment about how his Xiao Clan ended up wining when he met Xiao Yan and Gu Xun Er for the first time. This caused Xun Er to blush.

After Xiao Yan advanced to Dou Di and defeated the Hun clan he spoke to himself, but talking as if it were to Xiao Xuan, that he accomplished what you were unable to do. Since Xiao Yan advanced to Dou Di it reestablished the Dou Di bloodline of the Xiao Clan.

characters.title: Xiao Zhan
characters.introText: Xiao Zhan is the father of Xiao Yan, Xiao Li, and Xiao Ding and he was the Patriarch/Leader of the Xiao Family, before his disappearance during the fight with Yun Leng. It was later found out that the Hall of Souls had abducted him. Xiao Yan trades the Tou She Ancient God's jade for his return.
characters.appearance: The middle-aged man was wearing an expensive-looking grey tunic. He walked with pride and dignity and his face showed it. Xiao Zhan is meaty and average height man, with grey hair and blue eyes.
characters.personality:
Even when Xiao Yan lost his talent and became "trash" he did not lose his love for him but actually his love for his son grew. Xiao Zhan and his wife named Xiao Yan, because Yan meaning fire which represents Phoenix because he believed that Xiao Yan will never give up.

He is considered prudent, but will be hard if that is what is called for.

Listening to Xiao Zhan’s words, the surrounding mercenaries felt their heads grow numb. No wonder the son was so vicious, his father was even more ruthless!
characters.history:
Xiao Zhan tried his best to help Xiao Yan when he lost his talent even though the rest of the clan, except Gu Xun Er, had given up on him. He was delighted when Xiao Yan finally recovered his cultivation talent. As the Xiao Clan was battling the other clans for dominance in the market place, Xiao Yan disguised as Yao Chen came to the clan to help them and provided many elixirs for the clan to sell. This gave the Xiao Clan a leap above the other clans. When he found out the Jia Lie Nu was killed he confronted Xiao Yan and he confirmed he was indeed dead. Xiao Zhan was amused that the Jie Clan, who they had fought for years, was brought down by his son.

After the 3 year agreement was over he returned to the clan to see it being besieged by the Jia Lie Clan and the Ao Ba Clan. After killing all of them he found out Xiao Zhan was attacked by an elder of the Misty Cloud Sect. When he went to the Sect he found out that he disappeared while he was being attacked. Later Xiao Yan would find out he was  kidnapped by the Hall of Souls because they wanted the Tou She Ancient God’s Jade which was in possession of the Xiao Clan.

The Hall of Souls didn't gain the jade from Xiao Zhan as he left it in the Xiao Clan where the jade was given to Xiao Yan. Xiao Zhan was imprisoned by the Hall of Souls for more than 10 years and when Xiao Yan exchanged Xiao Zhan for the piece of the Tou She Ancient God Jade, Xiao Zhan was finally freed. He was proud of his son as he watched him battle the Hun Clan and caused them loses. After being freed Xiao Yan brought Gu Xun Er and Cai Lin to meet him. When he meets Xun Er again he felt she was the perfect wife for Xiao Yan and when Xiao Yan informed him that she was part of the Xiao Clan he was thrilled . When he was introduced to Cai Lin he was also surprised she also his daughter in law and gave Xiao Yan  a thumbs up. He was surprised when he was told she was also Medusa. Xiao Yan told him he is free and will nurse him back to health and that his granddaughter is waiting for them. With this he thought his son was a little too efficient.

During the years spent in the imprisonment, Xiao Zhan advanced to the Dou Huang class, as Hall of Souls fed him with various medicinal pills in order to keep him alive.
characters.trivia:
Xiao Zhan was in the Da Dou Shi class before he got caught by the Hall of Souls. The Hall of Souls gave him Numerous Medicinal pills and his level increased to Dou Huang It is not known what level his is at after Xiao Yan stepped into the Dou Di class.

In the Manhua he has a small crush on Ruo Lin and when he writes a letter to Xiao Xun asking about his well being he also asked about Ruo Lin.

A hot flame would combust and rise in the deep region of their eyes. From the looks of it, after these people returned home, they would imagine their wives or female servants at home to be this enchanting lady that was filled with temptation.
characters.personality:
Although this woman usually puts on an appearance filled with smiles, everyone knew that this woman was actually very arrogant. Today however, this haughty woman, contrary to her normal self, was respectfully guiding guests.

She is very cunning and has feelings for Xiao Yan. But she denied this fact and told Xiao Xun Er that Xiao Yan and her had a business relationship. When he returned to destroy the Misty Cloud Sect she realized that she had indeed fallen for him.
characters.history: She is the head auctioneer for the Miteer Family and was one of the first people to realize that Xiao Yan will become someone great in the future.
characters.trivia:
She was the only one who managed to figure out that Xiao Yan was in disguise when he was selling his medicine at the Miteer Auction House

It was Ya Fei who ordered the shadow corps to spread rumors across The Jia Ma Empire to scare away people.

A lot of people came to the Miteer Auction House so that they can meet Ya Fei and not for the items that were being auctioned. Some even dared to masturbate (Light Novel).

She became interested in Xiao Yan on the first day she met him.

She showed a small interest in becoming a Receptarier but was sad because she knew that she had no talent in such things.

When Ya Fei found out Xiao Yan was the mysterious man, he brought her to a lover's spot. Not only did he slightly threaten her about revealing his identity, he had quite a cold attitude towards her this contrast to the manhua.

Afterward, due to many transactions between the Miteer Auction House and Xiao Yan, he maintains a friendly relationship with Ya Fei. He's also seen to have a flirty attitude with her, as he hugged her once and drank wine from a cup she had.

She finally realized she had feelings for Xiao Yan in Chapter 302.

When Cai Lin saw her and Xiao Yan flirting with each other, Cai Lin got jealous and told Xiao Yan why don't you stare at her some more.

She was the second woman to fall in love with Xiao Yan.

characters.history:
Tian Huo Zun Zhe lived in his original body around 500 years ago before perishing and becoming a wandering soul in the magma world.

He was a great prodigy and an elite fighter, capable of creating a Tian-class Dou Technique, reaching the peak of 6-star Dou Zun, and even subduing the Fallen Heart Flame.

At the time of his death, he was in possession of the Fallen Heart Flame, the same flame that was later subdued by Xiao Yan.

His demise occurred when he discovered the core seed of the Fallen Heart Flame in the magma world. While attempting to merge the flames, they violently rejected each other, causing severe injuries. In his weakened state, a fire lizard from the Fire Lizard Race attacked and killed him. In a final effort to preserve himself, he created a small realm-like structure, a space of just a few meters filled with rocks and gravel, where he ultimately sat down and passed away.
characters.trivia: Due to Tian Huo zun-zhe’s soul completely merging with this new body, even the appearance of the body (Yun Shan) had changed. It had turned into one that was similar to Tian Huo zun-zhe’s soul.

characters.title: Yi Chen
characters.introText: Yi Chen was known as the most outstanding disciple of the Profound Sky Sect within a century. Of course, with his current position within the Profound Sky Sect, even some Elders would have to be respectful when facing him. Everyone knew that with this person’s strength and ruthless tactics, he would definitely become the next chief of the Profound Sky Sect. Although there were some other competitors within the sect, no one had ever imagined that the others would truly be able to compete with this person, whose viciousness caused even the chief of the Profound Sky Sect to feel his heart become chilly.
characters.appearance: The person seemed quite young. He was tall with an extremely handsome face that looked like that of a woman. However, there was some violence hidden between his brows. This caused his excellent appearance to possess a darkness.
characters.history:
He had ten years more than Xiao Yan to train. However, the current gap between the two was just this tiny bit. This was a serious blow to Yi Chen, who was usually extremely proud.

Moreover, even with Yi Chen’s talent, he was able to reach the peak of the Dou Zong class at such an age only because of the evil Qi Method of the Profound Sky Sect, relying on swallowing flesh to obtain Dou Qi. Although this method might be strong, it had terrible repercussions. In other words, he had used all of his future life force in order to obtain this current strength. He had thought, that with this strength, he would be all-powerful among those of the same generation. However, Xiao Yan’s sudden appearance told him a cruel reality. He had not obtained the kind of strength he had wanted from what he had paid. His only thought was to kill Xiao Yan.

He came to the Pill Tower for revenge against Xiao Yan for his Chen Tian Nan son's death Chen Tian Nan created a stage to battle Xiao Yan and issued a challenge to him. Xiao Yan appeared and accepted his challenge. Xiao Yan fought against Yi Chen on the stage and stacked 3 seals together (Open Mountain, Sea Flipping and Overturning Land Seals) to create the great God Seal Skill to defeat him. Once he was defeated, Xiao Yan took his storage ring as a reward. After Xiao Yan defeated Yi Chen,  Chen Tian Nan realized he must not let Xiao Yan live and attacked him. Xiao Yan called out his Sky Demon Puppet and it blocked his attack. Little Fairy Doctor and Yao Tian Huo stepped in and Chen Tian Nan realized he didn't have the strength to fight this group. As he was debating what to do Xuan Yi appeared and asked him if this continues he will make an enemy of the Pill Tower. He left, but still threatened Xiao Yan
characters.trivia:
He would never stop a battle with anyone unless he saw blood. Otherwise, the name Demon Yi would really be nothing but child’s play.

In the novel it is never said if he was killed along with all the other members of the Profound Sects.
