characters.appearance:
Within the lake, the back of a lady with a hot figure shot out from the bottom of the lake. With her back facing Xiao Yan, she shook her long hair that was stuck to her snow white shoulders. Drops of water were pasted on her skin which appeared so fragile that it would break when one blew on it. The drops of water followed the contours of her shoulders and slid past her extremely seductive narrow waist and finally fell back into the lake, creating ripples.

Although they were a little far apart, Xiao Yan was still able to clearly see how flexible that tight waist was. It was difficult to imagine just what kind of shocking angles that flexible narrow waist could twist to.

The lady’s narrow hand carelessly seized her long hair and gradually turned around.

As the lady turned her body around, her naked perfect body was instantly exposed to Xiao Yan's vision. The person, who was a still a virgin, immediately felt his blood surging.

The perfect body that appeared to be carved from white jade was like the masterpiece of the heavens. The supple and protruding chest was proudly revealed in the somewhat wet, cool air. Under the faint moonlight, her appearance was both lovely and enchanting. The beautiful rhombus shaped eyes contained traces of passion filled moisture.
characters.personality: Yue Mei is charming and playful towards those that she finds cute and innocent, and plays rough with them.

Her beauty is suppose to be almost on par with Cai Lin. In the Manhua she is portrayed as a beautiful woman, but she is kind of homely in the Donghua, which can't be compared to Cai Lin's exceptional beauty.

characters.introText: Yun Shan was the former leader of the Yun Lan Sect.
characters.appearance:
The white figure wearing an extremely plain, white-colored long robe.

The white figure was wearing an extremely plain, white-colored long robe. The gentle breeze brushed by and his long robes fluttered, giving him a kind of otherworldly and elegant aura. His age did not appear very old and his face did not have the wrinkles that an old man ought to have. Instead, it was like warm jade that was emitting a glow. If it were not for his long hair being snow white, Xiao Yan would really have difficulty thinking of him as a strong person of the same generation as Hai Bodong. However, from the reverence that had appeared on all the faces of the Misty Cloud Sect disciples below, it was clear that this person was the previous Misty Cloud Sect Leader, Yun Shan.

https://battle-through-the-heavens.fandom.com/wiki/File:Yun_Shan_Character_PV.mp4

Yun Shan has white hair with black streaks and purple eyes. In the past he had short black hair and white with a study body.
characters.personality: Yun Shan was initially deemed as a kind and caring man (most notably by Yun Yun; his former student). However following the events of the story, his persona shifted first to someone who instead of prioritizing truth and justice, shifted toward the overall safety and reputation of the Yun Lan sect.
characters.history: Yun Shan was the previous leader of the Misty Cloud Sect who everyone thought was deceased. In fact he had gone into seclusion  to break into the Dou Zong level. He reappeared when Xiao Yan had defeated Nalan Yanran in their 3 year engagement. He was oppressing  Xiao Yan till the Xiao Cai - (Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python) made Medusa  promise to save him and when she agreed Xiao Cai release her and let her talk over their body. Yun Shan allowed her to take Xiao Yan away as he didn't know if he could defeat her.
characters.trivia:
His name means "Clouds and Mountains".

In the manhua, Yun Shan was given a brief history of searching for Cai Lin and falling in love with her. However, the light novel makes no distinction as to this. Similarly, when Medusa reappeared, Yun Shan seemed even wary at her presence in the light novel, suggesting a grudging respect and maybe even fear of her presence.

In the novel, Yun Shan was described to be an old man in contrast to the young handsome appearance he is shown to have in the manhua and donghua.

Xiao Yan uses his corpse to help refine a body for Yao Tian Huo in the light novel.

‘Hall of Souls’ helped him breakthrough to an Dou Zong expert. They also provided his sect with the means to grow their strength rapidly to take over the Jia Ma Empire.

characters.introText: Yun Yun is one of the main female deuteragonist of Battle through the Heavens. She is an ally and second love of Xiao Yan.  She was the leader of the Misty Cloud Sect until it was disbanded by Xiao Yan. She later traveled to the central plains and became the sect leader of the Flower Sect on the insistence of Xiao Yan .
characters.appearance:
The lady in the sky was wearing a tight dress that covered her exquisite frame while wielding a strange looking long sword that was emitting a green colored light. Her black hair was held in place by a noble looking phoenix accessory. The beautiful and moving face of hers was very calm, revealing not the slightest change even when faced with a Magic Beast that was extremely well known in the Dou Qi continent.

On the mysterious woman’s back was a pair of green colored wings that appeared slightly illusionary. Those were likely formed from the amalgamation of her Dou Qi. The transformation of Dou Qi into wings was a symbol of those who were Dou Wang or stronger.

The mysterious woman lightly stood in the sky. Her calm and beautiful face carried a gracefulness and nobility that the simple dress she wore could not hide.

https://battle-through-the-heavens.fandom.com/wiki/File:Yun_Yun_Character_PV.mp4
characters.personality: She has a very serious and stern personality. It has been stated that she has dedicated her entire life to the martial arts and is uninterested in matters such as love and romance. She develops a soft spot for Xiao Yan after their first encounter and fell in love with him.
characters.history: She was the Sect Leader of the Misty Cloud Sect till Yun Shan decided to side with the Hall of Souls and remove her from the position. She gave Nalan Yanran permission to break the marriage engagement with Xiao Yan
characters.trivia:
She fell in love with Xiao Yan and later when she finds out his true identity she can't bring herself to tell Nalan Yanran.

She is the second woman to fall in love with Xiao Yan.

She seems to be unable to take care of someone else.

She is unable to cook or do any chores.

She was called a "cold granny" by Yan Shi this might mean that she is a lot older than she appears.

She lost her first kiss to Xiao Yan and vise versa.

She was the first female to bite Xiao Yan's shoulder.

She was the one who agreed with Nalan Yanran's request to cancel her marriage with Xiao Yan.

She had a complicated relationship with Xiao Yan in the light novel as she almost had sex with him (she put aphrodisiac in their food accidentally). Xiao Yan did lose his first kiss to her.

She left Xiao Yan a Dou Qi Technique and a Dou skill called Exploding Steps after he succumbed to the effects of Amethyst Essence. This technique did not appear in the manhua.

She along with Gu He, Yan Shi, Feng Li and others head into the Tager Desert to get the Heavenly Flame for Gu He. She saves Xiao Yan from being killed by Yue Mei.

After Xiao Yan escapes with the Heavenly Flame, she volunteers to capture him. After meeting him and finding out his identity, she asks him to leave and stays behind to cover his escape. She asks him to join her in Misty Cloud Sect, which Xiao Yan harshly rejects, because of his matters with Nalan YanRan. This causes Yun Yun to become irritated at his behavior.

She is then saved by Yao Lao under the request of Xiao Yan and she is shocked that Xiao Yan is able to make a Dou Huang come to her help and feels that she has underestimated Xiao Yan. Yao Lao also apologizes for Xiao Yan's behavior, which calms Yun Yun.

Xiao Yan only realizes that Yun Zhi is Yun Yun when he returns to the Misty Cloud Sect to kill Yun Leng, and Yun Yun stands before him among the other Misty Cloud Sect Elders.

Yun Yun was instructed by Yun Shan to stop Xiao Yan from unleashing a Angry Buddha Lotus Flame to kill Yun Leng. She is unable to do so as Xiao Yan distracts her long enough to unleash the attack.

During Yun Shan's battle with Xiao Yan, she is stunned on realizing that Nalan Yanran has developed an admiration for Xiao Yan and comforts her. She then allows her to enter the Gate of Life and Death before telling her that she'll have to discuss this with Yun Shan first.

When the Misty Cloud Sect is sent to look for Xiao Yan, Yun Yun is part of the group. After the rest are distracted by Ya Fei's Shadow Guards, she appears in front of Xiao Yan and  she allows him to leave the Jia Ma Empire and tells him to never return, though Xiao Yan states he'll be back for revenge, even though he's not sure when he'll return. He then hugs her, teases her and leaves the Jia Ma Empire, causing Yun Yun to have complicated emotions.

Xiao Yan is the only man who caused her heart to be filled with joy.

After the Misty Cloud Sect was disbanded, they stayed together on a mountain top for 3 days, the author leaves it vague if they slept together.

characters.introText: Zi Yan is one of the main female deuteragonist and a close friend of Xiao Yan. She became friends with him after they meet at the Jia Nan Academy and finding out that he can refine Medicinal Ingredients into Yaowan's. She is very important to Xiao Yan, much like a sister, and he goes all out to protect her.  She is the heir apparent and the future Dragon Emperor of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe as her father was the missing current Dragon Emperor, Zhu Kun. She is a Void Dragon that accidentally ate the Shape-Shifting  Flower that turned her into a human girl. Due to her bloodline, she possesses the ability to find high spiritual magical herbs, has superior spatial ability and deterrence against  beasts.
characters.appearance:
A young girl in white clothes who was level to Xiao Yan's waist. The little girl appeared to be twelve to thirteen years old. Her pale-purple hair was let out to her waist and her face was very soft. The girl’s appearance was beautiful, white, and clear, and her pair of black watery eyes blinked at Xiao Yan. It appeared to have a demonic strength that caused the shock in Xiao Yan’s heart to gradually disappear.

Zi Yan is a magical beast that got turn into a human because she ate the shape-shift flower. Her appearance as human is that of a small young girl with long purple hair and purple eyes. She is able to activate her magical beast wings when she feels like it which are purple and yellow radiant.

The human figure which that had appeared was completely naked. A faint purple glow lingered over her body causing her to appear to possess a magical charm. Long, smooth purple-colored hair scattered down and landed on her lovely protruding buttocks. Which part of her matured body that protruded from the front and the back was a style that the little girl from back then possessed. Looking at the somewhat matured, yet cute appearance, this was surprising the little Zi Yan who had grown big.

The lady who had appeared was wearing a purple-golden robe. A dragon and a phoenix were dancing on the robe. They appeared as though they were alive, emitting a noble aura that could not be hidden. The figure was tall and possessed long purple hair that poured down her body like a waterfall. Her hair spread over her narrow waist and reached her buttocks.

The lady was extremely beautiful. Her purple eyes had transformed into a purple-golden color. They appeared mysterious, containing a magical charm. Under the gaze of these purple-golden eyes, it was as though the entire world would submit to her.

The current Zi Yan no longer possessed the appearance of a little girl. Instead, she had turned into a mature lady, whose beautiful appearance could bring disaster to a country or a city.

Numerous eyes were initially absent-minded because of Zi Yan’s noble aura. Their eyes gathered on the spot behind her. A pair of ten-foot-long purple-golden wings were gently being flapped. Wind was created and the sound of thunder was vaguely emitted when the wings were flapped, shaking one’s very soul.
characters.personality:
She is extremely proud of her ability to find high ranking spiritual herbs and states that she has the right to eat them when she feels like it. She gets agitated and act like a child saying "meanie" when someone is takes something that she believes she deserves. This girl’s boldness was greater than even the Heavens.

After having fully transformed to her mature form, it seemed that her character had become completely different than before. Her indifferent coldness seemed to contain a nobility that was comparable with that of the world. In the face of this aura, even Hei Qing did not dare to treat her as that mischievous little girl from back then. Instead, he regarded her as the new Dragon Emperor of the Ancient Void Dragon tribe.
characters.history:
Zi Yan is part of the royal bloodline of Ancient Void Dragon tribe. Her father was the king of the Ancient Void Dragons back then. He had suddenly gone missing because he was trapped for 10,000 years by Tou She Ancient God as a guardian of Dou Di Mansion. Zi Yan who was with him back then was left behind in wilderness and was only sensed by her tribe when she arrived in the Central Plains.

She accidentally ate a rarely seen ‘Body Transformation Grass’. After which, she turned into human form and can no longer transform back. The reason for her eating medicinal ingredients is to quickly grow up. After which, she will be able to transform between her beast body and human body as she pleases.

Since she has gained consciousness, she has been living alone deep in the mountains. When she was young, she was bullied by the other fellows and could only flee gloomily until she ate the ‘Body Transformation Grass’. It was then that she met the First Elder of the Inner Academy. He brought her to the Inner Academy and she has remained there.

She kicked all the competitors down from the arena during the last ‘Strong Ranking’ Grand Competition.

Zi Yan’s fierce name was something that was extremely feared among these experts on the ‘Strong Ranking’. Back then, there was no shortage of strong and bold people who issued challenges toward her. However, each and every single one of them were violently sent flying like a ball under those delicate and small hands. Finally, they ended up with their bones broken and their tendons injured. Although they fully recovered from their injuries, that kind of frightening scene was enough to cause them to remember it for the rest of their lives.

cultivation.title: Ban Sheng
cultivation.introText: Ban Sheng. This level was called an abyss of despair by many experts at the peak of the Dou Zun class. Most of the experts in this world who had reached the peak of the Dou Zun class ended up halting at the edge of this Ban Sheng class. Regardless of how they trained, they were unable to truly stepped into this so called Ban Sheng class.

cultivation.title: Cai Lin/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: It said that once the Queen Medusa reaches the peak of a Dou Huang, she can undergo a strange evolution if she has sufficiently good luck. The Queen Medusa which has undergone the evolution would not only be able to transform into a human body but her strength would also be promoted into that of a Dou Zong. However, the chances of such evolution succeeding are extremely low. Moreover the most essential thing needed for this evolution is a ‘Heavenly Flame’. However, this evolution is extremely dangerous. If it were not to be done properly, she will be completely incinerated into nothingness by the ‘Heavenly Flame’. But if she were able to withstand it, she will undergo an extremely strange evolution.

cultivation.title: Dou Huang
cultivation.introText: When one reached the Dou Huang class, one could already use the Dou Qi in one’s body to resonate with natural energy during battle. After that, one could control these energies and unleash an incomparably terrifying force. This was also the reason why only Dou Huang possessed a destructive force that horrified people.
cultivation.trivia: The gap between a Dou Wang and a Dou Huang is extremely large. Normally speaking, even if one possessed the strength to breakthrough, one would require half a year or even a year in order to truly be able to undergo the transformation.

cultivation.title: Dou Ling
cultivation.introText: Dou Qi agglomerating into objects, the mark of a Dou Ling. It was a specialized ability of a strong person at the Dou Ling class or above, just like the Dou Qi cloak of a Dou Shi, and the Dou Qi Armor of a Da Dou Shi. The lethality of this kind of Dou Qi agglomerated item would undoubtedly have an extremely powerful effect when used in combination with Dou Techniques.

cultivation.title: Dou Sheng
cultivation.introText: Any experts who reach the Dou Sheng class are basically standing on the peak of the Dou Qi continent. At this level, one would have already surpassed the ordinary and would have stepped into the holy level. The strength that one would possess would naturally be far from what an ordinary person can imagine. Opening a realm where people could live is an indicator of an elite Dou Sheng.

cultivation.title: Dou Shi
cultivation.introText: Manipulating the Dou Qi into an energy cloak that was attached to the body was the mark of a Dou Shi realm. This energy cloak not only strengthened the owner’s defense, speed and attack, it also improved the owner’s absorption of energy from the surrounding area, so that the energy exhausted during a fight would be supplemented. Hence, almost every Dou Shi’s first action during a battle would be to call upon this Dou Qi cloak.

cultivation.title: Dou Techniques
cultivation.introText: One should note that Dou Technique training differed from Dou Qi training. If one were to learn a low Huang level Dou Technique, all that was required was one’s own hard work – grasped simply through trial and error. A mid or even high level technique, however, would require much more: it needed personal instruction from a Clan Technique Instructor.
cultivation.trivia:
The higher the class of the Dou Technique, the higher the difficulty of practicing it would be.

There was only an extremely simple method for the retrieval of a Dou Technique. That was to kill this person. In that case, the Dou Technique that existed within his mind would naturally disappear.

cultivation.title: Dou Wang
cultivation.introText: Dou Qi transformation into wings was basically an extremely symbolical result in the training of Dou Qi. This symbol represented a natural barrier in becoming a strong person on the continent. Everyone clearly knew that as long as one was able to transform Dou Qi into wings, it represented that one would be able to enter into the class that caused countless number of people to halt their progress: Dou Wang! The simple two words were the symbol which countless numbers of talented individuals had trained hard to achieve. However, the hardship that these two words represented caused most of the people to halt their progress before reaching that stage. Finally, these people would quietly withdraw.

cultivation.title: Dou Zhe
cultivation.introText: Dou Zhe and 9 Duan Qi had different natures. The energy assimilated before becoming a Dou Zhe was actually called Dou Zhi Qi; after becoming a Dou Zhe, the assimilated energy was now known as true Dou Qi.

cultivation.title: Dou Zhi Qi
cultivation.introText: Dou Zhi Qi was essential towards being a Dou Zhe. Dou Zhi Qi is split into 10 different stages, and when the body acquires 10 stages of Dou Zhi Qi, it can better condense the Dou Zhi vortex, becoming a well-respected Dou Zhe! The 8th to the 9th Duan Qi is the beginning of Dou Qi bottleneck stage.

cultivation.title: Dou Zong
cultivation.introText: Dou Zong, the true point when one could be considered a genuine expert on the continent. Only by successfully reaching this level would one gain the prerequisite that allowed one to survive in the Central Plains. Walking through the air was a unique indicator of an elite Dou Zong.
cultivation.trivia:
If one did not stake one’s life and engage in a life and death battle in a fight between Dou Zongs, such a battle would be able to last for a very long time. 

A nine star Dou Huang might only have a one star gap with a Dou Zong, but this one star was enough to cause a countless number of outstanding individuals to stop at this level forever, all the way until they die.

cultivation.title: Dou Zun
cultivation.introText: Dou Zun. That was a level that was even further and more frightening than a Dou Zong. At that level, one was already a top person on the continent. Their methods were far from what an elite Dou Zong could compare with.
cultivation.trivia:
Legend had it that only an elite Dou Zun could solidify their Dou Qi.

An elite Dou Zun normally did not fight, but when they do, they would unleash a truly terrifying attack!

cultivation.title: Half Step Dou Di
cultivation.introText: Half Step Dou Di is the level/title of a Dou Sheng who has reached both the peak nine-star of Dou Sheng in Dou Qi and the Di State in soul realm, this being the highest level one can reach on the Dou Qi Continent without becoming a Dou Di.

cultivation.title: Han Feng/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Back then, when he was still Yao Lao's disciple, he had stolen the ‘Flame Mantra’ when Yao Lao was off-guard. However, Yao Lao discovered it while he was practicing. Due to his haste, he could only obtain a portion of ‘Flame Mantra’s’ Qi Method routes.

cultivation.title: Mu Tie/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

cultivation.title: Nine Changes to turn Sheng
cultivation.introText: Nine Changes to turn Sheng (Saint) is the process to advance from from the peak of the Dou Zun class to the Ban Sheng class.

cultivation.title: Wu Hao/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: The thing that Wu Hao is best at is speed. Moreover, he also practices a Xuan Class High Level Agility Dou Technique: ‘Blood Shadow Flash’.

cultivation.title: Xiao Ding/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

cultivation.title: Xiao Li/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

cultivation.title: Xiao Yan/Cultivation
cultivation.introText: Although Xiao Yan had spent an unimaginable amount of effort compared to an ordinary person during his training journey, his journey was still considered smooth sailing. This kind of feeling where one was not even able to advance an inch over decades was something that he had never experienced nor did he wish to experience. Perhaps, this route might be one that many people would have to undergo, but he knew that for him, who was practicing Flame Mantra, his journey to obtain strength would be different from others, similarly, however, this route would also possess a much greater risk than usual training.
cultivation.history: Xiao Yan's Qi Method is Flame Mantra which can evolve and for evolution it needs Heavenly Flames.
cultivation.trivia:
Back when he was four, it took him 6 years to get to 9 Duan Qi/Dou Zhi Qi. Even with his talent, getting to 7 Duan Qi/Dou Zhi Qi in just one year was hopeless.

Even though for the past three years his Dou Qi has always been declining, his foundation in Dou Qi is much firmer than other people. In Dou Qi training, the foundation is the most important!

To gain one Duan Qi in 3 months, although this speed is slower compared to the two months needed for reaching 5 Duan Qi, Xiao Yan was still very satisfied. When he was training before, it took him an entire half year to go from 5 Duan Qi to 6 Duan Qi.

techniques.title: All Day Fire Seal
techniques.introText: It is likely that there are extremely few people who know about this sealing method in this continent. Back then, Tian Huo zun-zhe also possessed a friend with the ‘Woeful Poison Body.’ This sealing method was created for him. Unfortunately, this seal can only be used once and, at the very most, only last three years. Three years later, he still failed to find a method to overcome the ‘Woeful Poison Body’ hence he died. This seal is called the ‘All Day Fire Seal.’ It borrows the positive violence in a fire affinity Qi Method to suppress the poison gas.‘Heavenly Flame’ is able to optimize the effects of the seal.
techniques.trivia: Tian Huo zun-zhe taught this sealing method to Xiao Yan in order to help him suppress Little Fairy Doctor's Woeful Poison Body.

techniques.title: All Sky Fire Seal
techniques.introText: All Sky Fire Seal is a sealing method that can only be used once and, at the very least, only lasts for three years. It uses positive violence in the fire affinity Qi Method to suppress the poisonous gas.
techniques.trivia: Creator: Yao Tian Huo

techniques.title: Ancient Insect Emperor Cloth
techniques.introText: The Ancient Insect Emperor Cloth is a high-level defensive treasure refined from Ancient Devouring Insect.
techniques.appearance:
Its a cluster of black light with a smooth silk-like feeling and was extremely comfortable. When a drop of essence blood on the black light and the clothe immediately wiggled. It appeared like liquid as it moved over users hand and merged with his palm.

After merging with the body it appears as black clothes on the body with an extremely tough feeling.
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Xuan made one for Xiao Yan.

Emperor Cloth that has been refined from an Insect Queen. Its value will not be any less than a Tian class Dou Skill, and it is a rare object that one can only obtain through luck. After all, a powerful existence like the Insect Queen cannot simply be obtained just because one wishes to.

techniques.title: Angry Buddha Lotus Flame
techniques.introText: The Angry Buddha Fire Lotus, often translated as the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, is the signature and most powerful self-created fighting technique of Xiao Yan.
techniques.appearance: A green-white lotus seat the size of Xiao Yan’s palm was Xiao Yan's first Angry Buddha Fire Lotus. Since it always formed after merging different flames so its appearance also varies.
techniques.personality:
(佛怒火莲, Fó Nù Huǒ Lián) - Angry Buddha Fire Lotus

(毁灭火莲) (Huǐ Miè Huǒ Lián) - Annihilation Fire Lotus
techniques.trivia:
Creator - Xiao Yan

The Angry Buddha Fire Lotus is a product of forcibly compressed two or more Heavenly Flames to create an instant, devastating, highly unstable bomb for a single attack. It is entirely different from the permanent merged Heavenly Flames, Xiao Yan uses his cultivation method, Flame Mantra, to gradually absorb, refine, and merge two or more flames into a new, single, stable, superior, and permanent flame.

In Heavenly Silkworms Potato new novel  Shen tong zhe  main character Lu Ming obtain a black ring from his ancestor treasure inside that ring there was four things  Angry Buddha Lotus flame , Life spirit flame , Pure Lotus Demon Flame ,Nihility devouring flame . It still unknown how lu Ming ancestor found xiao yan ring .

techniques.title: Angry Buddha Reincarnation
techniques.introText: Angry Buddha Reincarnation is Middle Level Tian class Dou Technique that Xiao Yan created himself after breaking through to Dou Sheng.
techniques.appearance:
Four types of flames suddenly erupted from Xiao Yan’s hand after his indifferent voice sounded. They began to rotate in a crazy manner. Within the blink of an eye, they had turned into a four colored thousand feet large strange ring. The ring continued to rotate. The interior of the ring was black. This kind of black was even purer than the spatial black holes. It was a kind of reincarnation feeling! With the command of "rotate" a beam of black shot out of the center and anything caught in its path was annihilated to the point that the soul would not reincarnate.

Angry Buddha Reincarnation, Bind of Reincarnation, Fallen Reincarnation

Angry Buddha Reincarnation, Bind of Reincarnation, Fallen Reincarnation

Angry Buddha Reincarnation, Fallen Reincarnation

Angry Buddha Reincarnation absorbing enemies power to counter attack

Angry Buddha Reincarnation
techniques.trivia:
Chinese & Pinyin: 怒佛轮回  - Fó Nù Lúnhuí

This Skill Is At Least Comparable To A Middle Level Tian Class (Heaven-Tier) Dou Technique, surpassing even the most powerful Earth-Tier techniques.

In Donghua, this skill can be used in both offensive and defensive modes, and is capable of countering the opponent's attacks. In addition, this technique is a form of Dou Sheng accessory that appears behind his back.

techniques.title: Annihilation Fire Lotus
techniques.introText: Annihilation Fire Lotus. Angry Buddha Lotus Flame combining four different true heavenly flames Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Bone Chilling Flame and Three Thousand Burning Flame.
techniques.history:
The core of the lotus was made up of four colours. At a glance, it appeared incomparably beautiful. However, under this beautiful surface hid a annihilation like terrifying strength. An earthshaking loud sound suddenly resounded over the place when the fire lotus left Xiao Yan’s hand. At this moment, a annihilation like strength swept out like a storm in the sky. The entire mountain range trembled like an earthquake at this moment. Numerous enormous crack lines spread in all directions with the valley at its center. That large hall also began to sway unsteadily under this trembling. The destructive ripple continued to spread for nearly a thousand meters. Everything was red within a thousand meter radius. The dense forest was also destroyed. As a Dou Zong, Xiao Yan could seriously injure Dou Zun.

He used this while fighting with Hall of Souls while rescuing Yao Chen against Zhai Xing. He later unleashed it again during his battle with the Northern Dragon King in the civil war of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.

Xiao Yan using Annihilation Fire Lotus against Northern Dragon King

Xiao Yan using Annihilation Fire Lotus against Zhai Xing
techniques.trivia:
毁灭火莲 (Huǐmiè Huǒlián) - Annihilation Fire Lotus

Creator - Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Axe Splitting World
techniques.introText: Axe Splitting World can be considered as Low Level Di Class Dou Technique used by Dou Zun experts on the second floor of the Heavenly Tomb.
techniques.appearance:
Axe Splitting World is a Dou Technique which was used by an energy body(referred as the black armor energy body), which was the remains of a nine star Dou Zun expert who ruled quite a bit of territory on the second floor of the Heavenly Tomb.

This Technique is quite good reaching the probable strength of low level Di class Dou Technique or even a middle Level Di class Dou Technique

Even when the remains of that elite used this Technique a vast and mighty energy continuously surged out of the black-armored body. The enormous mountain-splitting axe suddenly swelled at this moment. The enormous axe was lifted high in the air, and the surrounding space collapsed at this moment, it can be considered as the killing move of that elite.

Axe Splitting World

techniques.title: Bat Duck Dodging Fire Steps
techniques.introText: Bat Duck Dodging Fire Steps is a middle level Di class Dou Technique. The name of this agility Dou Technique lacked ornamental value, just like the way it was used. This Bat Duck Dodging Fire Steps also have a matching Qi Method known as Fire Bat Method.

techniques.title: Black Collapsing Force
techniques.introText: Black Collapsing Force is a Dou Technique unleased during Pure Lotus Demon Flame arc while snatching the Demon Flame.
techniques.appearance: This Dou Technique was used during the battle between Hun Feng and Xiao Yan, alongside God Seal Skill Four Seal merger, Flame Splitting Tsunami, Splitting Wind Tiger Roar Palm, and this Black Collapsing Force all together.
techniques.history:
Many extremely powerful Dou Skills were unceremoniously sent flying toward Hun Feng. Although Hun Feng was only an advanced two star Dou Sheng, this fellow was even more dangerous than the deputy chief of the Hall of Souls in Xiao Yan’s eyes.

“Flame Splitting Tsunami!”
“God Seal Skill! Four Seal merger!”
“Bang bang!
“Splitting Wind Tiger Roar Palm!”
“Black Collapsing Force!”

Hun Feng did not feel the slightest fear when these sharp attacks erupted from Xiao Yan at this moment. Not only did he not withdraw, he instead unleashed the Dou Qi within his body to its limits. Many extremely powerful high class Dou Skills were unleashed. They spread with shocking speed. In an instant, energy erupted in the sky, and the earth-shaking Dou Skills caused many to be quietly shocked.
techniques.trivia:
In novel, it is mentioned that these sharp attacks erupted from Xiao Yan, but Xiao Yan never obtained or use this technique before.

In donghua, Hun Feng was the one who use this type of attack against Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Black Dragon
techniques.introText: Black Dragon is probably Di Class high-level Dou Technique of Ice River Valley.
techniques.appearance:
Black Dragon is the twin Black Ice Dragon technique unleashed by the Ice River Valley Chief, Bing Zun-zhe, when facing Yao Tian Huo, Little Fairy Doctor and Xiao Yan.

Black Dragon attack by Bing He (Ice River Valley Chief)

Black Dragon attack by Bing He (Ice River Valley Chief)

techniques.title: Black Ice Spear
techniques.introText: Black Ice Spear (unofficial name) refers to a technique used by Bing He where he forms multiple long spears from black ice and launches them at his opponent. The novel does not provide an official name for this technique.
techniques.appearance: It is described as multiple long spears made from black ice which are sharp and capable of piercing forcefully through the air.
techniques.history:
Bing He uses this attack during his confrontation with the elder of Gu Clan. The ice spears are launched rapidly toward the elder but are blocked by a mud wall formed from deep-yellow Dou Qi.

Black Ice Spear Video
techniques.trivia: No official technique name is mentioned in the chapter.

techniques.title: Blade Web
techniques.introText: Blade Web is a defensive Wind-affinity Dou Technique used by Lin Xiuya during his brief spar with Xiao Yan.
techniques.appearance:
Blade Net is a defensive Dou Technique that rapidly condenses dark green wind attributed Dou Qi into a web like structure in front of the user. The web is composed of numerous tiny wind blades creating a cutting barrier capable of intercepting incoming attacks. The technique is formed by quickly creating a hand seal, causing energy to ripple and agglomerate into a defensive structure.

Lin Xiuya displayed his extraordinary fighting experience at this critical moment. He formed a seal in his hand and the energy in front of him rippled swiftly. Finally, it agglomerated into a dark-green energy web. This energy web which was covered with tiny wind blades.
techniques.history:
Blade Net was used by Lin Xiuya during a public sparring match against Xiao Yan in the Inner Academy, shortly after Xiao Yan’s escaped through Blazing Sky Qi Refining Tower. When Xiao Yan suddenly appeared in front of him with overwhelming speed and extended a flame covered hand toward his neck, Lin Xiuya reacted instantly by forming the Blade Net as a defensive countermeasure. Despite his quick response, the technique was effortlessly destroyed by Xiao Yan’s dark-green flame, which burned through the wind blade web like weak thin paper. Xiao Yan’s hand then stopped just half an inch from Lin Xiuya’s neck, ending the exchange in a single move.

Lin Xiuya uses Blade Web in defense of Xiao Yan's green-flame
techniques.trivia: During spar with Xiao Yan being burned by that dark-green flame (Glazed Lotus Heart Flame), the sharp wind blade web immediately became like weak thin paper as it tore through it.

techniques.title: Blood Blade Chaotic Wind Tear
techniques.introText: Blood Blade Chaotic Wind Tear is a Di class Dou Technique of middle or high tier. It was used by Saint Xue Dao against Xiao Yan and Gu Qing Yang's group using his scimitar.

techniques.title: Blood Demon Robe
techniques.introText: Blood Demon Robe is a defensive technique used by the Fourth Tianzun that forms a thick blood cuticle over the user’s body to block incoming attacks.
techniques.appearance: Upon activation, blood flows from his pores and rapidly forms a thick cuticle layer that covers his body. This blood formed armor serves as a protective barrier against incoming attacks.
techniques.history: When Xiao Yan suddenly appeared behind the Fourth Tianzun and unleashed the Great Heaven Creation Palm. Shocked by the sneak attack, the Fourth Tianzun immediately activated Blood Demon Robe to defend himself. Blood immediately formed a thick cuticle around his body to defend against the attack. Although the blood cuticle absorbed part of the attack, it cracked under the force of Xiao Yan’s strike. The remnant force still injured the Fourth Tianzun, causing him to spit blood and be forced backward.
techniques.trivia:
Even with this technique, the Fourth Tianzun was unable to completely withstand a Tian class low-level Dou Technique.

This Dou Technique wasn't shown in Donghua.

techniques.title: Blood Di Body
techniques.introText: Blood Di Body is a special physique a only a Dou Di can create and only if He or She practice Blood affinity arts.
techniques.appearance:
This body was created by Hun Tiandi after he ascended to the Dou Di class according to Gu Yuan and the other elites of the ancient clan they were naturally aware that an elite Dou Qi could incorporate the world in their bodies. At that time, they would be the world. Just the lift of a hand could destroy the universe. Its might was extremely great and terrifying!.

When Hun Tiandi uses this technique the blood cloud, which spread over the sky, was swallowed by Hun Tiandi, the latter’s body swelled. Within a short instant, it had turned into a hundred thousand feet large blood coloured giant. Blood light rapidly gathered on his body. Finally, it turned into a layer of blood armor that surrounded the hundred thousand feet large body. The blood giant stood in the sky and covered it. In the face of the terrifying visual assault, no one suspected that this punch of Hun Tiandi would be able to turn the area within tens of thousands of kilometers into a deep gully!

This huge body was not formed from energy. Instead, it was a firm actual body. One could just imagine how terrifying the aura of a hundred thousand feet body was. This ability was referred to by others as the Dou Di Body, as it could only be used after reaching the Dou Di class.
techniques.trivia: This technique is Hun Tiandi's final card.

techniques.title: Blood Dragon
techniques.introText: Blood Dragon is a Dou Technique of the Hall of Souls, its a technique of Di class middle level or Di class high level.
techniques.appearance:
When used, a blood colored dragon appears and releases a terrifying dragon roar that can be heard from far away and then it rushes towards the enemy and collides with him / her and then a rich blood-colored light explodes in the sky and then the spreading blood light starts to bloom in the sky like a blood-colored sun.

This Technique when mastered could easily kill a six star Dou Zun without much problem.

techniques.title: Blood Dragon, Devour The Sky
techniques.introText: Blood Dragon, Devour The Sky is one of the strongest and also one of the most unorthodox and bloody technique that the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe posses.
techniques.appearance:
The summoned blood dragon is an incomparably large creature, described as being larger than the entire dragon island.

Its enormous body is a bright red, energized by a churning blood formation. Its huge dragon scales flicked with a chilling luster, giving the creature a life-like appearance, and its massive eyes contain an endless bloody aura.
techniques.history:
The huge blood formation suddenly churned after the northern dragon king’s cry sounded. An immeasurable amount of bloody Dou Qi gathered in the air above the northern dragon king. It vaguely formed a savage blood dragon that was larger than the entire dragon island. A voice filled with a violent and murderous desire slowly rang out.

Many ancient dragon figures exploded within the dragon island after the bloody Dou Qi gathered. They turned into blood fog that was absorbed into the blood dragon, causing its body to grow a brighter red.

Blood Dragon, Devour The Sky Donghua Video
techniques.trivia:
The Northern Dragon King used this technique to attempt to kill Xiao Yan, but failed due to Xiao Yan possessing the Pure Lotus Demon Flame.

Blood Dragon Devour The Sky can be considered the ultimate skill of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.

techniques.title: Blood Explosion
techniques.introText: Blood Explosion is a blood-based Dou Skill used by Yi Chen that triggers violent fluctuations in an opponent’s blood, causing it to boil and attempt to burst from the body.
techniques.appearance: Blood Explosion releases a dense blood glow from the user’s palm creating a strange ripple that spreads rapidly. Once it wraps around the opponent, it affects the blood inside their body making it feel as though it is boiling and about to break through blood vessels. It is an unusual and sinister technique.
techniques.history:
Yi Chen used Blood Explosion after failing to injure Xiao Yan. When used a dense blood glow erupted from his palm and an unusual ripple spread instantly, wrapping around Xiao Yan.
Xiao Yan felt his blood begin to boil with the intention of bursting his vessels. However, he used the Three Thousand Lotus Heart Flame to protect himself which scattered the strange fluctuation upon contact.

Blood Explosion Video (Donghua)
techniques.trivia:
This technique directly targets the opponent’s blood.

Although being an unusual technique, it was completely neutralized by Xiao Yan’s Heavenly Flame.

techniques.title: Blood Lightning Seal
techniques.introText: Blood Lighting Seal is seal Dou Techniques of the Wind Lightning Pavilion is used for tracking. Members of the Wind Lightning Pavilion will be able to find you no matter where you run go.

techniques.title: Blood Sea
techniques.introText: This sea of blood attack of Fan lao was his signature technique that he had been relieing on to dominate the ‘Black-Corner Region’ and also making him a renowned powerhouse . Once it was activated, it was able to hide his body. While being in it, his Dou Qi recovery and other aspects attained great enhancements. Back then, many experts were helplessly defeated when faced with this blood sea. However, this blood sea was just like a mouse that had seen a cat when it met Xiao Yan, who controlled a ‘Heavenly Flame’. It did not have the slightest ability to resist. Although Fan Lao was also an elite Dou Huang, the fighting strength that he could unleash against Xiao Yan was likely only similar to that of an ordinary Dou Wang. It must be said that there was always something that could restrain another thing.

techniques.title: Blood Shadow Flash
techniques.introText: Xuan Class High Level Agility Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Blood Splitting Chop
techniques.introText: Blood Splitting Chop is Wu Hao's most powerful Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Blood Transforming Grand Skill
techniques.introText: This Blood Transforming Grand Skill was a Tian class Dou Skill. Even some elite Ban Shengs would be affected by it, causing them to split their attention to suppress it.

techniques.title: Bloody Evil Sky Demon Palm
techniques.introText: This a Dou Technique that is used by the Hall of Souls, its at least a Di class High level Technique and is extremely frightening to see.

techniques.title: Bloody Ground Eight Split
techniques.introText: Bloody Ground Eight Split is a Middle Level Xuan Class Spear Dou Technique used by Bai Cheng.
techniques.trivia: He used it as a killer move in the second fight against Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Bone Corroding Round Dagger Dance
techniques.introText: Bone Corroding Round Dagger Dance is one of the treasured as well as strongest technique the Yellow Spring Pavilion has under its possession.
techniques.history:
When Wang Chen used this technique against Xiao Yan Considering his speed was also much faster compared to before releasing his full aura . In a flash, he appeared in front of Xiao Yan. The two daggers in his hands transformed into countless number of black glows that even caused numerous scars to appear in the air. The angle of the daggers’ dance was extremely strange. They had basically permeated all around Xiao Yan. Those black glows even contained waves of chillness that drilled into his heart.

Xiao Yan’s eyes coagulated. This Wang Chen was definitely using a kind of high class Dou Skill. Moreover, it was likely that its level was quite high… this Yellow Spring Pavilion really lived up to its reputation of being one of the four pavilions that coexisted.

Bone Corroding Round Dagger Dance used by Wang Chen against Xiao Yan

Bone Corroding Round Dagger Dance displayed by Wang Chen

techniques.title: Bone Emperor Blade
techniques.introText: Bone Emperor Blade is a dark, soul-infused sword used by Hall of Soul's First Tianzun.
techniques.appearance:
Bone Emperor Blade is a very rare treasure that the Hall Of Souls posses. Its an enormous blade weapon of milky white color. It gives off a stench of murderous aura; This due to this blade being made from Unorthodox actions where Tens of Thousands of people's bones gets forcefully forged into a sword.

This sword can't be mastered easily as a person may spent their entire life trying to understand it but may fail but ones a person masters this sword he/she may become terrifying existence overnight as this blade also helps the its user with many different ability with them being.
techniques.trivia:
It was destroyed when the First Tianzun fought against Xiao Yan.

Its abilities can only be used if the person has the Bone Emperor Blade

This Bone Emperor Blade Skill Is At Least A Tian Class Dou Technique

Man and Blade Merger - It allows the user and the Blade to become one.

It has the ability to injure one’s soul

Able to use Two Dou Skill of at least Di Class High Level or even Tian Class Low Level which were called - Bone Emperor Piercing Sky :  This allows a huge blade to appear and Split the sky and enemies in two.

Lastly was a Secret Technique which allows the user to raise there strength called body blade merger when used Countless tiny blood scars slowly spread over the blade, appearing as though they were densely packed blood vessels

techniques.title: Bone Emperor Piercing Sky
techniques.introText: Bone Emperor Piercing Sky is a high-level Dou Techniques of the Hall of Souls.
techniques.appearance:
When unleased the surrounding space had suddenly been filled by many sharp white bones that were piercing with lightning-like speed and a terrifying temperature melted those piercing bones in an instant. The piercing bones scattered and an unusually cold cry suddenly sounded. An enormous bone blade that contained a strange aura broke through the empty space.

It is a spiritual attack in the shape of a giant bone blade. This bone blade was created from the bones of tens of thousands of people. There are many unknown spiritual blades contained within it. Once this blade invades one’s body, one will suffer the bitterness of being devoured by tens of thousands of souls.

Bone Emperor Piercing Sky Video
techniques.trivia:
While the attack is frightening, Xiao Yan dismisses the initial shard phase as "child's play" because his Heavenly Flames possess a naturally high temperature that melts the bones instantly.

He only takes it seriously once the spiritual fluctuation of the large blade is revealed. Unlike standard physical attacks, this technique incorporates Spiritual Strength.

The weapon summoned by this technique (Bone Emperor Blade), is not made of ordinary bone. The First Tianzun reveals that it is a "living" weapon made from the remains of tens of thousands of people, making it a dark, unorthodox skill.

It can be compared to Low/Middle level Tian Class Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Sky Bird Nine Flying Wings
techniques.introText: A flying Dou Technique manufacturing method which was used in crafting Xiao Yan's Bone Wings.
techniques.appearance: gem-like white bone wings
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Yan obtained Sky Bird Nine Flying Wings from the sect leader of the Gold Geese Sect.

In Donghua, they are called Bone Wings.

techniques.title: Burning Flame Blazing Sky
techniques.introText: Burning Flame Blazing Sky is one of the strongest Dou Techniques of the Yan Clan.
techniques.trivia: Yan Jin tried to use this technique with the help of Lei Ying to forcefully collapse the space tunnel made by the Nihility Devouring Flame.

techniques.title: Circular Cold Spinning Rod!
techniques.introText: Circular Cold Spinning Rod is a Cold  Dou Techniques of Luo Hou.

techniques.title: Colorful Phoenix Domination
techniques.introText: Colorful Phoenix Domination is one of the signature, high-tier Dou Technique of Wind Lightning Pavilion to manipulate Dou Qi into silk ribbons, a massive energy construct to suppress and shred opponents.
techniques.appearance:
The colorful cloth had just been torn apart when a clear cry suddenly sounded. Immediately, one could hear a repeated ‘swoosh swoosh’ sound as numerous colorful clothes continuously shot out of the storm. After which, they swept toward enemy from all directions.

The colorful cloths poured down like rain from all directions, immediately striking enemy defence, which were over ten feet wide. Immediately, the countless number of colorful cloths, that permeated the sky, suddenly entangled together.

The colorful cloth contained an extremely great strength. Although they would be blocked by the defenses each time, its strength still formed numerous cracks on the silver wood ground Xiao Yan was standing on. Both of Xiao Yan’s feet were repeatedly shaken until they sank into the silver wood.

Colorful Phoenix Domination displayed by Feng Qing Er against Xiao Yan

Colorful Phoenix Domination
techniques.trivia: It can be considered as Low/Middle Level Di Class Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Corpse Eating Hand
techniques.introText: Corpse Eating hand is one of the Dou Techniques of the Yellow Spring Pavilion.

techniques.title: Dancing Wind Blade
techniques.introText: After releasing a deep breath, the scimitar in Mu She’s hand suddenly began to dance crazily. Numerous green colored shadows of the scimitar continued to appear in front of him. In the eyes of others, it was as though Mu She had formed a web of knives.

techniques.title: Darkness Skeleton King
techniques.introText: This black skeleton was a rare Tian class low grade Dou Skill. One would be able to use one’s Dou Qi and the surrounding energy to form a skeleton king after mastering it. This skeleton king was as hard as metal and was immune to fire and water. Moreover, each and every part of its body contained an extremely dark and cold energy. If an ordinary expert were to be struck by this darkness, that expert’s body might look fine, but their soul would be eroded. Hence, this thing could be considered quite sinister and vicious.

techniques.title: Death God Finger
techniques.introText: Death God Finger is one of the strongest Dou Techniques that the Hun Clan has under its possession and this technique is only practiced by the top elites of the clan.
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan had to use the combination of King Kong Glass Body and Extermination Fire Body to counter this attack.

techniques.title: Death Tomb
techniques.introText: Death Tomb is one of the strongest Defensive Dou Techniques used by the elites of the Hun Clan.
techniques.trivia: Hun Yuantian used this technique against Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Deathly Silence Gate
techniques.introText: This Deathly Silence Gate was created from an elite Dou Di from the ancient times. It is able to devour everything! This Deathly Silence Gate was extremely strange. This was because this was completely different from an ordinary Dou Skill. It was not even possible to classify it as a kind of Dou Skill. Instead, it was more appropriate to describe it as a kind of realm being created through one’s training.

techniques.title: Demon Phoenix Bell
techniques.introText: It is rumored that this Demon Phoenix Bell is a Dou Technique passed down in the Demon Phoenix Tribe since ancient times. It was created by an ancestor of the Heaven Demon Phoenix whose strength had reached the Dou Sheng class. Its defensive strength is incomparably frightening. Moreover, it could be used to unleash an extremely sharp sonic wave attack. It possesses both offensive and defensive capabilities, and it is extremely troublesome to deal with… it is the skill the Heaven Demon Phoenix tribe specialize in. There are few in the same class who can break it.
techniques.appearance: This bell was extremely huge. It was pitch black in color and crafted on the surface of the enormous bell was a flying black phoenix with its wings spread. An unusual black flame repeatedly curled and rose from its body. This enormous bell was a little strange. Clearly, it was agglomerated from energy, but it seemed even more real than something with substance. Even the dark light lingering on it was similar to an actual substance.

techniques.title: Demon Phoenix Holy Statue
techniques.introText: Demon Phoenix Holy Statue is the strongest Dou Technique found in the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe and is used by there strongest members.
techniques.appearance:
This technique can easily be classified as a Tian class Dou Technique which forces there bloodline to its maximum strength, thus making it used or seen very rarely and only used if the tribe member is going all out in a life or death battle against an enemy making it there last option in battle. Even the other two top tribes of the beast region are terrified of this technique.

When used, the sky gets shrouded in darkness as the dark clouds formed and allows the tribe members body to swiftly began to transform. A golden light gets shot out and a ten-thousand-foot-large Demon Phoenix will appeared in this world and blotted out the sun this allows the user to turn in its original body.

After the transformation is complete The wings of the Heaven Demon Phoenix will be like metal. The actual form of the user could remain perfectly fine even if he/she were to forcefully received the attack from a three or even four star Dou Sheng. Adding to there terrifying speed, he was just like a slaughtering machine. Anything would shatter with a flap of his wings.

Ones used their offensive strike did not require one to use any Dou Skill. The body of the user was a frightening Dou Skill! Those who touched it would die! Even an elite Dou Sheng’s body would be turn into a bloody mist if one were struck by it.
techniques.trivia: This offensive strike did not require one to use any Dou Skill, it can made the body of user into a frightening Dou Skill.

techniques.title: Demon Phoenix Steps
techniques.introText: Demon Phoenix Steps is a agility Dou Technique of Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
It is one of the strongest techniques found in Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe, helping them push there speed to the limit, and is one of the reason which made them famous.  This agility technique is far superior to the  Three Thousand Lightning Movement used by Xiao Yan.  If one does not posses incredible Soul perception they can't even retaliate against this technique making them sitting ducks.

When utilized, Many golden after-images continued to appear around Xiao Yan in the sky. A densely-packed sharp fist wind covered every single part of opponent's body. Those frightening fist winds had shattered the space within a thousand feet into pieces. These fist shadows might appear like illusions, but they would become real in an instant if they landed on one’s body. They appeared strange and unfathomable.

Huang Tian using Demon Phoenix Steps

Demon Phoenix Step
techniques.trivia:
The Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe specializes in speed, and because of this technique, even an elite six star Dou Sheng would not be able to catch up with him.

Huang Tian almost managed to overwhelm Xiao Yan with help of this technique.

Xiao Yan is able to see through the technique because his Perfect Heavenly State Soul and strong Spiritual Perception.

techniques.title: Demon Snake Sky Explosion
techniques.introText: Demon Snake Sky Explosion is one of the strongest Dou Technique used by the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
Demon Snake Sky Explosion is at least Di Class High Tier or Middle Tier Dou Technique. This technique allows the user to self destruct there body while preserving there soul making this technique used by them as there last ditch effort, it is also quiet useful as it allows them escape tricky situation with a chance to live as well heavenly damage there enemies.

When a person uses this Dou Technique they abandoned there physical body and hide there monster core in an avatar/soul.

There is major drawback of this technique because after the person uses this technique his strength falls so much that a Ban Sheng or even a Dou Sheng may become mere Dou Zun's. It is the self destruct skill of Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe

techniques.title: Demonic Flame Divine Statue
techniques.introText: Demonic Flame Divine Statue is one of the Dou Technique that the Pure Lotus Demon Flame learned from the inheritance it obtained from the Pure Lotus Demon Saint. Very few Techniques can be compared to it in its domain.
techniques.appearance:
The Demonic Flame Divine Statue is formed by condensing the surrounding cream-white demonic flames into a colossal fire giant. The Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame stands atop the statue, directly controlling it in battle. It's incomparably large body will cause one’s soul to tremble with a punch from this giant even an elite Dou Sheng would likely be shattered into nothing.

Demonic Flame Divine Statue

Demonic Flame Divine Statue (Video)

Demonic Flame Divine Statue (Video)

Demonic Flame Divine Statue (Video)

Demonic Flame Divine Statue (Video)
techniques.history:
During the battle with the ancestor of the Pill Tower, the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame gathered all nearby flames to form a hundred thousand foot tall fire giant, its legs rooted in the magma sea. From above, the flame controlled the statue and launched a massive punch that created a huge magma spiral and violently cracked the surrounding space.
Even with its overwhelming power, the statue was severely damaged when the ancestor of the Pill Tower countered it with Pill Merging Sky attack, melting over half of its body.

techniques.title: Demonic Flame Refining Heaven
techniques.introText: Demonic Flame Refining Heaven is a dou technique used by the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame to trap and eliminate intruders.
techniques.appearance:
The technique begins with a fierce cream-white flame erupting from the lotus flame's body, which rapidly expands to envelop the entire area. It manifests as four enormous cream-white fire curtains that pour down from the sky and connect with the sea of magma below. From a distance, it appears as a massive "cube prison" that physically connects the sky and the land, effectively sealing the battlefield.

It generates a terrifyingly high temperature that causes even high-level experts (Dou Shengs) to experience grave concern and visible physical distress. Yao Lao remarked, the ultimate purpose of the technique is to refine everyone trapped inside either vaporizing them or preparing them to become fire slaves.
techniques.history:
Once unleased many figures explode into clusters of blood fog. The blood fog had just appeared when it was vaporized by that frighteningly high temperature. These sudden deaths from the explosion of one’s body immediately caused many people to panic. More and more figures exploded out of the blue as everyone began to feel a more panicked. The deep bangs caused one’s scalp to turn numb. This method of killing really left no traces.

The flame uses a target's own emotions as a fuel source to burn their body from the inside out. Those who cannot maintain a calm mind or suppress random thoughts spontaneously explode into blood fog, which is then immediately vaporized. Pure Lotus Demon Flame commands those below the Dou Sheng class to explode in flames, causing 80% of the elite Dou Zuns present to explode instantly.
techniques.trivia:
The Pure Lotus Demon Flame learned this technique from the inheritance of the Pure Lotus Demon Saint. Its one of the strongest technique it can perform.

This technique's grade is unknown but can easily be classified as Tian Class Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Demonic Flame World Destruction
techniques.introText: Demonic Flame World Destruction is one of the killer moves of Pure Lotus Demon Flame which it learned from the inheritance of Pure Lotus Demon Saint.

techniques.title: Dense Net Great Star Hand
techniques.introText: Dense Net Great Star Hand is Di class Dou technique used by Hall of Souls.
techniques.appearance:
After targeting the enemy Zhai Xing would clench his arm violently and then One could see the space wiggled rapidly. It transformed into a large star hand that was covered with countless number of light spots. It grabbed violently towards Xiao Yan. Space collapsed wherever the large hand passed, revealing a dark black empty hole.

Cosmic Great Star Hand Video

Cosmic Great Star Hand Video

Cosmic Great Star Hand Video
techniques.trivia:
In Donghua, it is called 'All Of Nature Destruction Palm' or 'Cosmic Great Star Hand'.

Its strength was shown to be comparable to a four-stacked use of the God Seal Technique, consisting of the following seals:

Open Mountain Seal

Sea Flipping Seal

Overturning Land Seal

Sky Burying Seal

techniques.title: Descending Flame Mysterious Finger
techniques.introText: Descending Flame Mysterious Finger is a rare Tian Class Dou Technique found in the Yan Clan and can be compared to the Lei Clan's Lightning Calamity Palm.

techniques.title: Di Pill Palm
techniques.introText: Di Pill Palm is the strongest technique used by the Embryonic Tier Di pill. This Technique can only be used by a very powerful Medicinal Pill who has been able to form a consciousness and has human level intelligence.

techniques.title: Dominating Fire Demon Palm
techniques.introText: Dominating Fire Demon Palm is a top Dou Technique of the Burning Flame Valley.

techniques.title: Dou Qi Method Vs Dou Qi skills
techniques.introText: Dou Qi skills – These are the combat skill that are learned by Dou Zhe. Dou Qi skills are as important as the Dou Qi Method without the limitation of just one. It is little less risky when you choose a dou skill to learn because you can have many others. Some Dou Qi skills that Xiao Yan uses are Octane Blast, Vacuum Hand and Three Thousand Lightning Movement.

techniques.title: Dou Qi Wings
techniques.introText: Dou Qi Wings are projections of Dou Qi to form a pair of energy wings on one’s back, used by fighters that reached Dou Wang or Dou Huang. These wings would enable them to overcome their bond to the ground and fly amongst the clouds.
techniques.trivia: Merger of Dou Qi Wings and Eagle Wings:  Once one’s strength had reached the Dou Wang class, one would be able to superimpose the two kinds of wings together. The speed that this kind of superimposition could produce naturally far exceeded that of an ordinary pair of Dou Qi wings. The only disadvantage was that it consumed quite a lot of Dou Qi.

techniques.title: Dou Techniques
techniques.introText: One should note that Dou Technique training differed from Dou Qi training. If one were to learn a low Huang level Dou Technique, all that was required was one’s own hard work – grasped simply through trial and error. A mid or even high level technique, however, would require much more: it needed personal instruction from a Clan Technique Instructor.
techniques.trivia:
The higher the class of the Dou Technique, the higher the difficulty of practicing it would be.

There was only an extremely simple method for the retrieval of a Dou Technique. That was to kill this person. In that case, the Dou Technique that existed within his mind would naturally disappear.

techniques.title: Dragon Emperor Bell
techniques.introText: Dragon Emperor bell can be considered as Di Class High Level Dou Technique used by elites of Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
Dragon Emperor Bell is one strongest Defensive Dou Technique which is used by the elites of Ancient Void Dragon Tribe. This Technique is at least of Di Class High level but can be even more.

When used golden blood swiftly spread around the user and in front of the of them turns into a hundred-foot-tall golden bell covering there entire body. The Western Dragon King and Southern Dragon King used this technique to protect themselves from Zi Yan's Dragon Slaying Sword but were unsuccessful.

Dragon Emperor Bell used by Western and Southern Dragon King
techniques.trivia: By drawing upon the Power of the Dragon Emperor contained within the blood of the body, one summons a golden giant bell dozens of feet high to envelop themselves within, using it to defend against fierce attacks.

techniques.title: Dragon Slaying Sword
techniques.introText: Dragon Slaying Sword is an Dou Skill owned by Ancient Void Dragon Tribe, which could only be unleashed by purest royal bloodline.
techniques.appearance:
The Dragon Slaying Sword was not a weapon. Instead, it was an extremely powerful Dou Skill owned by the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe. This Dou Skill could only be unleashed by the Ancient Dragon that possessed the purest royal bloodline. Even the three great dragon kings were unable to use it, but none of them had ever expected the current Zi Yan to be able to summon it. It should be known that even the last Dragon Emperor had to reach the strength of a six star Dou Sheng before being able to barely summon the Dragon Slaying Sword. However, Zi Yan was only at the initial four star Dou Sheng class!

The Dragon Slaying Sword, as its name suggest, was specifically used to slay dragons. This could be considered a technique that only belonged to the Dragon Emperor. Unless one’s strength far surpassed the Ancient Dragon wielding the Dragon Slaying Sword, the Ancient Dragon would be as weak as bean curd under the sword.

Dragon Slaying Sword unleased by Zi Yan

Zi Yan slaying Dragon Kings with Dragon Slaying Sword
techniques.trivia:
During the battle, Dragon Slaying Sword unleashed by Zi Yan was immature and it began to exhaust Zi Yan’s lifeforce, causing a lock of her hair to turn grayish-white and making her vomit dark-golden blood.

Northern Dragon King was able to forge a fake Dragon Slaying Sword, after activating the Dragon Transforming Demon Formation and devouring the Western Dragon King, Southern Dragon King and numerous tribe members.

techniques.title: Dragon Snake Footwork
techniques.introText: Dragon Snake Footwork is a Middle Level Di Class Dou Skill of Gu Clan.
techniques.appearance:
A "dragon-snake illusory figure" vaguely appears behind the user. As the user moves, they appear "ghost-like" on the stage.

Yang Hao using dragon Snake Footwork against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: When Yang Hao utilized its maximum potential to drastically increase his speed and maintain a high-frequency movement that was intended to be difficult to track, the technique ultimately failed to bypass Xiao Yan’s superior spiritual perception.

techniques.title: Dragon Transforming Demon Formation
techniques.introText: The Dragon Transforming Demon Formation was a forbidden technique of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
A forbidden technique of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe. Once the formation is successfully activated, everyone inside the formation except for the person acting as the eye of the formation is completely shattered into bloody water to be swallowed and absorbed by the formation's eye, causing the strength of the formation's eye to explode.

This formation was created by an extraordinarily powerful expert from the tribe back then who was also the Great Grandfather of Northern Dragon King. Once this formation was formed, everyone inside, other than the person at the center of the formation, would be shattered into pools of blood. Finally, they would be devoured and absorbed by the center of the formation. Thus, the strength of that person would soar greatly, but this formation was far too bloody and cruel. Hence, it was classified as a forbidden technique and subsequently destroyed but expert may have secretly saved this technique.
techniques.trivia: The formation weaponizes the refined flesh and blood of sacrificed tribe members, manifesting it into a highly corrosive Transforming Dragon Blood Qi.

techniques.title: Eagle Wings
techniques.introText: A High level Xuan class Flying Dou Technique. It was found by Xiao Yan inside the cave in Magic Beast Mountain Range.
techniques.appearance:
A black scroll. As the pitch-black scroll unfolded, two pitch-black eagle wings that caused him to slightly tremble appeared before his eyes. Since this pair of eagle wings were painted on the scroll, they were not too big. However they faintly emitted some warmth. Looking at this mysterious sight, it was obviously not just a simple picture.

The eagle wings were dark black in color with purple clouds faintly showing. If examined closely, the pair of wings was actually like black steel, possessing a special type of metal texture. The feathers on the eagle wings emitted a soft warmth and when Xiao Yan lightly blew on it, his expression could not help but become slightly alarmed. Under the light breeze, the feathers on the eagle wings unexpectedly swished up as if they were real. It was an extremely miraculous sight.

techniques.title: Earth Demon Kick
techniques.introText: Di class High grade Dou Skill that was being sold in the spatial trade fair ; it was one of the first items Xiao yan saw .

techniques.title: Earth Melting Skill
techniques.introText: Earth Melting Skill is a Dou Technique of the Ground Spirit Gate.
techniques.appearance:
When the cry sounded, the deep-yellow Dou Qi swiftly became distorted. Immediately, it transformed into a ferocious Earth Dragon. It let out a roar and transformed into a light ray with a bang. Finally, it shot straight toward Nalan Yanran. A deep gully appeared on the empty ground where it passed, appearing like a bull plowing the fields…

Earth Melting Skill - Dragon

techniques.title: Earth Resolve Flame
techniques.introText: Earth Resolve Flame is a Di Class High Grade Dou Skill.
techniques.appearance:
Earth Resolve Flame is unleashed through a strange method. One’s Dou Qi needs to be inserted into the land to create an extremely hot gas stream. The stream of gas will then shoot out of the ground under the opponent’s feet in an unexpected manner. The attack will not reveal any sound nor presence as it delivers a fatal blow to the other party… this Dou Skill possesses some requirements in terms of the terrain. The closer one is to a volcanic area, the greater its strength.

Earth Resolve Flame displayed by Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan found this technique scroll in Dou Sheng Ancient Remains.

techniques.title: Emerald Fire Lotus
techniques.introText: Combination of Green Lotus Core Flame with Fallen Heart Flame from Glazed Lotus Heart Flame.
techniques.history: Angry Buddha Lotus Flame combining two different flames. Derived an extremely frightening energy; a frighteningly wild and violent energy slowly seeped out. If the attack is successfully launched, it would likely be enough to inflict a decisive, potentially fatal blow on the Dou Zong, as it is the only viable path to victory.
techniques.trivia: Creator - Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Eroding Poison Demon Hand
techniques.introText: Eroding Poison Demon Hand can be considered as Di Class - Low/Middle Level Dou Technique.
techniques.appearance: The Eroding Poison Demon Hand is a defensive and counter-attacking technique. It is unleased by transforming dou qi into an enormous purple hand. It can create an intense corrosion emitted waves of ear-piercing ‘chi chi’ sounds

techniques.title: Evil Wind Tear
techniques.introText: Evil Wind Tear is a Dou technique used by the Profound Sky Sect. It's strength or level is unknown but we can assume its either a High level Xuan Class Dou Technique or Low level Di Class Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Exploding Steps
techniques.introText: Middle Xuan Ranked Dou Technique that Yun Zhi left behind in one of the scrolls.
techniques.appearance:
As the name suggests, this was a type of Dou Technique that relied on the momentum from exploding energy to increase velocity and to this thing, Xiao Yan was quite interested, and thus learnt it. However, with Xiao Yan’s current strength, he was at most able to utilize ten steps of Exploding Steps, anymore would be impossible. But even so, Exploding Steps had a huge contribution to Xiao Yan’s hunting mission in this month.

Yun Zhi left two scrolls, one was a Qi Method and the other was a Dou Technique but Xiao Yan only learned the Dou Technique, Exploding Steps. The other Qi Method was useless for Xiao Yan who had learned the Flame Mantra and so, Xiao Yan could only leave it coldly unattended within the ring.

Exploding Steps Used by Xiao Yan When Dueling Against Mu She

Exploding Steps Used by Xiao Yan When Facing Xiao Li

Exploding Steps Used by Xiao Yan When Facing Nalan Yanran in the Three Year Agreement Battle

Xiao Yan Used Exploding Steps To Stop Gan Mu From The Wolf Head Mercenary Company Group

techniques.title: Exterminating Lightning Hammer
techniques.introText: Exterminating Lightning Hammer is a lightning attributed Dou Skill used by Hong Chen in which he gathers massive lightning Dou Qi into the Mighty Lightning Hammer and unleashes it to generate a destructive lightning beast attack.
techniques.appearance: Exterminating Lightning Hammer is used when Hong Chen pours all his lightning affinity Dou Qi into the Mighty Lightning Hammer. A lightning glow over a hundred feet in size forms around him. Upon striking the ground with the hammer, enormous cracks spread across the stage and the lightning glow transforms into a savage lightning beast. The beast moves with lightning like speed and launches a powerful claw attack capable of distorting space.
techniques.history:
Hong Chen used Exterminating Lightning Hammer after being forced into a disadvantage by Xiao Yan. He bit his tongue, spat blood onto the Mighty Lightning Hammer, and gathered all his lightning Dou Qi into it. After unleashing the technique, a massive lightning beast formed and charged toward Xiao Yan. The attack was powerful enough to distort space and produce threads of dark black spatial lines.

Exterminating Lightning Hammer Video (Donghua)
techniques.trivia:
Blood was used to enhance the hammer before the technique was unleashed.

The Dou Skill was personally taught to Hong Chen by the Pavilion leader of the Wind Lightning Northern Pavilion.

The attack was strong enough to distort space and create dark-black spatial lines.

techniques.title: Extermination Fire Body
techniques.introText: The Extermination Fire Body is one of Xiao Yan’s ultimate dou techniques, which completely merges the devastating energy of a Heavenly Flame with his own physical body.
techniques.appearance:
Xiao Yan's entire body ignites, completely covered in pink flames. His physical body becomes crystal clear and transparent, resembling transparent glass or a falling star from a distance.

Every internal organ, muscle, bone, and cell is filled with the pink flame. Through his translucent skin, his internal organs can be seen covered in a pink crystal layer. The green-red wings on Xiao Yan's back morph into a massive pair of transparent, pink glass-like fire wings. His eyes turn completely crystal clear. It radiates an "extermination-like" aura and an incomparably searing hot temperature.
techniques.trivia: This ultimate attack is capable of severely wounding an elite five-star Dou Sheng, allowing to defeat opponents of that tier without taking any damage himself.

techniques.title: Extermination Fire Lotus
techniques.introText: This is merge of the Life Transforming Flame into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Although the Life Transforming Flame was not a genuine Heavenly Flame, its strength was extremely extraordinary. Moreover, the merger of flames created a kind of extremely frightening, wild, violent energy from the various changes during the merger. This kind of creation only required some catalyst. This Life Transforming Flame was the best replacement at this moment.
techniques.history: Combining four different fires: Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Bone Chilling Flame and Life Transforming Flame. The fire lotus was colorful and beautiful. Its color denseness was far greater than anything prior to it. Hence, it appeared exceptionally beautiful. However, it was this demon-like beauty. An enormous fireball that was over two hundred feet across slowly rose from the cold cloud the instant the light pillar rose. The destructive strength contained within the fireball caused the surrounding space to become extremely distorted. There was even a faint black spatial crack appearing. The massive fireball appeared like another sun that was unleashing a frightening temperature. If this fireball were to explode, it was likely that this Inner Academy and the surrounding fifty kilometers would instantly cease to exist.  Xiao Yan had lost the ability to control it, however, the two guardians of the Jia Nan Academy Bai Lie and Qian Mu appeared to intervene.
techniques.trivia: Creator Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Extermination Fire Lotus
techniques.introText: This is merge of the Life Transforming Flame into the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Although the Life Transforming Flame was not a genuine Heavenly Flame, its strength was extremely extraordinary. Moreover, the merger of flames created a kind of extremely frightening, wild, violent energy from the various changes during the merger. This kind of creation only required some catalyst. This Life Transforming Flame was the best replacement at this moment.
techniques.history: Combining four different fires: Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Bone Chilling Flame and Life Transforming Flame. The fire lotus was colorful and beautiful. Its color denseness was far greater than anything prior to it. Hence, it appeared exceptionally beautiful. However, it was this demon-like beauty. An enormous fireball that was over two hundred feet across slowly rose from the cold cloud the instant the light pillar rose. The destructive strength contained within the fireball caused the surrounding space to become extremely distorted. There was even a faint black spatial crack appearing.
