The massive fireball appeared like another sun that was unleashing a frightening temperature. If this fireball were to explode, it was likely that this Inner Academy and the surrounding fifty kilometers would instantly cease to exist.  Xiao Yan had lost the ability to control it, however, the two guardians of the Jia Nan Academy Bai Lie and Qian Mu appeared to intervene.
techniques.trivia: Creator Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Fierce Bear Ground Splitting Fist
techniques.introText: This skill is Mulan Valley's Bear Headed Elder's Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Fire Gathering Finger
techniques.introText: Fire Gathering Finger is a high-level offensive Dou Technique executed by Xiao Yan using his Spiritual Strength and Heavenly Flames.
techniques.appearance: A beautiful glass-like crystal finger and a crystal attack formed from Heavenly Flames.
techniques.history:
Xiao Yan uses the attack to see through Huang Tian's illusions from Demon Phoenix Steps by penetrating the many human figures and ruthlessly pressed the fist behind the golden light and strike his true body, causing massive physical damage.

Xiao Yan used Fire Gathering Finger against Huang Tian

Fire Gathering Finger

Fire Gathering Finger
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Yan used this technique against Huang Tian making him lose one of his arm.

When exploded, its frightening temperature immediately vaporized any moisture of the area.

techniques.title: Fire Palm
techniques.introText: Low Xuan Level, Able to create huge gusts! The founder of this was a blacksmith who had been a blacksmith for his entire life. Because of the fire of the furnace, after a couple decades, he invented this technique. Xiao Yan combined this Dou Technique with Vacuum Hand.
techniques.trivia: Given to Xiao Yan by Yao Lao after Xiao Yan became 7-Star Dou Zhi Qi (Dou Disciple).

techniques.title: Fissure of the Lion
techniques.introText: Xiao Clan’s highest Dou Technique is a Xuan Level Technique Fissure of the Lion that goes with the Xuan Level Qi Method Raging Lion.

techniques.title: Four And Half Coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame
techniques.introText: Four and Half Coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Also called Five Coloured Lotus Flame as it combines five flames such as Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Bone Chilling Flame, Three Thousand Burning Flame, and Life Transforming Flame.
techniques.history:
Angry Buddha Lotus Flame combining five different flames. The entire place trembled because of this explosion. All the mountains within a ten-thousand-foot-radius emitted a ‘boom’ as they were blasted into dust. In an instant, the mountain range had turned into a desert. Sand and rocks flew while smoke permeated the air. Killing an elite six change peak Dou Zun with just one strike.  This level of fusion is typically used to confront enemies at the peak of the Dou Zun class or even against Semi-Saints (Half-Saints) when Xiao Yan's own cultivation is still far lower.

Xiao Yan using 5 coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame against Three Dragon Kings
techniques.trivia:
Creator - Xiao Yan

It is also mentioned as Extermination Fire Lotus.

techniques.title: Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique
techniques.introText: A Di Class high-level Dou Technique, also the signature technique of the Venerable Tian Huo.
techniques.appearance:
The Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique is a fire control technique, divided into five levels, each corresponding to a beast: Wolf, Leopard, Lion, Tiger, and Dragon. Each level has its own Fire Spirit.

When the technique is perfected, the five beasts gather together to form the Five Ring Flame Expelling Flame Formation, possessing the immense power to vaporize seas and burn the sky. If four of the five beasts are condensed from different types of Heavenly Flames, the power of this technique can rival that of a Tian Class Dou Technique. The various fire control methods recorded in this technique are not only spectacular but also allow for the most exquisite control of flames with minimal consumption of Spiritual Strength, ultimately unleashing an incredibly powerful force.

The Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique. If four of the five spirits were formed by Heavenly Flames, its might could be comparable to a Tian class Dou Skills. When Heavenly Flame are used to form them all. The five types of Heavenly Flames had unleashed the Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique to its limit!

When Five types of fire spirits swiftly merged together. They turned into a thousand-foot-large fire ring in the blink of an eye. The fire ring wildly rotated. Even space itself had completely collapsed at this moment, appearing like ferocious large black mouth.

Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique " Fire God Arm " Video

Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique " Fire God Arm " Video

Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique " Five Ring Flame Expelling Disk " ( Defense Mode ) Video

Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique " Five Ring Flame Expelling Disk " ( Attack Mode ) Video
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan used Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Three Thousand Burning Flame, Bone Chilling Flame and Sea Heart Flame to unleash this technique at its limit.

techniques.title: Five Snake Poison Breaking Seal
techniques.introText: A merging Dou Technique of Snake-People race.

techniques.title: Flame Creation Skill
techniques.introText: This Dou Technique is called the ‘Flame Creation Skill’. It is somewhat harsh to practice. The practitioner must be someone who practice a fire affinity Qi Method. This kind of Dou Technique would not only enable a person to swiftly control any flame but it is also able to transform the Dou Qi within one’s body into an energy flame that is not real. Of course, this is not what it is praised for. Its greatest use is that if another person who practices this Dou Technique were to use it at the same time, the energy flame that is formed can temporarily be merged. The energy flame after such a merger will transform into an actual flame. Its strength is extremely shocking and could even be comparable to a ‘Heavenly Flame’!
techniques.trivia: Life Transforming Flame

techniques.title: Flame Di Body
techniques.introText: Flame Di Body is a special physique only a Dou Di can create and only if He or She practice Flame affinity arts.
techniques.appearance:
This body was created by Xiao Yan after he ascended to the Dou Di class according to Gu Yuan and the other elites of the ancient clan they were naturally aware that an elite Dou Qi could incorporate the world in their bodies. At that time, they would be the world. Just the lift of a hand could destroy the universe. Its might was extremely great and terrifying!.

When Xiao Yan uses this technique the heavenly flame inside his body pushes to their limit and release a terrifying heat in all directions and burns down nearby area turning it into a drought area. Soon these flame combine and form multiple dragons that swirl around the Xiao Yan as he stands and roar that shakes the world.
techniques.trivia: This technique is Xiao Yan's final card in battle.

techniques.title: Flame Splitting Tsunami
techniques.introText: Flame Splitting Tsunami, Low Di Dou Skill. When mastery is achieved, cutting mountains and breaking waves can be easily accomplished.

techniques.title: Flying Dou Techniques
techniques.introText: Flying Dou Techniques were a strange secret technique that could enable the practitioner to form two small extensions that protruded from the veins on one’s back. With these two extension, one would be able to form a pair of wings and fly in the air even if one did not possess the strength of a Dou Wang. Flying was something that was a great temptation to many. In order to fulfill this temptation, many strong people put in all their effort to reach for the unreachable dream of becoming a Dou Wang. At the same time, there were also many who wanted to find a shortcut by finding this rare and valuable Flying Type Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Flying Roc
techniques.introText: Fly Roc is an agility Dou Technique. It seen being used by Jia ma imperial family.

techniques.title: Four And Half Coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame
techniques.introText: Four and Half Coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Also called Five Coloured Lotus Flame as it combines five flames such as Green Lotus Core Flame, Fallen Heart Flame, Bone Chilling Flame, Three Thousand Burning Flame, and Life Transforming Flame.
techniques.history:
Angry Buddha Lotus Flame combining five different flames. The entire place trembled because of this explosion. All the mountains within a ten-thousand-foot-radius emitted a ‘boom’ as they were blasted into dust. In an instant, the mountain range had turned into a desert. Sand and rocks flew while smoke permeated the air. Killing an elite six change peak Dou Zun with just one strike.  This level of fusion is typically used to confront enemies at the peak of the Dou Zun class or even against Semi-Saints (Half-Saints) when Xiao Yan's own cultivation is still far lower.

Xiao Yan using 5 coloured Angry Buddha Lotus Flame against Three Dragon Kings
techniques.trivia:
Creator - Xiao Yan

It is also mentioned as Extermination Fire Lotus.

techniques.title: Freezing Sky Palm
techniques.introText: Freezing Sky Palm is a Dou Technique used by Bing_He_(Chief), the Valley Chief of Ice River Valley. It is performed using the Ice Zun Force and involves condensing black cold Qi into a palm attack with intense freezing properties.
techniques.appearance: It appears as a palm covered in thick black ice emitting a dense chill while causing the surrounding cold air to become violent.
techniques.history:
Bing He uses Freezing Sky Palm during a clash with an elder of Gu Clan. The collision produces a massive energy storm, spatial cracks in the sky and forces both fighters backward before Ice River Valley eventually withdraws.

Freezing Sky Palm

Freezing Sky Palm
techniques.trivia: The black ice contains poisonous freezing properties.

techniques.title: Ghost Claw
techniques.introText: Ghost Claw can be considered as Low/Middle Level Di Class Dou Technique for agility and hand-to-hand combat style.
techniques.appearance:
The ghost claw, contained cold, dark-black air, which swiftly expand as numerous exclamations were made. The sharp ghost claw flashed over like lightning. After which, it struck and simply passed without reason means as the claw nears its target, the black air within it swiftly expands, increasing the range and making the attack harder to dodge.

Old Ground Demon Ghost attacking Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: The Ghost Claw is heavily infused with Ice-attribute Dou Qi.

techniques.title: Glorious Thunder
techniques.introText: Glorious Thunder is Bai Shan's most powerful Dou Technique.

techniques.title: God Seal Technique
techniques.introText: The God Seal Technique is a legendary Di Class High level Dou Technique that was created by a certain Dou Di during ancient times. Is a secret inheritance of the Gu Clan, consisting of five distinct styles: Open Mountain Seal, Sea Flipping Seal, Overturning Land Seal, Sky Burying Seal, and Ancient God Seal. Each seal is linked to one another. When one reaches complete mastery of all five seals, one will be able to flip the sea, overturn the oceans, and swallow the Heavens and Earth! It is comparable to a Tian Class Dou Technique at its peak! However, one must be at the Dou Wang class in order to practice this seal. Otherwise, one will fail and suffer bitterness alone!

techniques.title: Gold Emperor Incinerating Heaven Execution
techniques.introText: Gold Emperor Incinerating Heaven Execution is one of the strongest techniques of the Gu Clan and is used by none other than the young lady of the Gu Clan, Gu Xun'er, called the most brilliant flower of the Gu Clan and known for her beauty, charm, and strength. She created this technique after cultivating the ancestral flame of the Gu Clan, the Gold Emperor Incinerating Heavenly Flame, which ranks fourth on the Heavenly Flame Ranking and is the strongest flame held by anyone in the 8 ancient clans, except for Xiao Yan's Pure Lotus Demon Flame and the Hun Clan's Nihility Devouring Flame.
techniques.trivia: Gu Xun Er used this technique against Zhu Kun.

techniques.title: Great Blood Agglomeration Skill
techniques.introText: This is the Great Blood Agglomeration Skill of the Profound Sky Sect. It relies on the evaporation of one’s blood to temporarily strengthen oneself.

techniques.title: Great Blood Bodhisattva Devourer
techniques.introText: Great Blood Bodhisattva Devourer is a Di Class Dou Technique used by Fan Lao.
techniques.appearance:
Countless numbers of people below suddenly felt an extremely dense, bloody scent pouncing over the moment that the blood spear left his hand. Everyone felt as though they were in an abyss despite being under the light of the intense sun. Their bodies felt a chill, and the originally clear sky was also covered by the hazy bloody air. The entire place was desolate and gloomy.

The sudden change in their surroundings caused the fighting in the battleground within the sky to quietly become much duller. Numerous gazes carried some shock as they were thrown toward where Fan Lao and Xiao Yan were. This was especially when everyone saw the blood-colored long spear that had escaped Fan Lao’s hand. Quite a number of experts from the ‘Black-Corner Region’ immediately let out a surprised cry.

While shocked cries were being transmitted in the sky, a blood-colored lightning suddenly broke through the barrier in the sky at that moment. It appeared to have teleported, and in the blink of an eye, it carried a disgusting bloody stench as it appeared in Xiao Yan’s sight.

Great Blood Boddhisatva Devourer

Great Blood Boddhisatva Devourer
techniques.trivia: Most of those expert Dou Huangs who died in Fan Lao’s hands had lost to this move.

techniques.title: Great Heaven Creation Palm
techniques.introText: Great Heaven Creation Palm, Tian class low-level Dou Technique. It is created by Saint Zhao Hua by using all of his strength to merge a hundred Dou Techniques.
techniques.appearance: This palm technique pays attention to the meaning of creation. Using a palm to break the sky and strength to shatter everything. Tian class Dou Technique, exceeding the ordinary and surpassing a saint. By being able to obtain the secret hidden by Saint Zhao Hua in the bones, Xiao Yan can be considered a person of affinity. Since he has obtained the bones, his hand should have been refined by the golden spirit saliva. The Great Heaven Creation Palm can only be successfully used by a hand that has been refined. Otherwise, one will definitely encounter a backlash!
techniques.trivia:
When Xiao Yan was 2 Star Dou Sheng , he could use Great Heaven Creation Palm with his other hand because he was more powerful than the creator of this Dou Technique.

It is called 'Great Heavenly Fist' in the manhua.

techniques.title: Great Hell Dragon Fist
techniques.introText: Great Hell Dragon Fist is at least a Di Class High tier Dou Technique used by the fighters of the Profound Sky Sect. It is also one of the strongest technique that can be found in the Profound Sky Sect, even the deputy chief of this sect - Liu Cang used this technique.
techniques.trivia: He used this technique against Xiao Yan's King Kong Glass Body to no avail.

techniques.title: Great Rift Coffin Splitting Claw
techniques.introText: This claw technique is a High Xuan Dou Technique. However, in Liu Qing’s hands, it even has a strength that is comparable to a Di class Dou Technique. This is because he has honed this Dou Technique for nearly twenty years. It would not be surprising he had practiced it until he had reached the pinnacle.

techniques.title: Great Silent Destruction Finger
techniques.introText: Great Silent Destruction Finger is Tian Class Dou Technique of the Gu Clan.

techniques.title: Great Splitting Demon Claw
techniques.introText: Great Splitting Demon Claw is a Di Tier High Class Dou Technique of Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe.
techniques.appearance: A pair of wings that were dozens of feet wide were extended behind him. In a flash, he appeared above Xiao Yan. His large black claw suddenly pressed down. The sharp wind sealed the air around Xiao Yan. After which, he violently grabbed at Xiao Yan’s head.
techniques.trivia: It is not completely mentioned in Donghua; just its air sealing method was shown.

techniques.title: Great Splitting Wind
techniques.introText: This is a Dou Technique of at least Di class. It is used by the strong elites of the Profound Sky Sect. This technique is a bloody and poisonous. It is used to take out the enemy with strong and concentrated attack with a terrifying speed. It is also one of the strongest technique of Yaohua Liangjun.

techniques.title: Great Tragedy Hand
techniques.introText: Great Tragedy Hand is one of the Dou Technique that Pure Lotus Demon Flame learned from the inheritance of the Pure Lotus Demon Saint.
techniques.appearance:
This technique for a lack of words could be said as terrifying. It requires excellently control over the fire so much so that a person could control magma. This technique is at least Di Class High Tier or Tian Class .

When used the user's hand suddenly grabbed at the sea of magma below. One could see the sea of magma below suddenly exploding as a ten-thousand-foot-large magma hand broke away from the sea. It was accompanied by a shocking heat as it shot towards the enemy.

Great Tragedy Hand (Video)

Great Tragedy Hand (Video)

Great Tragedy Hand (Video)

techniques.title: Green Killing Tornado
techniques.introText: Green Killing Tornado is a high-level Wind-attribute dou technique used by Lin Xiuya.
techniques.appearance:
The flowing wind in the mountain valley appeared to suddenly solidify. Quickly following this, wild wind rose with great force. An extremely powerful strength swiftly agglomerated in mid-air. In merely the blink of an eye, the agglomeration of the strength was complete. Finally, the powerful strength tore through the air. The sharp rushing wind sound was like a whistle that lingered endlessly by people’s ears.

A vague green-colored shadow containing an extremely powerful wind shot explosively down from above. Although the green-colored shadow was extremely vague, one could still faintly identify it was a green-colored longsword that was formed by energy. The speed of this longsword was so fast that it was a little frightening. From the looks of the wildly surging rotating wind on its surface, it appeared that this was like an energy object that was compressed and agglomerated from wild wind. This substance-like energy acted in coordination with his Dou Technique, producing an extremely powerful strength.

Lin Xiuya using Green Killing Tornado on Snow Demon Sky Ape

Lin Xiuya using Green Killing Tornado on Xiao Yan after becoming Dou Wang
techniques.trivia:
It agglomerates the wild wind into a substance-like energy longsword.

In Donghua, 青炫风杀 (Qīng Xuàn Fēng Sha) is translated as Green Killing Vortex / Radiant Green Gale.

techniques.title: Green Submerged Sword Strike
techniques.introText: Green Submerged Sword Strike is a powerful Wind-affinity Dou Technique utilized by Lin Xiuya in a sneak attack against Fan Lao.
techniques.appearance:
The clear ring of a sword sounded from the longsword in his hand. Dark-green energy agglomerated swiftly. In the blink of an eye, the entire sword was covered by an energy sheath. There were actually a countless number of wild winds that appeared and rotated around the body of the sword.

As the cold cry sounded, the longsword suddenly left his hand and coagulated with the ten plus rotating storms. Finally, it turned into a silent vague shadow that directly shot toward Fan Lao’s head in a lightning-like manner! Its sneak attack was as fast as lightning. By the time enemy sensed it, the frightening force that pricked one’s skin had already reached the top of the head. At that moment, they could only give up on using a Dou Technique to oppose it.

Green Submerged Sword Strike Video

Lin Xiuya used Green Submerged Sword Strike against Fan Lao while helping Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia:
The green-colored sword shadow instantly penetrated the sea of blood surged by Fan Lao. The frightening force that it contained caused the sea of blood to fluctuate intensely.

In Donghua, this dou technique is shown as Lin Xiuya's strong one from "One Pester, One Strong".

This is one of the ultimate attacks of Lin Xiuya's sword technique, according to Lin Yan's guess, there are rumors that Liu Qing was defeated by this move.

techniques.title: Ground Drawing Prison
techniques.introText: Ground Drawing Poison is a ground based technique that creates a soil cage to trap opponents.
techniques.appearance:
The technique manipulates the earth using deep-yellow Dou Qi, forming a cage from the ground to restrict the target’s movements.

Ground Spirit Gate, Ground Drawing Prison
techniques.history: During the encounter with Nalan Yanran, three four-star Dou Huangs of the Ground Spirit Gate coordinated to use Ground Drawing Poison. They slammed their hands into the ground, causing the soil to rise and rapidly form a cage around Nalan Yanran.

techniques.title: Ground Splitting Hack
techniques.introText: Ground Splitting Hack is one of the strong Dou Techniques the Xiao Clan possessed during the time of Xiao Xuan.
techniques.appearance:
This technique is quiet strong and its grade should be around Di Class High Grade or higher. When Xiao Chen used this technique the enormous blood-soaked axe in his hand wildly danced like a windmill as he watched the bloody light rapidly magnify in front of him. The axe paused and a ten-thousand-foot-large bloody glow erupted from the axe. It was accompanied by waves deep sonic booms as it violently collided with the enemy with lightning-like speed.

This  attack can split the land and turn multiple mountains into dust all at once.

Ground Splitting Hack Video
techniques.trivia: Xiao Chen used this technique against Hun Mo in their challenge.

techniques.title: Gu Di Shattering Black Finger
techniques.introText: Gu Di Shattering Black Finger is one of the strongest Dou Techniques within the Gu Clan. This Technique is also the the killing blow of the Gu Clan strongest Member  Gu Clan's patriarch Gu Yuan even elites like Xiao Xuan, Hun Tiandi etc. have to defend against this blow with there might a normal 7 star or less Dou Sheng will just burst apart into blood mist if fighting against it.
techniques.trivia: Gu Yuan used this technique to fight against Hun Tiandi 's Blood Light who was a Dou Di even though he suffered injuries and fell back into the mountain he still managed to stop the attack.

techniques.title: Heaven Offering Demon Hand
techniques.introText: Heaven Offering Demon Hand is one of the guarded Dou Skills of the Profound Sky Sect.

techniques.title: Heaven Phoenix Shadow
techniques.introText: Heaven Phoenix Shadow is one of the strongest Dou Technique present in the Ancient Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe. It is at least Di Class High Level Dou Technique - making it one of their killing blows but using it requires some condition to use such a technique first of all the user must have the bloodline of the Ancient Heaven Phoenix and secondly matters the person's strength as how strong the person's level is decide the effect of this technique.

techniques.title: Heaven Shaking Rod
techniques.introText: Heaven Shaking Rod is a Dou Technique that concentrates Dou Qi into a rod and unleashes a powerful smashing strike.
techniques.appearance: Heaven Shaking Rod is a technique that channels Dou Qi into a rod weapon and releases it in a powerful smashing motion. When activated, the rod emits a piercing blue glow and produces a strange trembling rhythm before striking the target. The technique is strong enough to directly collide with large energy attacks in battle.
techniques.history:
During the battle between Xiao Yan and Xie Shan, Xie Shan used Heaven Shaking Rod to counter Xiao Yan’s Flame Splitting Tsunami attack.

Xie Shan gathered Dou Qi into his blue rod, causing its size to greatly increase before unleashing the technique. The rod emitted a piercing blue glow and struck the incoming ruler glow from Xiao Yan. The two attacks collided and produced a thunder-like explosion that spread powerful energy waves across the battlefield.

Heaven Shaking Rod (Video)
techniques.trivia: The rod’s size greatly increases after Dou Qi is poured into it, making it resemble a pillar during the attack.

techniques.title: Heaven Swallowing Mirror
techniques.introText: Heaven Swallowing Mirror is one of the best Defensive Dou Techniques that are known and is used by the elites of Hun Clan. This Technique is at least Tian Class Dou Technique.
techniques.appearance:
This Technique allows the user the user to transform their Dou Qi into a purple-black mirror-like light curtain immediately, which spread in front of the user with lightning-like speed. Everything that touched this purple-black light curtain, regardless of whether it is a terrifying natural Treasure like the Heavenly Flame or energy, was completely devoured in an instant.

This Technique not only allows the user to defend but to also capture or trap their enemies into a secluded space but that means the user must also be in the secluded space but if the user is defeated or runs, the curtain disappears.
techniques.history: The grave expression on Hun Feng’s face became more dense when he sensed this terrifying attack. A mouthful of purple-black light was spat out of his mouth. It immediately transformed into a purple-black mirror-like light curtain, which spread in front of him with lightning-like speed. Everything that touched this purple-black light curtain, regardless of whether it was a Heavenly Flame or energy, was completely devoured in an instant.
techniques.trivia: This Defensive Technique is one of the best defensive techniques but its completely useless against a soul attack.

techniques.title: Holy Demon Phoenix Icon
techniques.introText: Holy Demon Phoenix Icon, Swallow the Heaven and Earth is dou technique of Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe, is the ultimate bloodline manifestation used by Feng Qing Er. It is the offensive evolution of her "Holy Demon Phoenix Icon."
techniques.appearance:
Majestic Dou Qi surged out of her body, transforming into an enormous phoenix icon behind. This phoenix was completely black in color and gave one a kind of demonic feeling. The phoenix’s eyes when stared from a distance gives an unusual pressure fell from the sky! Under this pressure, even the energy in the surroundings had become somewhat chaotic.

The technique begins by summoning an enormous, dark phantom that reveals her true lineage and exerts a powerful spiritual pressure. The mere presence of this icon destabilizes the natural energy of the surrounding environment.

At this bone-chilling cry of "Swallow Heaven and Earth", the illusory black phoenix behind her seemingly roars to life, letting out a piercing shriek to the heavens. Flapping its enormous wings, it morphs into a hundred-foot-tall mass of darkness that streaks toward the enemy with the devastating force of a falling meteorite.

Feng Qing Er displaying Holy Demon Phoenix Icon, Swallow The Heaven And Earth against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia:
After using soul swallowing bloodline only Feng Qing Er has reached the three-star level to summon the Holy Demon Phoenix Icon.

It can be considered as Di Class High level Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Holy Demon Phoenix Icon
techniques.introText: Holy Demon Phoenix Icon, Swallow the Heaven and Earth is dou technique of Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe, is the ultimate bloodline manifestation used by Feng Qing Er. It is the offensive evolution of her "Holy Demon Phoenix Icon."
techniques.appearance:
Majestic Dou Qi surged out of her body, transforming into an enormous phoenix icon behind. This phoenix was completely black in color and gave one a kind of demonic feeling. The phoenix’s eyes when stared from a distance gives an unusual pressure fell from the sky! Under this pressure, even the energy in the surroundings had become somewhat chaotic.

The technique begins by summoning an enormous, dark phantom that reveals her true lineage and exerts a powerful spiritual pressure. The mere presence of this icon destabilizes the natural energy of the surrounding environment.

At this bone-chilling cry of "Swallow Heaven and Earth", the illusory black phoenix behind her seemingly roars to life, letting out a piercing shriek to the heavens. Flapping its enormous wings, it morphs into a hundred-foot-tall mass of darkness that streaks toward the enemy with the devastating force of a falling meteorite.

Feng Qing Er displaying Holy Demon Phoenix Icon, Swallow The Heaven And Earth against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia:
After using soul swallowing bloodline only Feng Qing Er has reached the three-star level to summon the Holy Demon Phoenix Icon.

It can be considered as Di Class High level Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Ice Condensate Sword Skill
techniques.introText: Ice Condensate Sword Skill can be considered as Di Class Middle/High Level Dou Technique, created by merging the Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes.
techniques.appearance:
Ice Condensate Sword is created by merging the Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes when they have already embedded themselves within an enemy's defensive barrier. The technique manifests as a ten-foot-wide, dark-black ice sword with a sharp point and a "pressing cold air" that can suppress the corrosive properties of Dou Qi.

Ice Condensate Sword
techniques.trivia:
The sword can detonates, transforming into countless palm-sized ice blades like Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes that shred the target at close range upon explode.

The sword successfully broke through the Little Fairy Doctor’s Eroding Poison Demon Hand, causing her multiple bleeding injuries despite her elite Dou Zong speed.

techniques.title: Illusonary Ghost Agility Skill
techniques.introText: Illusory Ghost Agility Skill is a Dou technique used by Hall of souls . Its one of the ultimate skills of old Ghost Zhai Xing
techniques.appearance:
Zhai Xing has never used this technique on someone less than 5 star Dou zun fighter its ability to increase speed is on par or even better than the Three Thousand Lightning Movement.

This technique is quite mysterious and hard to understand ; its at least a dou technique of DI class - to use a person suppresses multiple spiritual bodies under them and start to control them like a puppet  this grants the user a temporary boost granting them greater speed and as it was seen how Zhai Xing suddenly became as fast as Xiao Yan and suddenly had the power to make him retreat.

Under this crazy attack, the space itself was being forcefully pressured into a concave form. A sonic boom sound continued to resound across the sky when using this technique.
Another powerful ability a person can show using this dou technique is the attack of Spiritual Body in which the body under suppresion suddenly get released and start attacking the enemy from multiple direction making them hard to avoid even Xiao Yan had to sustain multiple minor injuries leaving his clothes in taters.

Illusonary Ghost Agility Skill Video

Illusonary Ghost Agility Skill Video

Illusonary Ghost Agility Skill Video
techniques.trivia:
It was shown in Donghua Ep 208.

It is called the Phantom Soul Body technique in the Donghua.

techniques.title: Iron Fists
techniques.introText: Iron Fists: a High Huang level Dou Technique with a decent amount of power. It required a Dou Qi of at least 7 Duan to be able to learn and practice. It is a Dou Skill belonging to the Xiao Clan.
techniques.trivia: It is used by Xiao Ning.

techniques.title: King Kong Glass Body
techniques.introText: The King Kong Glass Body, Tian class low level Dou Skill turns one’s body into metal that nothing can pierce or destroy, used by Xiao Yan.
techniques.appearance:
King Kong Glass Body, Tian class low level Dou Skill. This Dou Skill was created by Saint Liu Li a thousand years ago. If one practices this Dou Skill to its peak, one’s body would appear as indestructible as metal, one’s punch could collapse the sky, and one’s feet could crack the ground. It is a kind of powerful Dou Skill that combines both offense and defense together.

When one fully masters this Dou Skill, one’s body turns into King Kong. Their body becomes ninety-nine feet in size, extremely strong, and a dazzling golden light appears. One’s fist will shatter the sky while one’s feet will crack the land! This was a Dou Skill that used Dou Qi to strengthen one’s physical body.  In order to practice this ‘King Kong Glass Body,’ one needed to merge one’s Dou Qi with one’s bones, blood, and flesh using a unique method.
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan uses energy within Heaven Demon Blood Pool to fully master King Kong Glass Body. The pool is rich in energy, helpful for tempering Xiao Yan's King Kong Glass Body.

techniques.title: Kun Huang Blood Stomach
techniques.introText: Kun Huang Blood Stomach is a Di Class High Tier Dou Technique of Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
Kun Huang Blood Stomach is a Dou Technique of the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe. This Technique is one of the strong Technique of Tribe and is of at least a  Di Class High Tier Dou Technique,

This technique is rare technique which has the ability of Devouring.

When used Black vapor surged out of the user body. It swiftly formed a strange black blob that was a couple thousand feet wide under the enemy. At a glance, it appeared like an enormous stomach. A large hole was opened at the top of the stomach, appearing like a large ferocious mouth that wildly bit towards the enemy.

Kun Phoenix Engulfment
techniques.trivia:
In donghua, this technique is named as Kun Phoenix Engulfment (鲲凰吞灭) and its appearance is also based on its name:
鲲 kūn - A legendary giant fish from Chinese mythology

凰 huáng - referring Phoenix

吞 tūn - To swallow / To devour

灭 miè - To destroy / To annihilate

Kun Huang Blood Stomach, consumes Dou Qi to condense a giant Kun (a legendary fish) that swallows the enemy into its belly. This Dou Technique is exceptionally firm and extremely difficult to break. In just half a moment (approx. 15 minutes), it can refine a One-Star Dou Saint into bloody water. (Donghua)

techniques.title: Large Scale Angry Buddha Lotus Flame
techniques.introText: Combination of Green Lotus Core Flame with Bone Chilling Flame (Borrowed by Yao Lao).
techniques.history: Angry Buddha Lotus Flame combining two different flames. An enormous firestorm appeared just like a mushroom cloud as it suddenly surfaced in the sky. An earth-shaking explosion caused the ears of many to ring. That wild and violent heat that came spreading from the sky caused shock to surge onto the faces of everyone.
techniques.trivia: Creator - Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Large Wind Handprint
techniques.introText: Large Wind Handprint is a Dou Technique used by Yun Shan through one of his afterimages during the battle at Misty Cloud Sect, forming a massive energy palm to attack Hai Bodong while pursuing Xiao Yan.
techniques.appearance: It is described as a gigantic energy handprint formed from Dou Qi that strikes downward from above with destructive force.
techniques.history:
During Yun Shan’s pursuit of Xiao Yan after the destruction caused by the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, his afterimages intercept Hai Bodong when the latter tries to help Xiao Yan escape. One afterimage uses Large Wind Handprint summoning a massive energy palm that destroys Hai Bodong’s ice defenses and strikes him directly, injuring him and forcing him downward while the afterimages continue chasing Xiao Yan.

Great Wind Handprint - Great Wind Hand Seal Video

Great Wind Handprint - Great Wind Hand Seal Video
techniques.trivia: The technique is powerful enough to break through the ice defense of Hai Bodong.

techniques.title: Lightning Bat Sky Wings
techniques.introText: This ‘Lightning Bat Sky Wings’ can be considered to be a Low Level Xuan Class Flying Dou Technique if it were to be ranked according to its class. Therefore, the based price is set at one million on Great Auction Fair.

techniques.title: Lightning Calamity Palm
techniques.introText: The Lightning Calamity Palm is a rare Tian class high level Dou Skill within the Lei clan. Moreover, it was unleashed by Lei Ying. This Dou Skill might easily destroy all living creatures within a five hundred kilometre radius.

techniques.title: Lightning Snake Dance
techniques.introText: Lightning Snake Dance is a spear-based Dou Technique used by Ling Quan, a commander of the Gu Clan’s Black Submerged Army.
techniques.appearance:
The technique is high-speed and visually flashy. Ling Quan swung the lightning spear, and it appeared like a randomly dancing silver snake as it trickily pierced toward all the fatal spots on Xiao Yan’s body. Numerous spear afterimages surfaced in the air.  His palm abruptly smashed into the spear handle. This suddenly explosive force caused the lightning spear to shoot out like a crossbow. Even the space itself was torn along the way, forming a dark-black fissure.

The long-spear shot out at a lightning-like speed. However, a fire hand rushed out just when it was about to strike Xiao Yan’s chest. This fire hand forcefully grabbed the body of the spear and stopped its forward momentum. Xiao Yan abruptly clenched his hand and the long spear was snapped apart. It transformed into a countless number of silver snakes, which finally turned into nothingness as the flame rose.

Ling Quan using using Lightning Snake Dance
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan refer to it as a Fancy spear techniques which are completely useless.

techniques.title: Lion Inch Force
techniques.introText: This skill is Mulan Valley's Lion Headed Elder's Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Lion Tiger Gold Shattering Roar
techniques.introText: Lion Tiger Gold Shattering Roar is a High Xuan Class Sonic type Dou Technique
techniques.appearance:
When the lions and tigers roar in union, all beasts submit. It has the enormous strength of shattering gold and shaking the soul.

Lion Tiger Gold Shattering Roar (Video)
techniques.trivia: In Book Collection Hall of Jia Nan Academy, Xiao Yan didn't manage to take it from the energy layer. Xun Er did it and gave it to Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Lizard Crawl
techniques.introText: Mercenary suddenly placed his palms on the ground, his figure became similar to that of a house lizard. Flicking his palms off the ground, in a weird manner, his body dashed towards the thicket.
techniques.appearance: Mercenary suddenly placed his palms on the ground, his figure became similar to that of a house lizard. Flicking his palms off the ground, in a weird manner, his body dashed towards the thicket.

techniques.title: Man and Blade Merger
techniques.introText: Man and Blade Merger is the "trump card" of the First Tianzun. It represents the peak of his training, moving from using a weapon to literally becoming the weapon itself.
techniques.appearance: The First Tianzun’s body dissolves and "merges" into the Bone Emperor Blade. His face appears on the dense white surface of the bone. The blade grows "tiny blood scars" that look like "densely packed blood vessels," making the weapon appear like a living, breathing organism.
techniques.history:
During the battle, the First Tianzun activated the Man and Blade Merger, merging his body with the Bone Emperor Blade for the first time. Countless blade shadows appeared aiming at the lethal spots around Xiao Yan. In response, Xiao Yan used Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler, forming a defensive net of ruler shadows around his body. Despite this, the First Tianzun’s attacks were so fast that a blade still pierced Xiao Yan’s shoulder breaking part of his defensive formation. However Xiao Yan countered with his spiritual attacks, using Yellow Spring Divine Anger, Yellow Spring Finger, and Yellow Spring Palm, ultimately sending the First Tianzun flying and defeating him.

Man And Blade Merger displayed by First Tianzun

Bone Emperor Man And Blade Merger Video

Bone Emperor Man And Blade Merger Video
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Yan was the first opponent on whom the First Tianzun used this technique.

While the Man and Blade Merger improved his combat speed and offensive power, he was still overwhelmed by Yellow Spring Divine Anger.

Xiao Yan used Yellow Spring Divine Anger, the spiritual vibration was so violent that it physically "shook" the First Tianzun out of the merger. He was forced out of the blade, spitting blood and leaving him completely exposed to Xiao Yan's follow-up attacks (the Finger and Palm).

techniques.title: Mountain Shaking Footsteps
techniques.introText: Mountain Shaking Footsteps is a Dou Technique which was used by an energy body(referred as the black armor energy body), which was the remains of a nine star Dou Zun expert who ruled quite a bit of territory on the second floor of the Heavenly Tomb.

techniques.title: Mountain Splitting Spear
techniques.introText: The Mountain Splitting Spear is a formidable martial skill known for its destructive power and precision. Wielded by Liu Qing, the leader of the Splitting Mountain Faction in Jia Nan Academy, this technique is designed to break through the strongest of defenses and overwhelm opponents with sheer force.
techniques.trivia:
Liu Qing Has Two Attack Styles From the Mountain Splitting Spear Technique, The First Is The Great Rift Rock And The Second Is Heaven Splitting Mountain.

This Spear Technique is at the peak of The high-level xuan class, yet its power is capable of competing and comparing to Low-Level Di Class Dou Techniques

techniques.title: Mysterious Fire Move
techniques.introText: Mysterious Fire Move is a Dou Techniques of the Hong Clan.
techniques.history:
When Xiao Yan was traveling with Han Xue their party was attacked by Hong Mu and Hong Lie and this is one of the attacks they tried to use against Xiao Yan. He easily dispersed the attack as it was a  flame attack.

Two cries erupted from Hong Lie and Hong Mu’s mouth. Immediately, a hot-red glow swept out like a flame. Behind it was a green-colored Dou Qi, which swiftly chased after it and merged into the flame. Immediately, the fiery-red Dou Qi’s momentum soared. The hot temperature caused the withered yellow leaves on the sides of the road to emit a ‘chi’ sound as ignited by themselves.

techniques.title: Mysterious Ice Killing Vortex
techniques.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

techniques.title: Nightmare Heavenly Fog
techniques.introText: Nightmare Heavenly Fog is a legendary and terrifying Dou Techniques, famously associated with the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint and later used by the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame.
techniques.appearance:
This was a unique ultimate skill of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint for which he was renowned. It is a fog that can cause a person to descend into an illusion forever.

It is rumored that the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint once unleashed this skill and covered an entire city within it. The people in the city felt as though they had lived for a couple of centuries. Only after the fog scattered did they suddenly realize that the hundred year experience was merely a dream. When the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint unleashed this skill, he was able to get millions of people in an entire city to live in an illusion for centuries. The magical effect of this illusion is not something that an ordinary person can comprehend.

The most terrifying aspect of the Nightmare Heaven Fog is if one continue to progress as the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame had planned, they would only sink further and further into it. In the end, they would have become its fire slaves. Even though they experience a big battle and win, they will still remain in an illusion.

Some Practitioners Affected by the Illusionary and Hallucinatory Effects of the Nightmare Heavenly Fog

Explanation of the Nightmare Heavenly Fog Illusion Technique

Explanation of the Nightmare Heavenly Fog Illusion Technique

Explanation of the Nightmare Heavenly Fog Illusion Technique
techniques.history:
Xiao Yan discovered that he and his companions were trapped inside an illusion created by Nightmare Heaven Fog. The illusion had been prepared for a long time by the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame.

The illusion was extremely realistic. There is reality in fake and fake in reality. Xiao Yan eventually explained that the strength of the enemy within the illusion depended on the fear and perception in their hearts. By realizing this and using the Breaking Nightmare Seal, Xiao Yan successfully destroyed the illusion and brought everyone back to reality.
techniques.trivia:
It is originally a famous Dou Skill of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint.

Pure Lotus Demon Flame had obtained this inheritance after death of demon saint, and after thousand years give him enough time to gradually learn all the tricks of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint.

techniques.title: Nine Hell Palm
techniques.introText: Nine Hell Hand / Nine Hell Palm is a Dou Technique of a High tier or middle tier Xuan class Dou technique.

techniques.title: Nine Lightning Calamity Palm
techniques.introText: Nine Lightning Calamity Palm is one of the strongest Dou Techniques of the Lei Clan .
techniques.appearance: Lei Ying tried to use this technique with the help of Yan Jin to forcefully collapse the space tunnel made by the Nihility Devouring Flame.
techniques.trivia: Lei Ying tried to use this technique with the help of Yan Jin to forcefully collapse the space tunnel made by the Nihility Devouring Flame.

techniques.title: Nine Serene Soul Hand
techniques.introText: Nine Serene Soul Hand is a powerful attack technique that Old Ghost Zhai Xing unleashed to attempt to kill Xiao Yan during the Yao Chen rescue mission in theDeath Soul Mountain Range.
techniques.trivia: Xiao Yan Suffered Severe Wounds And Fatal Injuries After Receiving Old Ghost Zhai Xing's Powerful Attack, His blood vessels were destroyed and seventy percent of his bones were broken, leaving him in a coma and on the verge of death.

techniques.title: Nine Turning Wind Steps
techniques.introText: Nine Turning Wind Steps is an agility Dou Technique of Han Clan.
techniques.appearance:
The technique relies on wind-attributed Dou Qi to manipulate air currents, simultaneously accelerating the practitioner's movement speed and creating a disruptive, swirling wind around the battlefield.

It is able to stir a wild wind that would hide user's body, it was totally ineffective in the face of the probing Spiritual Strength.
techniques.history: Nine Turing Wind Steps ~ Five Turn displayed by Han Tian against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: It is the signature, reputation-defining technique of the Han Tian.

techniques.title: Octane Blast
techniques.introText: Octane Blast: Xuan High Level Dou Technique, close-combat Dou Technique. Focus’ on attacks and when mastered, attacks have eight different forces that stack up and the power is equal to a Di Low level Dou Technique!

techniques.title: Overlapping Waves
techniques.introText: A Low Xuan Dou Technique, was the strongest technique that Jia Lie Nu could fully control.

techniques.title: Pestering Snake Hand
techniques.introText: Pestering Snake Hand is a kind of extremely strong close range Dou Technique.
techniques.appearance:
The technique is nicknamed "One Pester" (the first half of Lin Xiuya's "One Pester, One Strong" reputation). It is a specialized close-range Dou Technique designed to neutralize an opponent's strength rather than meeting it head-on.

Lin Xiuya has practiced a kind of strange Dou Technique, ‘Pestering Snake Hand’. He is able to use this Dou Technique to completely suppress all your attacks within an extremely small area. Someone with weaker strength would basically be toyed with by him until their attacks would move with his wish. This ‘Pestering Snake Hand’ and Liu Qing’s ‘Great Rift Coffin Splitting Claw’ are completely different. If the latter is said to be incomparably strong and tough, this ‘Pestering Snake Hand’ belongs to the type that uses gentle force to subdue a tough one. I have fought with him a couple of times but I was strangely battered by that ‘Pestering Snake Hand’. If one were to discuss the degree of formability, this ‘Pestering Snake Hand’ is even stronger than the ‘Great Rift Coffin Splitting Claw’ of Liu Qing.

Pestering Snake Hand used by Lin Xiuya in Strong Ranking Grand Competition.
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Yan named this technique as “Sticky candy…” as an appropriate name.

This Dou Technique can be considered as Middle/High Level Xuan Class.

techniques.title: Pill Merging Sky
techniques.introText: Pill Merging Sky is one of the strong Dou Techniques used by the Pill Tower Ancestor.
techniques.appearance:
This technique when used, The finger of the ancestor of the Pill Tower was lifted. A drop of green blood seeped out of his pores. One seemed to be able to glimpse the strand of golden luster in that dense-green color. This green-colored blood swiftly flew toward the demonic flame divine figure the moment it escaped the ancestor’s body. It became larger as it flew. Within a short instant, it had turned into a thousand-foot-large green light ray. The light ray was accompanied by a dense fragrance as it shot through the sky.

Finally, it smashed into the chest of the enemy with lightning-like speed. Green light immediately filled one’s vision around them.

This technique can be at least of Tian Class, but its true grade is unknown. Pill Tower Ancestor was famous due to such techniques, and even old demons such as Hun Mo and others are scared of this technique. Even the Pure Lotus Demon Flame's one of the strongest techniques, the Demonic Flame Divine Statue, was smashed into the chest of the divine statue made of demonic flames with lightning-like speed. Green light immediately filled one’s vision, but one could see over half of the divine statue made of demonic flames melting away.

Pill Merging Sky used against Demonic Flame Divine Statue

Pill Merging Sky
techniques.trivia: The cyan-colored blood shimmering with a golden glow subdues the enemy as fast as lightning; it can even melt/fuse Demonic Flames. (Donghua)

techniques.title: Profound Sky Blood Palm
techniques.introText: Profound Sky Blood Palm is one of the strongest Dou Technique of Profound Sky Sect. It's at least a Dou Technique of Di Class High Tier or even Quasi or low Tian class Technique

techniques.title: Profound Sky Palm
techniques.introText: Profound Sky Palm is one of the best Dou Techniques that is found in the Profound Sky Sect. This Technique is of at least of Di Class Middle or High Tier Dou Technique .
techniques.trivia: Tian Ming used this technique to injure Yao Lao.

techniques.title: Pure Yang Cotton Hand
techniques.introText: One of the high class Dou Skills of the Burning Flame Valley. If one reaches complete mastery, one would be able to make one’s hands extend as one pleases. It will be able to obtain quite a unique effect when fighting with others.

techniques.title: Eagle Wings
techniques.introText: A High level Xuan class Flying Dou Technique. It was found by Xiao Yan inside the cave in Magic Beast Mountain Range.
techniques.appearance:
A black scroll. As the pitch-black scroll unfolded, two pitch-black eagle wings that caused him to slightly tremble appeared before his eyes. Since this pair of eagle wings were painted on the scroll, they were not too big. However they faintly emitted some warmth. Looking at this mysterious sight, it was obviously not just a simple picture.

The eagle wings were dark black in color with purple clouds faintly showing. If examined closely, the pair of wings was actually like black steel, possessing a special type of metal texture. The feathers on the eagle wings emitted a soft warmth and when Xiao Yan lightly blew on it, his expression could not help but become slightly alarmed. Under the light breeze, the feathers on the eagle wings unexpectedly swished up as if they were real. It was an extremely miraculous sight.

techniques.title: Qi World Transformation
techniques.introText: Profound Sky Technique, Qi World Transformation is one of the treasured technique that is preset in Profound Sky Sect. It is Dou technique that if mastered can go against a Tian class technique. It is also the strongest technique of Yaohua Liangjun.
techniques.trivia: This is the strongest technique of Yaohua Liangjun but in Donghua it was replaced by Qi Transformation of Heaven and Earth - which would create multiple hibiscus flower on a seal with Blood red colour.

techniques.title: Quiet Ghost Poison Claw
techniques.introText: Quiet Ghost Poison Claw is Di class High or Middle Level Palm Technique with a high affinity for poison and not many techniques can compare to it in its domain. It is used by the top elite of the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe.
techniques.trivia: Nine Serene Deep Ground Python First Elder used it against Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Quiet Woods Poisonous Snake Vine
techniques.introText: Quiet Woods Poisonous Snake Vine is Hu Jia's most powerful Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Radiance Seal
techniques.introText: Radiance Seal is presented as a high-level, destructive Dou Technique used by Han Feng during his peak confrontation with Xiao Yan.
techniques.appearance:
Han Feng’s eyes stared intently at the cluster of sun-like Dou Qi in his hand. A moment later, he suddenly raised his head. His face was covered with a savage insanity. With a brutal cry, the cluster of majestic sun-like Dou Qi shot explosively toward Xiao Yan.

An eye-piercing light drew across the sky. The light faintly revealed a large palm that appeared to be a sun falling from the sky as it carried a frightening energy that caused one’s hairs to stand on end!

Radiance Seal used by Han Feng on Xiao Yan

Radiance Seal used by Han Feng on Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: Using Flame Splitting Tsunami which is a Di Class Dou Technique, Xiao Yan counter this move of Han Feng.

techniques.title: Rain Heaven Erosion
techniques.introText: This is a Dou Technique of at least Di class used by the Mo Yu, Ninth Tianzun and Qiu Di, Eighth Tianzun.
techniques.trivia:
Seen in S5 EP 143

This technique requires a lot of energy, and if a person overexerts themselves, they may suffer backlash. Even the Eighth Tianzun, an elite in the late Dou Zun class, started coughing blood despite only slightly losing control.

techniques.title: Refining Sky Ancient Formation
techniques.introText: The Refining Sky Ancient Formation is a formation created by the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint.
techniques.appearance:
A hundred-thousand-foot-large fire array slowly appear in the empty sky, the endless magma sea begun to churn soon after the large array appeared in the sky. Soon, even it slowly formed an extremely huge fire formation. The fire array in the sky blotted out the sun. The two fire arrays appeared like two extremely huge fire plates that covered this realm from above and below.

The great array is personally placed by the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint, said to be an existence which was closest to a Dou Di during that era. The formation is not a single entity; it is divided into two massive components—one covering the Sky and one covering the Earth. When fully active, these appear as two massive, rotating fire plates that encompass the entire Demonic Flame Realm.

These large arrays had yet to unleash any attacks, but some of the experts whose strength had reached the Ban Sheng class immediately paled, some even ended up spitting up a mouthful of fresh blood. The combined power of the Refining Sky Ancient Formation—an attack that should have decimated even a six-star Dou Sheng, successfully blocked by the Saint's own residual power as manifested into a mysterious light shield.
techniques.history: The Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame tried to use the formation to refine all the cultivators into his slaves. This prompted the remnant soul of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Saint that was inside of Xiao Yan to takeover his body to stop him.
techniques.trivia: It is vastly more powerful than the Tianlou Sealing Demon Formation used by the Hall of Souls chief, Hun Mie Sheng.

techniques.title: Rending Claws
techniques.trivia: It is used by Xiao Ning.

techniques.title: Royal Sword Technique
techniques.introText: This is the Royal Sword Technique of the Ten Thousand Sword Pavilion. It is rumored that if one practices it to the highest level, one will be able to control the sword with one’s heart as well as move with the sword. One’s flying speed will also be extremely quick. This can be considered a unique technique of the Ten Thousand Sword Pavilion.

techniques.title: Seven Kill Spear
techniques.introText: Seven Kill Spear is a spear Dou Skill used by Yi Chen.
techniques.appearance: Seven Kill Spear transforms a blood spear into numerous bloody afterimages that attack all lethal spots on the enemy’s body. The attack is fast and dense, resembling a storm of spear thrusts.
techniques.history:
When Yi Chen used Seven Kill Spear, long spear danced and transformed into numerous bloody figures that shot toward Xiao Yan’s lethal spots. However, Xiao Yan used agility and afterimages to dodge the attacks and eventually caught the spear tip with two fingers.

Seven Killing Spear (Donghua)

Seven Killing Spear (Donghua)
techniques.trivia: Creates multiple bloody spear afterimages.

techniques.title: Shaking Lightning Arc Blast
techniques.introText: This ‘Shaking Lightning Arc Blast’ was a High Xuan Dou Technique. It was one of the high class Dou Techniques which Bai Shan had mastered. Back then, when he was training in the ‘Black-Corner Region’, he had once used this attack to seriously wound a strong Dou Ling, who could not raise his defences in time, before finally taking the person’s head.
techniques.trivia: Bai Shan used it with the intention to kill Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Shatter Rock Hand
techniques.introText: Shatter Rock Hand, a low Huang Level Dou Technique that only required 3 Duan Qi to learn!

techniques.title: Shocking Dormant Lightning Method
techniques.introText: Di class Middle level Dou Skill. It is a Dou Skill that forms a set with the ‘Rushing Lightning Mirror’.

techniques.title: Silver Lightning Shield
techniques.introText: Silver Lightning Shield is Xiao Li's life saving Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler
techniques.introText: Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler is a Di class Middle level ruler Dou Technique
techniques.appearance:
It was created a couple of centuries ago by the Six Joint zun-zhe who had dominated the continent back then. This ruler technique is a Dou Technique that made him renowned. Its strength is extremely strong. The only imperfection is that a ruler technique is somewhat unorthodox. Unless one has studied this weapon for decades, it is likely that one will have difficulty controlling it.

Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler, attacking and defending as one. It can attack when one advances and defend when one withdraws. It is the top Dou Skill that this Venerate (Dou Zun) has created. The ruler technique is separated into three levels: Splitting Fire, Body Flowing Fire, and Six Joint Fire. One can find a magma lake to train, lifting the magma wave and penetrating it. If one were to be able to pass through magma field as one pleases without relying on one’s Dou Qi with not even the slightest magma liquid touching oneself, then one could be considered to have gained a foothold in this skill. If one were to be sufficiently hard working, one would be able to achieve complete mastery over time, able to attack and defend together. No one of the same class or below would be able to approach one’s body!

Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler " Splitting Fire " ( Attack Mode ) Video

Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler " Body Flowing Fire " ( Defense Mode ) Video

Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler " Six Joint Fire " ( Attack Mode ) Video
techniques.trivia: Xiao Li brought Six Joint Body Flowing Ruler at Great Auction Fair in Black Emperor City for Xiao Yan.

techniques.title: Sky Bird Nine Flying Wings
techniques.introText: A flying Dou Technique manufacturing method which was used in crafting Xiao Yan's Bone Wings.
techniques.appearance: gem-like white bone wings
techniques.trivia:
Xiao Yan obtained Sky Bird Nine Flying Wings from the sect leader of the Gold Geese Sect.

In Donghua, they are called Bone Wings.

techniques.title: Sky Demon Blood Insect
techniques.introText: Sky Demon Blood Insect attack is a sinister technique used by Old Man Hun Mo to release a blood-red entity from a cloud of gathered souls, which then manifests as the Soul Curse Toad.
techniques.appearance: A summoning-type technique used by Old Man Hun Mo. It releases a high-speed blood-energy entity from a dark cloud. The user first creates a massive dark cloud filled with soul energy. Upon activation (“bite”), the cloud churns violently releases a blood-red streak of light. That streak moves at extreme speed, almost impossible to track. At first looks like a sharp, insect-like projectile, after slowing down or impact Reveals its true form (Soul Curse Toad).
techniques.history:
The seals formed by Hun Mo's hands suddenly change as the dark cloud above him, which blotted out the sun, suddenly emitted countless of sharp miserable screeches. One could even vaguely see an unimaginable number of figures struggling within the dark cloud.

That black cloud in the sky suddenly churned after Old Demon Hun Mo’s dark and cold cry sounded. A moment later, a fierce aura that did not belong to a human suddenly surged from the dark cloud. A piercing bloody light tore through the dark cloud like lightning in front of tons of pairs of shocked eyes. It wildly charged toward Xiao Chen at speed one could not react to.

Sky Demon Blood Insect used by Hun Mo.
techniques.trivia:
It’s not the main weapon itself, but the activation/summoning move. The real threat comes after it hits - Soul Curse Toad.

Hun Mo used this technique during his battle with Xiao Chen.

techniques.title: Sky Demon Puppet
techniques.introText: Sky Demon Puppet. This skill is not a Qi Method nor is it an ordinary Dou Technique. Instead, it is a puppet skill that has been passed down from ancient times. One must gather three items in order to refine the Sky Demon Puppet. A corpse, a spirit, and a Monster Core. The corpse is the device, the spirit is the guide and the Monster Core is the heart. This, accompanied by many other ingredients will ultimately form a Demon Puppet. The Demon Puppet is divided into three levels, Sky, Ground, and Man. The differences between them are determined by the ingredients and the flame used during the refinement. A Demon Puppet possesses an unending amount of strength, and does not have any emotion nor does it feel any pain. It is basically a killing machine.
techniques.trivia: Earth Demon Puppet was created from the body of Old Ground Demond Ghost and the soul of Protector Tie, combined with Rank 7 Monster Core.

techniques.title: Sky Evil Qi Shattering Claw
techniques.introText: Sky Evil Qi Shattering Claw is Di Class middle level Dou Skill belonging to the Gu Clan.
techniques.appearance:
The Sky Evil Qi Shattering Claw is an aggressive, high-class Di-rank Dou Skill utilized by the elite members of the Gu Clan. This technique is characterized by the gathering of a fierce, "evil aura" onto the practitioner's palm, which transforms their strike into a devastating claw force.

When unleashed, the sheer intensity of the energy is capable of tearing through space—leaving dark black scars in the air—and is accompanied by a sharp, deafening buzzing sound. Designed for lethality, the skill aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of high-speed "dragnet" strikes and raw, space-shattering power.

Sky Evil Qi Shattering Claw used by Yang Hao on Xiao Yan

techniques.title: Sky Feather Finger
techniques.introText: Sky Feather Finger, Xuan class Middle level. A finger Dou Technique is usually quite rare. Although it is somewhat difficult to practice, it is able to gain the element of surprise when fighting with other people.

techniques.title: Sky Incinerating Expelling Flames
techniques.introText: Three types of Heavenly Flames, one type of Beast Flames, and one type of mysterious Sun Flame. The five types of flames merged together and stimulated each other in the Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique. The final creation could only be described by the word ‘frightening.’

techniques.title: Sky Shattering Stone Steps
techniques.introText: Sky Shattering Stone Steps is a high-level agility Dou Technique unique to the Burning Flame Valley.
techniques.appearance:
To activate the technique, the practitioner channels flame-like Dou Qi into their feet and violently stomps on the ground. This physical impact is powerful enough to shatter tough rock and hurl the user forward or upward like a rocket, frequently breaking the sound barrier to create a deafening sonic boom and leaving physical cracks in the earth.

The momentum turns the user into a human-shaped tank, allowing them to instantaneously close large distances and overwhelm an opponent's spatial defenses. However, its overwhelming straight-line velocity trades off the fluid, evasive maneuverability found in standard lightning or wind-based agility techniques.

In contrast to agility-based techniques like the Three Thousand Lightning Movement which prioritizes nimble flexibility and phantom-like afterimages: the Sky Shattering Stone Steps is for raw forward velocity, immense momentum, and overwhelming destructive force.
techniques.history:
Wu Chen uses the skill in his 10 exchanges duel with Xiao Yan. After Xiao Yan succeeded in withstanding the first 5 exchanges Wu Chen thought he would win by using this skill, but the Three Thousand Lightning Movement is a higher tier technique and allowed Xiao Yan to persevere.

Wu Chen used Sky Shattering Stone Steps against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: It is similar to the Three Thousand Lightning Movement, but weaker.

techniques.title: Sky Walking Goose
techniques.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.
techniques.trivia: This Agility Technique Has Ability And Power Comparable To The Three Thousand Lightning Movement That Xiao Yan Used.

techniques.title: Skyfire Three Mysterious Change
techniques.introText: Skyfire Three Mysterious Change is Dou Skill created by Xiao Xuan who was Xiao Yan's ancestor - that was given to the Burning Flame Valley as a gift; As the creator of Burning Flame Valley, the Burning Flame Ancestor was a close friend of Xiao Xuan, the then patriarch of the Xiao Clan.
techniques.appearance: Xiao Yan’s gaze stared lazily at this black colored broken jade piece. He randomly held it in his hand. The jade piece that entered his hand was not smooth. Instead, it was covered with tiny granules and appeared as if the material was not very good. Moreover, there were some faint crack lines on the jade piece. Between the gaps there were even some soil stains.
techniques.trivia: After going to the Gu Realm and visiting his ancestor's tomb, he meets Xiao Xuan who bestows the complete version to him. This version has 9 parts and when completed displays the Xiao Clan's Clan Tattoo on his forehead.

techniques.title: Slaughtering Di Ghost Blood Blade
techniques.introText: Slaughtering Di Ghost Blood Blade is one of the most terrifying weapons in the entire Battle Through the Heavens universe. It serves as the ultimate trump card for the main villain, Hun Tiandi.
techniques.appearance:
The blood blade was extremely strange. It did not have a hilt the blood light lingering over it seemed to be able to even split this world!

The bright sun in the sky had dimmed as this strange blood blade appeared. The whole world gradually darkened. It appeared as though even the sun, moon and clouds were terrified of that strange blood blade!

techniques.title: Small Scale Angry Buddha Lotus Flame
techniques.introText: Combination of Green Lotus Core Flame with Purple Beast Flame.

techniques.title: Soul Destruction Palm
techniques.introText: Soul Destruction Palm is a Dou Technique of either Di Class High Tier or Low Level Tian Class mainly used by the top elites of Hun Clan and Hall of Souls.
techniques.appearance:
When using this technique the user 's hand seal changes, and he forms many complicated seals. The cold Dou Qi within their body formed a frightening black palm in front of there body with lightning-like speed. Sharp miserable cries continued to be emitted from the palm. There was a savage-looking face vaguely visible on it.

The dark-black palm was not very large, but it contained an extremely dark, cold, and powerful Dou Qi. This technique was one of the killing moves of Hun Yu one of the contenders for the seat of patriarch of Hun Clan and anyone who was well aware of the strength of the Soul Destruction Palm, an ordinary nine change peak Dou Zun expert would not be able to receive it, much less head-on, because the palm contained a dark chilling energy that eroded one’s soul which may as well cripple the enemy or even kill it.

Soul Destruction Palm (Video)
techniques.trivia: Hun Yu used this technique with his full might exhausting himself to just kill Xiao Yan with one move yet with a random strike from Xiao Yan he ended up spiting blood.

techniques.title: Soul Destruction Slash

techniques.appearance:
Black Qi surged from within before turning into many ferocious-looking souls. Sharp miserable screeches continued to charge into the bone blade. As these numerous souls surged into it, bright-red blood began to gradually appear on the dense, white surface of the bone blade. It appeared like a dark line of blood.

Soul Destruction Slash Video

techniques.title: Spatial Blood Escape
techniques.introText: Spatial Blood Escape is likely at the High Level of Di Class Dou Technique used in escape through spatial manipulation.
techniques.appearance:
The Spatial Blood Escape is a high-level, desperate movement technique typically used by elite practitioners (usually at the Dou Zong level or higher) to flee from a losing battle.

It requires the user to spray out "Essence Blood" (often by striking their own chest). Because Essence Blood represents a cultivator's core life force.

The spat-out blood forms a mist or "blood fog" that wraps around the user. This fog acts as a catalyst to distort space, allowing the user to bridge the gap between their current location and a distant point instantly. To an observer, the user appears to explode into a mist and vanish into a spatial crack, making it much faster and more unpredictable than standard flight.

Old Ground Demon Ghost trying to escape using Spatial Blood Escape
techniques.trivia: Powerful experts (like Old Bai and Old Qian), can track the residual blood energy or the spatial ripples left behind.

techniques.title: Spiritual Barrier Technique
techniques.introText: Spiritual Barrier Technique is a soul based defensive technique used by the Chief of the Hall of Souls.
techniques.appearance:
The body of the hall chief trembled because of danger. His soul surfaced from his brow, and the arms of his soul strangely exploded.

Black clouds suddenly surged from all directions and blotted out the sky. The sky was filled with black fog in an instant, and spiritual waves spread from it.
techniques.history:
When Xiao Chen used the Three Sky Breaking Axe, the Chief of the Hall of Souls activated the Spiritual Barrier Technique.
His soul surfaced from his brow, and his spiritual arms exploded, releasing black clouds that filled the sky. The technique created a dense spiritual barrier that attempted to block Xiao Chen's three axe strikes.
However, Xiao Chen's attack still penetrated the barrier, cutting through multiple layers of the black clouds and severely injuring the Chief of the Hall of Souls.

Spiritual Barrier Technique Video
techniques.trivia:
It creates a large black cloud like spiritual field that covers the sky.

Even after using this technique, it was still penetrated by Xiao Chen's Three Sky Breaking Axe.

During the explosion, there was no blood or flesh spattering. Instead, countless large dark green-colored energy snakes wormed out of the spot where the explosion occurred. When these huge snakes appeared, they began to swiftly fly in all directions.

techniques.title: Splitting Wind Tiger Roar Palm

techniques.appearance: This Dou Technique was used during the battle between Hun Feng and Xiao Yan, alongside God Seal Skill Four Seal merger, Flame Splitting Tsunami, Black Collapsing Force, and this Splitting Wind Tiger Roar Palm all together.
techniques.history:
Many extremely powerful Dou Skills were unceremoniously sent flying toward Hun Feng. Although Hun Feng was only an advanced two star Dou Sheng, this fellow was even more dangerous than the deputy chief of the Hall of Souls in Xiao Yan’s eyes.

“Flame Splitting Tsunami!”
“God Seal Skill! Four Seal merger!”
“Bang bang!
“Splitting Wind Tiger Roar Palm!”
“Black Collapsing Force!”

Hun Feng did not feel the slightest fear when these sharp attacks erupted from Xiao Yan at this moment. Not only did he not withdraw, he instead unleashed the Dou Qi within his body to its limits. Many extremely powerful high class Dou Skills were unleashed. They spread with shocking speed. In an instant, energy erupted in the sky, and the earth-shaking Dou Skills caused many to be quietly shocked.
techniques.trivia:
In novel, it is mentioned that these sharp attacks erupted from Xiao Yan, but Xiao Yan never obtained or use this technique before.

In donghua this type of technique is not shown while battle between Hun Feng and Xiao Yan when snatching the Demon Flame.

techniques.title: Ten Thousand Beast Spear Technique
techniques.introText: Ten Thousand Beast Spear technique is high level Di Class Dou Technique of Gu Clan
techniques.appearance:
The Ten Thousand Beast Spear Technique is characterized by an ice-cold expression and a cold glint surging within the eyes. The spear figure vaguely contains many wild beast roars while a wave of sharp desire to kill transforms into a sharp wind that rushes toward fatal spots from all directions. It is an extremely sharp beast roar executed with an ice crystal spear that emits a sharp wind.

The spear technique contains a hidden true killing blow within the illusory figure of the fierce beast. The long icy spear can act like a gyro as it suddenly rotates at great speed with after-images appearing and a whizzing wind being emitted. The spear’s body twists in a strange fashion where the tip of the spear is lifted and a frightening force shoots out.

This technique possesses a very strong sharp murderous intent when used. This technique has further classifications but when a person fully masters this technique, he is able to use its strongest form Ten Thousand Beast Spear Technique, Beast King Roar is a move where a countless number of spear figures gather together at a lightning-like speed. Majestic Dou Qi surges out of the ice crystal spear like floodwater and within the blink of an eye, it agglomerates into a fierce beast figure. The long spear rushes out and draws an extremely tricky arc that violently pierces toward the throat in a lightning-like fashion.

techniques.title: Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes
techniques.introText: Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes can be considered as Low/Middle Level Di Class Dou Technique.
techniques.appearance:
The Thousand Illusionary Ice Spikes is a high-level attack technique that prioritizes speed and lethal precision. It manifests as a swarm of small, black-colored ice awls launched from the fingertips that, despite their "inconspicuous" size, carry enough power to kill a Dou Huang with a single strike.

The black-colored ice awls might appear inconspicuous, but the winds that contained them were quite frightening. Forget about the attack coming from all directions. Even a single one of them would likely kill an expert Dou Huang. From this, it could be seen that this small thing was actually not as cute as its size.

The ice awls came in a lightning-like manner. In merely a flashed, they shot Dou Qi wall like a swarm of bees. However, these ice awl were corroded by the powerful strength contained within the wall after they had just shot into it. Thus, they swiftly turned into clusters of water that were vaporized.

Thousand Illusionary Mysterious Ice Spikes attack by Old Ground Demon Ghost on Little Fairy Doctor
