techniques.title: Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body
techniques.introText: 'Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body' is Di Class High Level Dou Technique of Wind Lightning Pavilion.
techniques.appearance:
Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body. The most prized treasure of the Wind Lightning Pavilion. It was rumored to be a Dou Technique passed down from the ancient times, Di Class High Level. Once this skill is mastered, it is possible to form a lightning illusionary body. The lightning illusionary body has a similar strength to the actual body. As long as the actual body does not die, the illusionary body will not be destroyed. This god-like effect could be described in four words—comparable to Tian Class!

The reason that the Wind Lightning Pavilion possessed its current position on the Central Plains today was related to this Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body. However, the difficulty of practicing this was extremely high. One of the requirements was that one needed to master the Three Thousand Lightning Movement until the highest level. During these years, there had been few people, within the entire Wind Lightning Pavilion, who had successfully mastered it.

The Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body might be frightening, but it is unusually difficult to practice. One of the requirements is that one must master the Three Thousand Lightning Movement until the highest level. During these many years, there have only been a few people throughout the Wind Lightning Pavilion who have successfully mastered it.

This Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body was indeed extremely mysterious. Moreover, the thing that surprised Xiao Yan the most was the harsh requirement of Spiritual Strength. No wonder there was hardly anyone within the Wind Lightning Pavilion who was able to successfully practice this skill. Other than some with extremely abnormal strength, how could an ordinary person achieve such a harsh Spiritual Strength requirement? Even if one managed to meet the requirement, the formation of the avatar was also quite difficult.

Originally, Xiao Yan had felt somewhat surprised that the Three Thousand Lightning Movement was actually related to it. Only by reading the Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body did Xiao Yan understand that the formation of this avatar would only have a slight chance of being successful when one had reached the highest level of the Three Thousand Lightning Movement.

Moreover, even if one successfully created it, this avatar was also divided into three categories, entry level, intermediate level, and mastery level.

These three categories represented the strength of the avatar. An entry level avatar would at most possess one-third of the actual body’s strength. An intermediate level would possess around two-thirds of the actual body’s strength while the mastery level would mean the avatar possessed a similar strength to the actual body.

techniques.title: Three Thousand Lightning Movement
techniques.introText: This ‘Three Thousand Lightning Movement’ seems to be the highest grade Agility Dou Technique of the Wind Lightning Pavilion of the continent.
techniques.appearance:
Three Thousand Lightning Movement Scroll

Three Thousand Lightning Movement an Agility Type Dou Technique, Di Class Low Level. After one learns it, one’s body would transform into a flash of lightning, being so quick that it would be terrifying. If a Da Dou Shi were to learn this, he would be in a position where he would not lose even when contending head on against a Dou Ling. It is really unexpected that this thing, which is regarded by the ‘Wind Lightning Pavilion’ as their lifeblood, would actually end up in Black-Corner Region.

The ‘Three Thousand Lightning Movement’ is an Agility Dou Technique that would cause a countless number of people to covet it, even when it is placed in the entire Dou Qi continent. Back then, Yao Lao once had the intention of borrowing this Dou Technique from the ‘Wind Lightning Pavilion’ to take a look. However, he was still turned away in the end. This is one of the Safeguarded Pavilion Treasures of the ‘Wind Lightning Pavilion.’ The creation of each scroll consumes a great amount of effort. This is because there is a thread of wind-lightning strength that the Pavilion Head seals within it. Only by absorbing this thread of wind-lightning strength will one be able to truly learn this unique ‘Three Thousand Lightning Movement.’ Therefore, only some people of the Elder level or extremely outstanding disciples who had great contributions to the Pavilion would have the qualification to practice it.

The Three Thousand Lightning Movement had a special meaning to the Wind Lightning Pavilion. Not only was it one of the top agility techniques in the Wind Lightning Pavilion, but only by mastering the Three Thousand Lightning Movement until the highest level would one possess the qualification to practice the Wind Lightning Pavilion’s most guarded skill.
techniques.trivia: Black Skeleton’s Tomb bought it for price over 10 million gold coins and in the Donghua it was 8 million.

techniques.appearance:
A vast, mighty Dou Qi fluctuation was emitted from the rotating storm. Immediately, the countless number of colorful cloths, that permeated the sky, suddenly entangled together. Within an instant, it formed a hundred-foot-large colorful phoenix in front of everyone’s eyes. The colorful phoenix was completely created from cloth. However, the enormous Dou Qi storm suddenly crumbled the moment it was formed. The storm transformed into a ten-foot-large Dou Qi pillar that shot into the body of the enormous, colorful phoenix.

With the disintegration of the Dou Qi storm, user's finger pointed at the colorful phoenix in the distance, and a drop of fresh blood flew from the finger. Finally, it landed on the body of the colorful phoenix. A life force formed in the colorful phoenix as the drop of fresh blood landed on its body, much to the disbelief of others. The majestic aura that was contained within it also became more wild and violent.

Wind Lightning Sacrifice displayed by Feng Qing Er against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia:
The primary purpose of this sacrifice is to act as a fuel for her ultimate attack Wind Killing Finger.

It can be considered as Low/Middle level Di Class Dou Technique.

techniques.title: Wind Spirit Fractal Sword
techniques.introText: Middle Xuan Dou Technique of the Misty Cloud Sect. A technique which allows the use to create swords of Dou Qi identical to the one the owner holds and use them as projectiles.

techniques.title: Wind’s Peak: Dazzling Sunset
techniques.introText: Wind’s Peak: Dazzling Sunset is a Xuan Class High Level Dou Technique of the Misty Cloud Sect.

techniques.title: Wind’s Peak: Killer Meteorite
techniques.introText: This terrifying Dou Technique was something that Yun Yun had used before when she fought with the Amethyst Winged Lion in the past. This attack had directly cut off an Amethyst Winged Lion’s horn, which was the hardest part of its body, which also possessed the strength of a Dou Huang. From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the piercing strength of this mysterious Dou Technique was. Moreover, the Dou Technique was currently displayed by Yun Shan. Regardless of whether it was momentum or the extent of the strength of the force, the Dou Technique this time had far surpassed the power that Yun Yun had displayed back then.
techniques.trivia:
This Skill Is One Of The Strongest Dou Techniques Of The High Level Xuan Class Of The Misty Cloud Sect.

In the past, Yun Shan once used this technique to kill two strong people in the same realm of the Chu Yun Empire, when he was still a Dou Huang.

Wind’s Peak: Killer Meteorite Video

Wind’s Peak: Killer Meteorite

techniques.title: Winter Cold Blood
techniques.introText: Winter Cold Blood is an ultimate defensive Dou Technique which can be considered as Di Class High Level.
techniques.appearance:
The technique is a high-level manifestation of ice-attribute Dou Qi. The expelled air swiftly swells to form a black, cold cloud over a hundred feet wide that completely envelops the user. The cloud creates a frighteningly low temperature that instantly freezes water vapor in the air into falling ice crystals. The cold is so invasive that it spreads like a ripple, causing even the Dou Qi inside the bodies of nearby observers to begin solidifying.

Winter Cold Blood
techniques.trivia: The technique was powerful enough to cover half the Inner Academy in a layer of frost almost instantly.

techniques.title: Withered Glory Palm
techniques.introText: Withered Glory Palm is one of the strong Dou Techniques used by the elites of Yan Clan.
techniques.appearance: Condenses Dou Qi into a massive, yellowish, withered palm. It strikes down fiercely, accompanied by a strange, eerie gust of powerful wind, carrying an overwhelming and intimidating momentum.
techniques.history:
It is a technique utilized by Yao Wangui against Xiao Yan; When executing the technique, Yao Wangui's hand appears somewhat ancient and yellowish. The strike is accompanied by a "strange wind" as it is slammed furiously toward the opponent.

Despite its name and the force behind it, the technique is completely ineffective against Xiao Yan. Upon contact with Xiao Yan's Fire Gathering Finger, the sharp wind generated by the palm is swiftly eroded, and the encounter ends with Yao Wangui receiving a heart-piercing pain, a bloody hole blasted into his palm, and being sent flying backward.
techniques.trivia:
This Technique is at least of Di Class its true tier is unknown.

It is one of Yao Wangui's strongest techniques.

techniques.title: Withered Leaf Great Poison Palm
techniques.introText: Withered Leaf Great Poison Palm is Di class High Level Palm Technique with a high affinity for poison and not many techniques can compare to it in its domain. It is used by the top elite of the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe.
techniques.trivia: Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe first elder used this technique to quickly kill Yao Ming.

techniques.title: Woeful Poison Calamity
techniques.introText: Woeful Poison Calamity is one of the strongest Technique used by the Little Fairy Doctor. This Technique grade is unknown but can be around Di Class High Tier or more.

techniques.title: Wood Aura Rise
techniques.introText: Wood Aura Rise is a Dou Techniques of the Hong Clan.
techniques.history:
When Xiao Yan was traveling with Han Xue their party was attacked by Hong Mu and Hong Lie and this is one of the attacks they tried to use against Xiao Yan.  He easily dispersed the attack as it was a flame attack.

Two cries erupted from Hong Lie and Hong Mu’s mouth. Immediately, a hot-red glow swept out like a flame. Behind it was a green-colored Dou Qi, which swiftly chased after it and merged into the flame. Immediately, the fiery-red Dou Qi’s momentum soared. The hot temperature caused the withered yellow leaves on the sides of the road to emit a ‘chi’ sound as ignited by themselves.
techniques.trivia: It doesn't state in the Novel who used this technique.

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Blood Skill
techniques.introText: Yellow Spring Blood Skill is one of the the Secret Dou Techniques that the Yellow Spring Pavilion posses and is used by their top elites.
techniques.appearance:
This Secret Techniques is of okay quality and can be used by someone with the rare Dark Type Dou Qi. It can raise someone's strength from a Quasi- Dou Zong to a genuine Dou Zong, but using it still carries quiet some risk. It is the last trick for members of the Pavilion.

This technique is quiet well known among the pavilion and is one of the reasons the Yellow Spring Pavilion stands as one of the strong faction in the Central Plains.

When it was used by Wang Chen his aura rose instantly and wildly like a fire arrow. Following the increase in strength of his aura, both of his eyes turned dark-black in color. The dark-black energy surged out of his body in all directions spreading out. Looking from a distance he appeared just like a ferocious ancient beast emitting a savage fierceness.

Yellow Spring Blood Skill used by Wang Chen
techniques.trivia: When Wang Chen used this technique Tang Ying called him a lunatic.

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Divine Anger
techniques.introText: Yellow Spring Divine Anger is one of the most powerful, a kind of sonic Dou Skill of Huang Quan.
techniques.appearance:
Yellow Spring Divine Anger is a Tian class high level sonic Dou Skill. It is a soul-based Dou Technique, making it devastatingly effective against even the strongest opponents. It was recorded in ancient texts that the Huan Quan Divine Anger was something that caused the expressions of even some elite Dou Shengs to change. At least nine out of ten top experts who had died fighting the Demon Saint Huan Quan had their souls forcefully shattered by the Huan Quan Divine Anger.

Xiao Yan using Yellow Spring Divine Anger

Yellow Spring Divine Anger
techniques.trivia:
In the donghua, Xiao Yan survived the Demon Saint's Yellow Spring Divine Anger primarily by forcibly channeling the power of the Heavenly Flame, while his strong soul foundation and the potential gained from the Bodhi Heart and the experience of a hundred lifetimes of reincarnation aided him.

This Sonic Dou Skill also known as Underworld Wrath or Underworld Sky Fury.

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Finger
techniques.introText: Yellow Spring Finger is a Low Level Tian Class Dou Technique created by the Demon Saint Huang Quan.
techniques.appearance:
Xiao Yan obtains it when he receives the inheritance of Demon Saint Huang Quan. It is a Dou skill that effects the soul and is most effective against magical beasts.

Yellow Spring Finger Video

Yellow Spring Finger Video
techniques.trivia: As the saying goes, "The Yellow Spring Finger decides life and death." This Low-rank Tian (Heaven) Class Dou Skill can condense into a giant finger. It descends with destructive power, causing the surrounding space to collapse instantly.

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Great Seal
techniques.introText: Sealing Skill, Yellow Spring Great Seal is one of the key Dou Skills of the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe.
techniques.appearance:
Yao Xiaotian furiously roared at the ceiling after transforming into his actual snake form. A frightening dark and cold force suddenly erupted from the Nine Serene Spring below as he roared. Under Yao Xiaotian’s control, this dark and cold force along with his own monstrous Dou Qi formed a black mountain-like seal. That seal was covered with numerous mysterious symbols.

Yellow Spring Great Seal Video - Yao Xiaotian attacked on Xiao Yan

Yao Ming Uses the Yellow Spring Great Seal

Yao Ming Uses the Yellow Spring Great Seal

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Palm
techniques.introText: Yellow Spring Palm is a Middle Level Tian Class Dou Technique created by the Demon Saint Huang Quan. It is a Soul Dou Skill and is most effective against Magical Beasts.
techniques.appearance:
The Yellow Spring Palm (黄泉掌 - Huáng Quán Zhǎng) is the second level of the "Three Great Yellow Spring Techniques" left behind by the legendary Yellow Spring Demon Saint. While its counterpart, the Yellow Spring Finger, focuses on piercing power, the Palm is designed for overwhelming, wide-scale destruction.

Xiao Yan displaying Yellow Spring Palm against two Dou Shengs

Yellow Spring Palm

Yellow Spring Palm attack from Yellow Spring Demon Saint

Yellow Spring Palm attack from Yao Ming on Xuan Mo
techniques.trivia: In this Dou Technique, Dou Qi condenses into several massive palm prints. The offensive momentum is exceptionally fierce and powerful; it can be used both to confront an enemy directly and to trap/entrap them. (Donghua)

techniques.title: Yellow Spring Rotten Corpse Arm
techniques.introText: Yellow Spring Rotten Corpse Arm is the extremely powerful Dou Skill of the Yellow Spring Pavilion.
techniques.appearance:
This Dou Skill was quite well-known across the Central Plains. When unleased the dark-black energy swiftly agglomerated as a dense corpse stench spread from Wang Chen’s right hand. Immediately, his entire arm turned as black as ink. The dark-black arm suddenly shot out with a low roar. A crack was formed in the air when the black arm struck out. The tough silver wood arena seemed to have met its nemesis as it swiftly lost its luster. Immediately, it was just like withered wood, turning yellowish and rotten.

Yellow Spring Rotten Corpse Arm displayed by Wang Chen

Yellow Spring Rotten Corpse Arm against Xiao Yan
techniques.trivia: Wang Chen uses the Rotten Corpse Arm as a follow-up to his Yellow Spring Blood Skill.

artifacts.title: 5 Wave Purple Gold Card
artifacts.introText: 5 Wave Purple Gold Card, in Dou Qi mainland, you have to be at least a Dou Ling (If Dou Zhe is first, Dou Ling is 4th) to have the honor of using this type of gold card that represents their rank, Of course, some special powers also have the privilege of getting the card.
artifacts.appearance: A purple gold card. On the card are five different waves of color.
artifacts.trivia: Five-lined purple gold card was something that only a Dou Ling had the qualification to manage and carry on this Dou Qi continent. Of course, nothing was ever absolute. According to common sense, a tier three alchemist also had this qualification.

artifacts.title: Acceptance Soul
artifacts.introText: Acceptance Soul can create a special space in your body which is used to store a Heavenly Flame. After all, if you have not completely refined the flame, the kind of destructive ability of a Heavenly Flame would incinerate everything, including your vortex and body, except this kind of space of nothingness.
artifacts.appearance: It was a grey-colored stone that was around the size of a thumb. The stone was as smooth as jade and did not have the slightest flaw. In the middle of the stone, there was a pale-blue glow that was slowly wiggling, much like a small worm that possessed a life force.

artifacts.title: Amethyst Lion Birth Essence
artifacts.introText: The Amethyst Winged Lion is a Magic Beast with innate talents. Otherwise, it would be difficult for it to become a rank six Magic Beast. When the Amethyst Lion gives birth, there is an extremely small chance that she would also give birth to this kind of Amethyst Lion Birth Essence along with the baby Magic Beast.
artifacts.trivia:
Yao Lao did not manage to find it despite breaking into eight Amethyst Winged Lion’s caves .

The small Amethyst Winged Lion was born with the Amethyst Lion Birth Essence, so it can grasp the status of the latter at any time.

Xiao Yan used Purple Smoke Fruit to lure the beast away and obtain the Amethyst Lion Birth Essence.

artifacts.title: Ancient Insect Emperor Cloth
artifacts.introText: The Ancient Insect Emperor Cloth is a high-level defensive treasure refined from Ancient Devouring Insect.
artifacts.appearance:
Its a cluster of black light with a smooth silk-like feeling and was extremely comfortable. When a drop of essence blood on the black light and the clothe immediately wiggled. It appeared like liquid as it moved over users hand and merged with his palm.

After merging with the body it appears as black clothes on the body with an extremely tough feeling.
artifacts.trivia:
Xiao Xuan made one for Xiao Yan.

Emperor Cloth that has been refined from an Insect Queen. Its value will not be any less than a Tian class Dou Skill, and it is a rare object that one can only obtain through luck. After all, a powerful existence like the Insect Queen cannot simply be obtained just because one wishes to.

artifacts.title: Asparagus Ice Fire Fruit
artifacts.introText: Asparagus Ice Fire Fruit is one of the four rare medicinal ingredients needed for refining of the Ground Spirit Pill.
artifacts.appearance:
A palm-sized fruit. This fruit was quite unique. Half of it was red in color while the other half was white in color. Xiao Yan could sense the heat seeping out from the red-colored side even though he was two feet away. The white-colored side, on the other hand, emitted a completely different ice-cold temperature. These two extremely different affinities were perfectly merged into one fruit. It must be said that nature was truly incomparably unique and unusual.

Additionally, there was faint line markings spreading out on the surface of this fruit which contained the two affinities of ice and fire. These lines all over the place and appeared to have a certain hidden pattern. However, if one was to carefully study it, one would see a cluster of complete mess that one could not understand.

artifacts.title: Black Bead
artifacts.introText: The black bead is a condensed manifestation of the devouring power belonging to the Nihility Devouring Flame.
artifacts.appearance:
A black-colored bead had gradually formed within Xiao Yan’s body after Little Yi swallowed the Nihility Devouring Flame’s flame seed since both of them were Heavenly Flames. He could sense a devouring power, which could even swallow one’s soul, within this bead.

The color of the bead was an extremely deep black. At a glance, it appeared just like a small black hole. It even felt like it was trying to pull one’s soul into it. It possesses an overbearing, non-discriminating devouring ability that swallows energy, Dou Qi, and life force.

If kept inside a human body, it relentlessly drains the user's own Dou Qi and life force. The energy absorbed by this devouring power was extremely impure, and the impurities within this energy agglomerated together because of the devouring power.
artifacts.history:
After completely swallowing the black light spot, Little Yi suddenly extended his little hand and grabbed at the empty space in front of him. An invisible ripple was quickly formed. The energy around this lake swiftly gathered into his palm. Within a short moment, the energy had transformed into a five-colored spotted crystal. This crystal was swallowed by Little Yi.
Xiao Yan was stunned as he watched this scene. After the impure energy crystal entered Little Yi’s body, it was swiftly separated into waves of aboriginal energy that appeared within Xiao Yan’s body without reason…

Xiao Yan’s face was stunned. It was a long while later before a thought passed through his mind. He began to refine that pure energy and turn it into Dou Qi, which he then merged into his body.
artifacts.trivia: As long as one was able to refine a flame seed from the Nihility Devouring Flame, one would gain the chance of obtaining its ability.

artifacts.title: Black Demon
artifacts.introText: Black Demon is the eighth ranked cauldron on the ‘Cauldron Ranking’.
artifacts.appearance:
A solid black-colored medicinal cauldron the size of the table surface suddenly appeared.

The black-colored medicinal cauldron had a sturdy body. Its entire body was faintly shrouded in a calm atmosphere. Life like flame pictures were drawn on the surface of the medicinal cauldron. These flame drawings even seemed to be physically real. Xiao Yan could even faintly sense flame energy starting to circle around the medicinal cauldron.

artifacts.title: Black Mirror Rock
artifacts.introText: Black Mirror Rock is a rare material that has the unique ability to reflect some attacks.
artifacts.trivia: Walls of the Black Emperor City are made from this material.

artifacts.title: Blood Essence Demon Fruit
artifacts.introText: The Blood Essence Demon Fruit was an extremely rare medicinal ingredient, a demonic fruit that absorbs essence blood. This fruit hid underground and absorbed the life force within essence blood before it eventually transformed into the shape of a fruit.
artifacts.appearance: A blood-red oval fruit was lying within the jade box. A blood aura seeped from it, causing it to emit waves of life force.

artifacts.title: Bodhisattva Ancient Tree
artifacts.introText: The Bodhisattva Ancient Tree would enter the top three if every natural treasure across the entire Dou Qi continent were to be ranked!
artifacts.appearance: There is a kind of mysterious ancient tree within a sparsely populated mountain. It is named the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree. The rhizome of this tree, buried deep underground, will gradually form a thick heart-shaped item that will possess a mysterious effect. It slowly agglomerates over the years. Hence, there are people who call it the Bodhisattva Heart. However, normally speaking, it would require the accumulation of over a thousand years for the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree to form a Bodhisattva Heart. The Bodhisattva Body Transformation Saliva is a mysterious item that is secreted from the surface of this Bodhisattva Heart.
artifacts.history:
Attacked from a black clothed enemy who was a Dou Di

Wanted to snatch its sprit and use it to heal his injuries

Another Dou Di who helped the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree

Bodhisattva Ancient Tree is an existence of an ancient time and posses strength of a Dou Di according to its memory it had an attack from a black clothed enemy who was also a Dou Di who wanted to snatch its sprit and use it to heal his injuries but the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree didn't lay standing and struck back with monstrous energy but at that time another person appeared in white clothes another Dou Di who helped the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree. He was the enemy of the black clothed Dou Di but even then the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree was injured but they defeated the black clothed Dou Di but the person's sprit didn't stop and entered the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree at the time the Dou Di's sprit put all the negative emotion into the body of the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree which with time change the nature of the the tree turning it from divine and peaceful to sinister and chilly.
artifacts.trivia:
This Bodhisattva Ancient Tree could likely be considered as rare an existence as a phoenix feather and unicorn horn even in the entire Dou Qi continent. 

It is also referred as Ancient Towering Tree.

artifacts.title: Bodhisattva Heart
artifacts.introText: Bodhisattva Heart is one of the divine treasures produced by the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree, a legendary tree that appears once every thousand years.
artifacts.appearance: The rhizome of Bodhisattva Ancient Tree, buried deep underground, will gradually form a thick heart-shaped item that will possess a mysterious effect. It slowly agglomerates over the years. Hence, there are people who call it the Bodhisattva Heart. However, normally speaking, it would require the accumulation of over a thousand years for the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree to form a Bodhisattva Heart.
artifacts.trivia:
Once someone obtains Bodhisattva Heart advancing to saint is not big deal. Xiao Yan was able to reach 1-star Dou Sheng after refining it along with help of Bodhisattva Pill.

Bodhisattva Heart rewarded to Xiao Yan was hidden itself within his body which is why no one was able to detect its presence.

artifacts.title: Bodhisattva Seed
artifacts.introText: The Bodhisattva Seed, like the Bodhisattva Heart, was something that originated from the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree. However, this kind of rare item was just as rare as the Bodhisattva Heart. Normally, it would transform into powder in an instant after falling from the Bodhisattva Ancient Tree. It was extremely difficult for an outsider to obtain.

artifacts.title: Bone Flame Ring
artifacts.introText: Bone Flame Ring is also known as Black Ring. In the earlier part of the story Bone Flame Ring was called Black Ring.
artifacts.appearance: A dark-black storage ring with simple design.
artifacts.history:
Bone Flame Ring is a ring in which Yao Lao hid his spririt.

The black ring had a simple design. On it were some markings as well. This was the only present Xiao Yan's late mother gave to him before she passed. He started wearing it since the age of 4 and even now, 10 years later, he was still wearing. It was a precious gift from his mother and Xiao Yan treasured it dearly.

Yao Lao had luckily obtained an extremely rare ‘Warm Soul Spirit Ring’ when he was helping other people refine medicinal pills back then. In the end, he got someone to help him create the black-colored ring. It was because of this that he managed to escape being killed by Hall of Souls. Finally, the ring went in circles and landed in Xiao Yan's mother’s hands before finally being passed on to Xiao Yan.

The space within this dark-black ring was something that even the high grade ‘Serene Sea Storage Ring’ on Xiao Yan’s hand had difficulty comparing to. Of course, the most valuable thing was not this ring but the many things that were stored within the ring.

Within the storage ring was all that Yao Lao had accumulated in his lifetime. Medicinal Formulas, Qi Methods, Dou Techniques, and some other strange things were piled inside it. A wide range of things were piled together, causing eyes to be dazzled.

Xiao Yan randomly flipped some of the Qi Methods and Dou Techniques. He was once again speechless to discover that it was extremely difficult to find any low class items within them. The lowest class of Qi Methods and Dou Techniques were all at the Xuan Class Low Level. Xiao Yan actually even saw some Di class Qi Methods and Dou Techniques upon detailed observation. However, it was obvious that there were very few items of this class. After counting, the combined number of them did not exceeded twenty.

Despite this, the things that were hidden here already caused Xiao Yan to be astounded. This was really a treasure repository that was sufficient enough to cause a countless number of people to flock over in doves. Fortunately, only he alone was aware of these things. Otherwise, anyone who possessed so many high class Qi Methods and Dou Techniques would definitely invite the envy of a countless number of people.

artifacts.title: Bone Spirit Fruit
artifacts.introText: This was the so-called Bone Spirit Fruit. The refinement of the few key ingredients was extremely arduous. If one did not possess a special refinement method, it would be difficult to refine the portions that one needed. This was the case for the Dragon Blood Ganoderma, for the Bone Spirit Fruit, and for the Mysterious Sky Green Vine.

artifacts.title: Bright Square Fire
artifacts.introText: Bright Square Fire is a medicinal cauldron purchased by Xiao Yan on Great Auction Fair in Black Mark City. Xiao Yan spent four hundred thousand to purchase it.

artifacts.title: Cold Edge
artifacts.introText: This sword is named ‘Cold Edge’. It is molded from cold metal and is said to be able to cut iron like one would cut soil. Moreover, it is perfectly embedded with a rank three ice affinity Monster Core. If a person who practices water or ice affinity skills uses it to fight with an opponent, their strength will definitely be increased. Powerful magical weapons are something that one must bring when going out.
artifacts.appearance: A longsword which was entirely blue, reflecting a thick, cold luster as the light reflected off of it. Seeing the energy traces flowing on its body, it was clearly a Monster Core weapon that a renowned blacksmith had meticulously created.

artifacts.title: Core Bead
artifacts.introText: Core Bead. Normally, it was called the Core Fire Bead, also Heart Pearl or Earth Core Pearl which are translation of "地心珠". It was a kind of energy bead formed from essence energy that was found deep underground after a countless number of years. This kind of bead contained an extremely vast, mighty energy within it. It was rumored that some tier 8 or even tier 9 medicinal pill would use this legendary Core Fire Bead.
artifacts.trivia: A Core Bead is a key ingredient in refining the Core Lightning Bead

artifacts.title: Core Lightning Bead
artifacts.introText: The Core Lightning Bead was not a medicinal pill. Instead, it was a refinement that utilized an extremely unorthodox formula. It referred a kind of strange refining method to refine the Core Bead. If the refinement was a success, it would end up forming a Core Lightning Bead. This thing could not be consumed by a person, but it possess an extremely terrifying might. Even an elite Dou Zun would at least suffer serious injuries even if they did not die should they be struck head-on by this thing.

artifacts.title: Core Mother Jade
artifacts.introText: Core Mother Jade was a mysterious gem that formed from the agglomeration of the strength of the land over a countless number of years. Due to the special calmness and heaviness of the strength of the land, Core Mother Jade was a treasure that an expert would find it difficult come across even with vast amounts of money. If one used a seat created from Core Mother Jade when one trained or refined pills, it would suppress the wild and violent energy within one’s body. With this thing, the chances of one deviating from the norm during training and entering a dangerous state would essentially be non-existent.
artifacts.appearance: A snow-white jade rock.

artifacts.title: Core Soul Marrow
artifacts.introText: Core Soul Marrow was a kind of extremely unique treasure. Moreover, this thing was very attractive to alchemists because this thing could forge one's soul!This so-called forging would temper and refine one’s soul. In other words, this Core Soul Marrow could purify one’s soul.  This Core Soul Marrow could not be consumed directly. It required some other natural treasures to mediate it in order to unleash its full effect.
artifacts.appearance: A viscous, white-colored liquid.

artifacts.title: Core-Fire Lotus Seed
artifacts.introText: The Core-Fire Lotus Seeds are located in the Green Colored Lotus Platform. This Core-Fire Lotus Seed that is known as the essence of flame spirits is something that requires a hundred years to form. If you go out and shout that you have a Core-Fire Lotus Seed, even a Dou Huang would use all his might to exchange with you. Of course this is excluding those who prefer a more direct method like killing and robbing you. If you take any of these things out, you would turn the Jia Ma Empire into an upheaval.

artifacts.title: Deep Green Fruit
artifacts.introText: Deep Green Fruit is one of the main ingredients in refining this ‘Deep Green Longevity Pill’. Dense lifeforce could be sensed within it.
artifacts.appearance: A green thorny fruit that faintly emitted a rich fragrance.

artifacts.title: Deep Green Longevity Pill
artifacts.introText: Deep Green Longevity Pill, a tier six medicinal pill that is able to raise one’s lifespan by nearly ten years. One individual can only consume one pill in their lifetime. The refining ingredients, Deep Green Fruit, King Longevity Starch, Ten Thousand Years Vine.

artifacts.title: Demonic Flame Rock
artifacts.introText: Demonic Flame Rock are the crystals filled with fire affinity energy due to Demonic Flame.
artifacts.appearance:
The individual crystals that were filled with a wild and violent fire affinity energy were called ‘Demonic Flame Rock’ because these crystals seemed to possess an extremely faint trace of remains from the demonic flame. Although this lingering demonic flame had been diluted thousands of times over, it was still an absolute treasure for those who practiced fire affinity Dou Qi and alchemists. As long as one was able to absorb the energy within these Demonic Flame Rock, one’s Dou Qi would not only become stronger, even the flame that an alchemist summoned would also grow more powerful than before.

Because of their immense value, many factions like the Sky Mansion Alliance and the Hall of Souls established territories to mine them, frequently fighting bloody battles every three to five days to control the richest veins.
artifacts.trivia:
They were found in Demonic Flame Plains.

Bringing back ten Storage Rings filled with Demonic Flame Rocks would allow an entire section of the Sky Mansion Alliance to be raised to inner alliance disciples.

Commander Liu leading the members of Sky Mansion Alliance was in charge for extraction of these rocks, ambushed by Protector Mo but later rescued by Xiao Yan.

artifacts.title: Dragon Phoenix Ancient Armour
artifacts.introText: The Dragon-Phoenix Ancient Armor  is an incredibly powerful and rare defensive treasure. It is one of the most prominent legendary artifacts associated with ancient beast bloodlines (Dragon Phoenix).
artifacts.appearance: Dragon Phoenix Ancient Armour is the armor with strongest defensive strength of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe. It looks like purple dragon scales underneath ones skin.
artifacts.trivia:
Chinese: 龙凰古甲 (Lóng Huáng gǔ jiǎ)

Zi Yan gave it to Xiao Yan when she became the Dragon Empress.

artifacts.title: Dragon Phoenix Crystal
artifacts.introText: The Dragon Phoenix Crystal is a condensed energy state formed from the Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit when it's power cannot be fully absorbed by the inheritor.
artifacts.appearance: The Dragon Phoenix Crystal is a condensed energy state formed from the Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit when its power cannot be fully absorbed. Instead of dispersing, the excess energy solidifies and encases the inheritor’s body, placing them in a suspended, living dead condition. The crystal contains terrifying dragon phoenix energy and is extremely difficult to refine or break.
artifacts.history:
Zi Yan attempts to inherit the Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit in order to awaken her full royal bloodline. However, her body is unable to completely absorb the fruit’s overwhelming energy. As a result, the energy solidifies into the Dragon Phoenix Crystal, sealing her entire body and stripping away all visible life force. Though she does not die, she becomes trapped in a crystalized state, forcing the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe to seek help from Xiao Yan.

Only a high-ranked Heavenly Flame, particularly one within the top ten of the Heavenly Flame Ranking, could refine the Dragon Phoenix Crystal without harming Zi Yan. Xiao Yan, possessing multiple Heavenly Flames was entrusted with the task. He began refining the crystal by carefully melting the solidified energy and forcing it back into Zi Yan’s body, marking a crucial turning point for the future of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.

artifacts.title: Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit
artifacts.introText: This kind of fruit requires the absorption of the lifeforce from an Ancient Void Dragon and a Ancient Heaven Phoenix in order to gain a ten percent chance of being born.
artifacts.appearance: This fruit was the size of a palm. It was both golden and purple in color. If one was to carefully observe it, one could discover that the golden half was twisting and turning, appearing just like a shrunk version of an Ancient Void Dragon. The other purple half was dancing with spread wings… a phoenix? That’s right. It was indeed a Heaven Demon Phoenix.
artifacts.trivia:
Even in the records of the Ancient Void Dragon, this Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit had only appeared for a mere five times. This is the sixth time.

It has only successfully been absorbed twice. One was obtained by the Heaven Phoenix. Hence, the Heaven Phoenix tribe produced an extremely powerful person. During that period of time, even the Ancient Void Dragon tribe was completely suppressed by them. Fortunately after a couple of hundred years, Ancient Void Dragon tribe finally obtained a Dragon Phoenix Origin Fruit and managed to turn things around. However, during the final bloody battle between the two tribes, those two experts, who possessed extremely powerful bloodlines, ended up dying together.

Zi Yan refined it with Xiao Yan's help and became the Dragon Empress.

artifacts.title: Dragon Purple Cloth
artifacts.introText: Dragon Purple Cloth is similar to the Dragon Phoenix Ancient Armour, but is not as strong.

artifacts.title: Dragon Soul Bead
artifacts.introText: Dragon Soul Bead is a treasure of the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe.
artifacts.appearance:
This Dragon Soul Bead can be considered a terrifying as well as a bloody weapon. As it is made after the Ancient Void Dragon Tribe scarifies the the souls of tens to hundred thousands souls of the tribe member and suppress into a bead that is then called Dragon Soul Bead.

This relic can only be made by someone who has attained the strength of 5 star peak to 6 star Dou Sheng and has the bloodline of the tribe.

Once constructed the one blood-colored bead releases terrifying soul power that also releases negative emotion of anger, hostility, etc. and if the creator where to just throw this blood-colored bead at someone who is around the strength of 5 star Dou sheng they will instantly be torn apart to shreds.
artifacts.trivia:
The dragon souls imprisoned within it suffer immense torment, unable to live yet unable to die.

Northern Dragon King tried to use it against Xiao Yan to kill him.

Xiao Yan used the Pure Lotus Demon Flame to refine the Dragon Soul Bead.

artifacts.title: Drunken Demon Saliva
artifacts.introText: Xiao Yan used this while refining Pure Lotus Demon Flame.
artifacts.appearance:
This pale-red liquid was called Drunken Demon Saliva. It boasted an extremely intense numbing effect. Xiao Yan used if for refining of the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame. Of course, Xiao Yan did not hope to completely numb the demonic flame. He only wished to borrow the medicinal effects of this thing to cause the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame to remain lazy. In this way, the demonic flame’s strength would fall slightly and increase the refinement effect.

After the Drunken Demon Saliva fell into the lotus, even the flower petals had an additionally scent of laziness. The Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame might still possess some spirituality but it did not possess any true intelligence. It still needed to have contact with humans for a period of time before it would become as intelligent as the previous Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame.
artifacts.trivia: Its name not mentioned in Donghua.

artifacts.title: Earth Core Spirit Serum
artifacts.introText: The medicinal pill refined by it can attract a six-colored Pill Lightning. This medicinal ingredient emits shocking energy.
artifacts.appearance: The medicinal pill refined by it can attract a six-colored Pill Lightning. This medicinal ingredient emits shocking energy.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan found this while roaming around in Spatial Trade Fair with Cai Lin and Little Fairy Doctor.

artifacts.title: Energy Core
artifacts.introText: It stores extremely pure energy, and it is the extremely nourishing thing.
artifacts.appearance: A  rhombus-shaped thumb-sized crystal. It glowed with an extremely rich energy fog.

artifacts.title: Falling Soul Powder
artifacts.introText: Its name may be a little frightening, but it is not purely a poison. This is something that I found in the Seven colored Poison Book and is the highest grade medicinal powder that Fairy Doctor was currently able to make.  This ‘Falling Soul Powder’ emits a smell that irritates the eyes. Moreover, she have also added some special things in it. If you meet any strong person whom you cannot handle in the future, you can scatter it on the other party. If he or she is caught off guard, even if the other person is a Da Dou Shi, the piercing smell released by it would cause them to temporarily close their eyes. During this time, there would be an opportunity to flee.

artifacts.title: Fire Crystal Card
artifacts.introText: Fire Crystal Card is a exclusive item of Inner Academy which is used for storing Fire Energy.

artifacts.title: Fire Demon Halberd
artifacts.introText: Fire Demon Halberd is a Dou Technique that forms a halberd from the magma using the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame.
artifacts.appearance: Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame
artifacts.trivia: It used to belong to the Pure Lotus Demon Saint.

artifacts.title: Fire Energy
artifacts.introText: Fire Energy is the unique and essential currency used by students of Inner Academy. It isn't just money for food or gear; it is primarily a "fuel" for cultivation.
artifacts.appearance:
Fire Energy’ is the most important thing in the Inner Academy. This is also the reason why the strength of the new students would increase by leaps and bounds after entering the Inner Academy to train. The blue-robed young man hesitated before answering this question for quite a while before he helplessly opened his mouth to speak when Xiao Yan grasped the hilt of the Heavy Xuan Ruler with his hand: In the Inner Academy, there is a ‘Sky Flame Qi Training Tower’ buried underground. If one were to train within the tower, one would be able to obtain the strange effect of gaining more with less effort. Moreover, the farther down one goes to train in the tower, the faster the training speed. Of course, the price is also expensive to the point of being outrageous.

If one wanted to enter the ‘Sky Flame Qi Training Tower’, one must have sufficient ‘Fire Energy’ in their Fire Crystal Card for the expenses. ‘Fire Energy’ appears in numbers of days. The Fire Crystal Card in your hands is able to cover the cost of you all training in the tower for five days. After five days, you can only go and earn ‘Fire Energy’ by yourself. Of course, on the first day of every month, the Inner Academy will also give everyone seven days worth of ‘Fire Energy’ as living expenses.

In the Inner Academy, you can obtain ‘Fire Energy’ using various different means. For example, you can sweep the tower, copy scrolls, etc. Naturally, the ‘Fire Energy’ one gets by relying on this is way too little. Therefore, some of the stronger students would go and hunt Magical Beasts, using their Monster Core to exchange for ‘Fire Energy’. Alternatively, they can find someone to challenge. As long as the other party agrees, they would be able to compete in the Inner Academy’s Sports Arena. The one who wins would be able to obtain the ‘Fire Energy’ that is deducted from the loser. In summary, there are quite a number of methods to obtain ‘Fire Energy’. However, there is one precondition. That is you must have sufficient strength. Otherwise, not only will you not be able to earn ‘Fire Energy’, but you will also lose everything you have.

There is one more method to earn ‘Fire Energy’. That is to ascend to the top of the ‘Strong Ranking’ in the Inner Academy. As the name suggests, this is the ranking system that is used to measure one’s strength. It is also the ranking that is worth the most in the Inner Academy. There are only fifty names on the ranking. As long as you are able to grasp a position on it, you will be able to obtain the reward that the Inner Academy issues each month. The reward is linked with the rank. One would naturally get more the higher up the ranking they are. In that case, they would be able to hide themselves within the ‘Sky Flame Qi Training Tower’ all day to train and need not worry about exhausting the ‘Fire Energy’. Therefore, all the students in the Inner Academy are working hard and striving towards this ‘Strong Ranking’. That competition is so intense, that it simply leaves one speechless. There are many people who got onto the ranking on the first day before they were pulled down on the second day by people who desperately challenged them.

The Hunting Competition: As mentioned before, seniors steal it from newcomers, and Xiao Yan famously stole it from seniors.

The Fighting Arena: Winning duels against other students is the most common way to earn Fire Energy.

Selling Pills: Since Xiao Yan is a talented Alchemist, he earned massive amounts of Fire Energy by refining and selling medicinal pills to other students through his faction, Pan's Gate.

Academy Missions: Completing tasks assigned by the academy elders.

Monthly Stipend: The academy provides a very small base amount to students each month, but it is rarely enough for serious cultivation.

Strong Ranking Grand Competition

artifacts.title: Fire Lightning Bead
artifacts.introText: This kind of bead formed from the agglomeration of flames was called Fire Lightning Bead. Xiao Yan had discovered it in some of the scrolls Yao Lao had left behind. This thing could be considered quite unique. A special technique was required to compress a flame to the extreme. Finally, it would form this bead shape.

artifacts.title: Fire Lotus Bottle
artifacts.introText: Fire Lotus Bottle, contains a small scale Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.  Although the explosion created will not possess the kind of power of a true Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, it will certainly be quite useful during critical moments.
artifacts.trivia: Creator -  Xiao Yan

artifacts.title: Fire-Mountain Flame Cauldron
artifacts.introText: This is tier five medicinal cauldron. Back then, Gu He used it to take the champion spot during that year’s Grand Meeting.
artifacts.appearance: An ancient looking red cauldron containing a faint, deep aura.

artifacts.title: Flame Gathering Pot
artifacts.introText: This thing was created by a Hall Guardian of the Inner Academy. He calls this a ‘Flame Gathering Pot.’ If you are able to insert a thread of genuine Fallen Heart Flame essence into it, it would be able to unceasingly produce Heart Flame as long as someone repeatedly poured Dou Qi into it in the future. Of course, the effect of this kind of Heart Flame is naturally not comparable to the extremely powerful effect of the Heart Flame created by the actual body of the Fallen Heart Flame. However, it still possesses some effect on increasing one’s training speed.
artifacts.appearance: A strangely shaped item that had been created by transparent glass .

artifacts.title: Flame Leaving Pills
artifacts.introText: These are Flame Leaving Pills that Xiao Yan has refined. Each of them contained a trace of strength from a Heavenly Flame. You can consume one when you refine the Dou Qi. It will aid you in increasing the speed of refinement. At the same time, it will also allow your Dou Qi to be refined until it is extremely pure.

artifacts.title: Golden Sawtooth Disc
artifacts.introText: It is rumored that this weapon of Qian Mo is called Golden Sawtooth Disc. It has shocking momentum when thrown. Moreover, it is extremely accurate and vicious. If ten of these Golden Sawtooth Discs were to be thrown out together, it would be something that would really cause one to have a headache.
artifacts.appearance: A circular sawtooth golden-colored item. The circular yellow-colored sawtooth disc was merely the size of a palm. However, the numerous sharp saw-teeth on its edge faintly contained a cold penetrating glow.

artifacts.title: Goose Feather Ring
artifacts.introText: This is an unique weapon of the Gold Geese Sect. It is extremely tricky and vicious. Moreover, if it is used in collaboration with their Qi Method and can be quite strong.
artifacts.appearance:
This weapon was somewhat like a golden ring but its outside edge was covered with a sharp hidden thorn. The purple glint that faintly appeared on the hidden thorn was clearly covered with a lethal poison.

Using the technique Fire ring explosion they could release harmful projectiles on the intended target

artifacts.title: Green Colored Lotus Platform
artifacts.introText: This green colored lotus platform is formed from the agglomeration of the planet’s flame for a thousand years. As long as you remove it and sit on it to train in the future, your training speed may not be able to increase by ten times but an increase of three to four times should be possible. Moreover, you can activate it using your Dou Qi when you meet an enemy and release the Core Flame contained within it. If you meet a person at the Dou Ling level, you may not be able to defeat him but you should meet no resistance when fleeing.
artifacts.trivia:
It had been destroyed by the ‘Fallen Heart Flame’ while Xiao Yan was underground.

It was able to help Xiao Yan reach Dou Wang

artifacts.title: Green-Flame Cauldron
artifacts.introText: This is a tier five cauldron. There were quite a number of tier four alchemists had gotten into a big fight over it back then.
artifacts.appearance: An ancient looking green cauldron containing a faint, deep aura.

artifacts.title: Gu Jade Token
artifacts.introText: This Blood Jade Token possessed an extremely powerful deterrence within the Gu clan.
artifacts.appearance: A palm-sized, blood-red jade tablet . There was a flamboyant ‘Gu’ word written on it!

artifacts.title: Heart Blood Jade Pendant
artifacts.introText: That thing was something the ancestor of Luo Clan had personally made for Luo Xiao Yao. She was told not to use it unless it was a critical moment. It was unexpected that she actually took this thing out over such a small matter.

artifacts.title: Heavenly Flame Lengthen Ancient Ruler
artifacts.introText: Heavenly Flame Lengthen Ancient Ruler is the ultimate, legendary weapon manifested by Xiao Yan to defeat Hun Tiandi.
artifacts.appearance:
Heavenly Flame Lengthen Ancient Ruler is summoned by combining 22 Heavenly Flames on the Heavenly Flame Square. A brilliant coloured ancient ruler appears at the point where the flames merged.

This was a mysterious object that only existed during the ancient times. Very few of those ancient experts had even seen it before.
artifacts.history:
Xiao Yan uses his status as the Flame Di to command all the flames across the Dou Qi Continent to gather at the Heavenly Flame Square. When all 22 distinct flame pillars shoot into the sky and merge at a single central point, they solidify into a brilliant, multi-colored ancient ruler.

The terrifying storm from the clash instantly cut the defensive barrier of the Sky Mansion Alliance, sent everyone flying by ten thousand feet, and exploded the meteorite at the location of the Star Realm into dust. The force of the wind smashed the Heavenly Flame Square directly into the ground, creating a fifty thousand kilometer large deep pit.
artifacts.trivia:
Xiao Yan manifested this ruler to counter Hun Tiandi's Slaughtering Di Ghost Blood Blade.

The clash between the Ruler and Hun Tiandi's Blood Blade was so violent that it completely shattered the divine Dou Di bodies of both combatants, reducing Hun Tiandi to a weakened state where he could finally be sealed.

While there are 23 stone pillars on the Heavenly Flame Square, only 22 flames merged to create the ruler itself. The 23rd central pillar was later occupied when Xiao Yan self-ignited his own Dou Di body to create the final sealing array.

artifacts.title: Heavenly Flame Square
artifacts.introText: This is the Heavenly Flame square that was taken out from the Ancient God Mansion. There are 23 places on this square where the 23 Heavenly Flames are summoned. Xiao Yan used this thing to summon the Heavenly Flame Lengthen Ancient Ruler when he became Dou Di and by summoning 22 Heavenly Flames, he launched the final attack on Hun Tiandi.

artifacts.title: Heavy Xuan Ruler
artifacts.introText: Heavy Xuan Ruler (Heavy Black Ruler) is a heavy black iron ruler with strange and special patterns on it. Yao Lao gave Xiao Yan when he come to train in the Magic Beast Mountain Range.
artifacts.personality:
玄重尺 (Xuán Zhòng Chǐ)

玄 (xuán) means Black, dark, mysterious, or profound.

重 (zhòng) means Heavy

尺 (chǐ) means Ruler (a Chinese measuring unit, but frequently used in fantasy/wuxia novels to describe a wide, flat, sword-like weapon that lacks a sharp edge).
artifacts.history:
It was made of Flame Meteorite, it was extremely hard and heavy, and it had the unique ability to suppress Dou Qi. Xiao Yan used this characteristic to practice hard in the Jia Ma Empire. On the surface of the pitch-black giant ruler, there are some vague and strange lines painted one after another. From the lines to the handle of the ruler, almost all parts of the ruler body are covered. With the simple black color, it looks quite mysterious.

At the beginning of his training, Yao Lao handed the Heavy Xuan Ruler to Xiao Yan, and let Xiao Yan carry this black ruler 24 hours a day. The purpose was to cultivate Xiao Yan's willpower, and at the same time suppress the speed of Dou Qi in the body, which is beneficial to his cultivation. After Xiao Yan reached the Great Dou Shi, the increase brought by the black ruler gradually decreased, Xiao Yan did accustomed to the existence of the Heavy Xuan Ruler, but not completely used to it.

After years of tough training, the current him had gotten used to the heaviness of the black ruler. Each times he removed the Heavy Xuan Ruler, his speed and strength would ferociously rise. Xiao Yan believed that when fighting with an opponent, this sudden increase in speed and strength would catch the opponent off guard.
artifacts.trivia:
Xiao Yan named it Heavy Xuan Ruler

The ruler was primarily a training tool, as it was made of heavy metal that actively suppressed Xiao Yan's Dou Qi

In early battles, he used the ruler for its brute force, often combining it with his Flame Splitting Tsunami Dou Skill.

artifacts.appearance: A thin mask that looked like human skin.
artifacts.trivia:
Xiao Yan used it to enter Nalan Clan.

In donghua its appearance is different but its effect is similar as to hide you true aura.

artifacts.introText: If the ‘Blood Lotus Pill’ is meant to protect the exterior of your body, then this ‘Ice Spirit Cold Fountain’ is meant to protect the inside of your body. It can protect you from the destructive temperature of a ‘Heavenly Flame’ when you are refining it, preventing you from being burnt till nothing remains.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan obtained this ingredient from Gu Te by exchanged it with a bottle of Amethyst Lion Birth Essence.

artifacts.title: Jade Bone Fruit
artifacts.introText: Jade Bone Fruit is one of the rare medicinal ingredients needed to refine the Heaven Soul Blood Bone Pill.

artifacts.title: Life Devouring Pill
artifacts.introText: This kind of medicinal pill was able to forcefully raise the strength of someone who was around the Da Dou Shi class all the way to the Dou Wang class. However, once such a medicinal pill is used, one could only maintain one’s life for three years. In other words, this medicinal pill basically used all of one’s remaining life to exchange for a Dou Wang strength for three years!
artifacts.appearance: The medicinal pill was entirely blood-red, and was around the size of a dragon’s eye. This medicinal pill appeared extremely strange. At a glance, it seemed to be like a transparent body that was filled with blood. There was a bloody dark-red glow at the middle of the medicinal pill. The pill was just like a tiny eye at a glance and its entire body emitted a strange feeling.
artifacts.history:
It was a medicinal pill that had once shook the entire continent many years ago. It could be considered to be at the peak of the seventh tier. The creator of this kind of medicinal pill was an alchemist grandmaster who possessed quite a great reputation. The most frightening aspect of this medicinal pill was that it was able to create many expert Dou Wangs!

One could imagine, just how willing people would be when this one pill was able skip all of the tribulations of training they had to undergo in order to climb to this level. Although this kind of temporarily borrowed strength was obtained by squandering one’s life, which of those people who could truly rely on normal training to reach the Dou Wang class did not have outstanding training talent? How could this talent be something that everyone possessed?

Hence, it aroused the craziness of a countless number of people the moment this kind of medicinal pill was born. Some of the first rate factions in the continent possessed an extreme greed for it. After all, whoever was able to obtain it might be able to create expert Dou Wangs. Just think, who could defeat a faction if it had a thousand or a ten thousand Dou Wang army?

However, this kind of craziness did not continue for long before it was gradually annihilated. This was because the alchemist who created the ‘Life Devouring Pill’ had disappeared overnight along with the medicinal formula for the ‘Life Devouring Pill’.

There were still some people who did not give up and looked for him everywhere during the short period after he disappeared. However, as more time passed, the craziness that had shook the entire continent gradually calmed down. That so-called ‘Life Devouring Pill’ had gradually disappeared in the long river of time. It even reached the extent that it was foreign to many alchemists today.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Li found this pill and consumed it to forcefully raise his strength.

artifacts.title: Lively Fruit
artifacts.introText: Lively Fruit is one of the ingredients for the Blood Clotting Powder. From the Lively Fruit, an almost fully black and small kernel was obtained. This kernel had the effect of improving blood circulation. If an experienced mercenary was injured in the wilderness while lacking healing medication, often times, he would grind a Lively Fruit and use it to alleviate the injury.

artifacts.appearance: Magical Testing Monument is described as a black stone monument. When a person touches it, the monument "shines brightly" and displays the results in large, written characters. It is used for measuring level of Dou Qi of a practitioner.

If any individual wants to refine a pill, first of all, one must have a fire attribute. And then, within the fire attribute, one must have a tiny sliver of the wood attribute to act as a catalysis in pill-refining.

However, to refine a pill, just having the fire and wood attributes is not enough. That’s because one must also have a strong Soul Perception or Soul Moulding!
