artifacts.title: Mighty Lightning Hammer
artifacts.introText: Mighty Lightning hammer is a treasure of the Wind Lightning Pavilion.
artifacts.appearance: It was named the Mighty Lightning Hammer. Its body had been created using lightning stones. If a person who practiced a lightning Qi Method used it, that person’s Dou Qi would experience a strengthening effect. Adding that the lightning stone were naturally heavy, it was filled with strength when one swung it. An ordinary expert would not dare to receive it head-on.
artifacts.trivia: Hong Chen has two mighty lightning hammer techniques, the first is Thousand Shattering Lightning Hammer and the second is Exterminating Lightning Hammer.

artifacts.title: Monster Cores
artifacts.introText: Monster cores, in the Dou Qi Mainland, they are also known as Magic Crystals. The Monster Core is the energy nuclei within a magic monster. The monster core is filled with extremely violent world energy. When facing this kind of violent world energy, even a Dou Wang wouldn’t risk absorbing a monster core.
artifacts.history:
Monster cores, in the Dou Qi Mainland, they are also known as Magic Crystals. The Monster Core is the energy nuclei within a magic monster. The monster core is filled with extremely violent world energy. When facing this kind of violent world energy, even a Dou Wang wouldn’t risk absorbing a monster core.

Even though Monster cores cannot be absorbed directly, it is a core ingredient in alchemy. A monster core that goes through an Alchemist’s’ refining can be infused with some herbs to become desirable and expensive pills that can increases one’s strength.

Furthermore, monster cores can be placed on weapons. The weapon that has been fused with a monster core does not only have increased destructive power, it can also have special Dou Qi effects, and becomes a highly sought after commodity in the Dou Qi Mainland.

Besides weapons, Monster Cores can also be added to armors and defensive equipment. The defensive equipment that have Monster Cores have an extreme defense and give their users an extra safety net when they’re in danger.

With that many uses, monster cores are naturally the most sought after items within the Dou Qi Mainland. Not only Dou Zhes but even respectable Alchemists search in person for high level monster cores in order to create higher quality level pills.

Under such demand, the supply for monster cores on the mainland is always unable to meet the demand from the buyers, thus whenever a high level core appears in any auction or other setting, it was bought immediately at a high price.

Because of the high value of monster cores, many mercenary groups specialize in killing magic monsters for a living but getting a monster core is not a simple task.

First, magic monsters are not only extremely strong but also very cunning. Because of their devious nature and special attacking methods, magical beasts can be much stronger than humans of the same rank. Hence, without outstanding power of your own, trying to kill a magical beast on your own is impossible and may possibly lose your life without getting a magical core.

Even if you do kill a magic beast, not all magical beasts possess a magic core, the probability of a magical beast having a core is almost random so a mercenary group could have half of their force killed trying to kill a magic monster and yet not find a core. These kinds of incidents happen all the time in Dou Qi Mainland…

Thus the price of monster cores in Dou Qi Mainland are all very expensive.

artifacts.title: Moonlight Stones
artifacts.introText: Moonlight Stones  are used to illuminate places.

artifacts.title: Mountain Melting Cauldon
artifacts.introText: The Mountain Melting Cauldron is a powerful and renowned medicinal cauldron ranked on the "Heavenly Cauldron Ranking." It is fiery-red in color, adorned with numerous drawings of erupting volcanoes, and exudes a violent aura, reflecting its immense power. The cauldron belongs to Tang Zhen, the Valley Chief of Burning Flame Valley, who claims to have obtained it through sheer luck.

artifacts.title: Mysterious Beast Skin
artifacts.introText: Changing one’s appearance was not rare within the Chu Yun Empire. Poison Masters always loved to act in unorthodox ways and would create all sorts of strange, unique items. A tool known as the Mysterious Beast Skin was able to quietly make some changes to a person’s appearance. Of course, one’s appearance would naturally recover to its normal form once this thing was removed.

artifacts.title: Nine Serene Profound Scepter
artifacts.introText: It is the keepsake of the tribal chief!  Whoever possesses the Nine Serene Profound Scepter is the tribal chief of Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe.
artifacts.appearance: A five-foot-long scepter. This scepter was completely black with two lifelike poisonous snakes twisting at the top. A fist-sized black bead was present between the two snakes. It emitted a faint cold glow.

artifacts.title: Nirvana Plate
artifacts.introText: Nirvana Plate is used to test the value of Spiritual Strength, which value is decided by Pill Tower.
artifacts.appearance: A stone tablet that was around ten feet tall. Actually, it was not accurate to describe it as a stone tablet because this stone tablet was transparent, giving it a crystal-like appearance.
artifacts.trivia: Donghua called it as Soul Measuring Stone; categories the value in levels, getting a soul value of level 4th or above count as passing. Cao Ying highest record of 9th level was broken by Xiao Yan by achieving 14th level.

artifacts.title: Northern King Puppet
artifacts.introText: This puppet was different from those Sky Demon Puppets in the past. The Sky Demon Puppets did not possess an intelligence. They needed to be controlled by people when fighting others. However, this “Northern King” would automatically attack with just a thought from Xiao Yan. Moreover, it would not look sluggish like a regular puppet would when fighting against others. It appeared as though it was no different than if the northern dragon king had been revived.  Xiao Yan gave it this intelligence as he left part of the Northern Kings soul in the puppet when refining it. The current Northern King should be comparable to a five star Dou Sheng.
artifacts.appearance: This puppet was different from those Sky Demon Puppets in the past. The Sky Demon Puppets did not possess an intelligence. They needed to be controlled by people when fighting others. However, this “Northern King” would automatically attack with just a thought from Xiao Yan. Moreover, it would not look sluggish like a regular puppet would when fighting against others. It appeared as though it was no different than if the northern dragon king had been revived.  Xiao Yan gave it this intelligence as he left part of the Northern Kings soul in the puppet when refining it. The current Northern King should be comparable to a five star Dou Sheng.

artifacts.title: Pill Beast
artifacts.introText: Pill Beasts are spiritual manifestation of a high-tier Medicinal Pills, primarily those of Tier 9 and above.
artifacts.appearance:
The spiritual energy of higher-tier pill (Tier 9, or above) and essence within the medicinal ingredients become so concentrated and powerful that the pill gains its own form of spiritual intelligence or sentience. This spiritual intelligence often takes the form of a beast, sometimes resembling the primary spirit-beast ingredient used in the pill's refinement, or an auspicious creature. This is the Pill Beast.

Pill Beast is extremely precious, Tier 8 pill with at least 8 Pill Lightning colors if groomed properly then it would sooner or later advance into the true tier 9 level. At that time, it would really be able to revive people, change their lives and other inconceivable magical effect.
artifacts.trivia: A tier 9 Treasure Pill can transform into a human shape as Pill Beast.

artifacts.title: Pill Soul Serum
artifacts.introText: This Pill Soul Serum was one of the key medicinal ingredients he needed to mix with the Core Soul Marrow. This thing was extremely rare.
artifacts.appearance: There was a stream in front of Xiao Yan. The source of the stream was a ten meter or so large rock. That enormous rock was covered in green moss. At the center of the rock was a hole. One could vaguely see a jade-green, viscous liquid within it. The serene fragrance was being emitted from that spot.
artifacts.trivia: The Place Was Guarded By a Rank 7 Water-Type Magical Beast, Mysterious Water Tiger Snake.

artifacts.title: Poison Resisting Pill
artifacts.introText: Poison Resisting Pill is a high level scarlet colored medicinal pills better than the Poison Avoiding Pill and can even help people from very strong poisons but its precautionary pill meaning if poison enters the body first it becomes useless.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan 's group used them in the Ancient Wasteland Region.

artifacts.title: Purple Lightning Burst
artifacts.introText: Purple Lightning Burst is a Xuan Class High Level Qi Method.
artifacts.trivia: It was found in the Book Collection Hall of the Jia Nan Academy.

artifacts.title: Purple Smoke Fruit
artifacts.introText: The Purple Smoke Fruit was a special fruit that could be found in the Magic Beast Mountain Range. As this fruit contained a little fire energy in it, it was well loved by many kinds of fire type Magic Beasts.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan injected a strong laxative in this fruit, which caused the young Amethyst winged lion to have a very upset stomach , he also added some nectar from an Anorexia Flower to the fruit which gave it a allure of delicacy it was something the beast could't resist .

artifacts.title: Purple Spirit Crystal
artifacts.introText: Amethyst Winged Lion can only drop a small piece every twenty years.
artifacts.appearance: It was a fist size purple colored spirit stone that was oddly sharp. A bright light flowed on top of the purple colored spirit stone, giving it a beautiful appearance.
artifacts.trivia: Amethyst Winged Lion was willing to exchange it for Body Transformation Pill.

artifacts.title: Qi Breaking Arrows
artifacts.introText: Qi Breaking Arrows are arrows that can pierce the layer of Dou Qi.
artifacts.appearance: An arrows, blood-red in color. These blood-red raining arrows clearly possessed a great difference compared to the ordinary raining arrows. This could be differentiated from the sound that was emitted when the arrow’s body flew through the sky. Moreover, when these raining arrows struck a Misty Cloud Sect’s disciple, the Dou Qi that was lingering on the surface of their bodies clearly did not pose much of a hindrance to the arrow. Instead, due to the overly great strength, the remaining strength of the arrow after it penetrated one’s body would even penetrate through the body of the person behind.
artifacts.trivia: These arrows are used by Primer Clan in fight against Misty Cloud Sect.

artifacts.title: Rainbow Poison Book
artifacts.introText: A Poison Book that records the methods of making poison.
artifacts.appearance: It is described as an ancient, seven-colored (rainbow-colored) scroll.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan remarks that mastering the book would require significant time and effort. He chose not to contest with Xiao Yi Xian for it because he felt that training his Dou Qi already consumed all of his energy.

artifacts.title: Red Spiritual Recovery Fruit
artifacts.introText: Red Spiritual Recovery Fruit is the most important ingredient for Energy Recovery Pill.
artifacts.appearance: A purple colored sapling on the mountain wall. The sapling grew from within the mountain wall. On it, green and red colors were interwoven because hiding under the green leaves were stealthily hidden red fruits that were emitting a faint fragrance.

artifacts.title: Sea’s Core Vest
artifacts.introText: Sea's Core Vest is an armour which was given to Xiao Yan by Yun Yun. He has saved her life and helped her obtain Purple Spirit Crystal so this could be considered as his reaward.
artifacts.appearance: A blue-colored metal inner vest that had a strange light flowing on it.
artifacts.history:
This inner vest had rescued Xia Yan a couple of times back then. Quite a number of fragments had fallen during the times it protected him. Finally, these fragments were quietly and bitterly searched for by Yun Yun before once again being set into the vest. Of course, some of those that were impossible to find due to various reasons were meticulously mended by Yun Yun with the same material.

Although this inner vest was Yun Yun’s personal object that she had always kept close to her and ended up forming a slight relationship with it, attempting to search for those tiny fragments within this enormous Jia Ma Empire would require one to expand an incredible amount of effort. Hence, this point made Xiao Yan give up any grudges from the past.
artifacts.trivia: It was destroyed by explosion of Angry Buddha Lotus Flame.

artifacts.title: Serene Sea Storage Ring
artifacts.introText: Serene Sea Storage Ring is a high grade storage ring obtained by Xiao Yan from Han Feng after defeating him (Han Feng). Back then, Han Feng had went through a great battle in order to obtain this storage ring.
artifacts.appearance: A dark blue storage ring.

artifacts.title: Seven-Colored Origin Stone
artifacts.introText: This Seven-Colored Origin Stone was a mutated Spiritual Stone.
artifacts.appearance: There was a seven-colored stone there. This stone was around the size of half a fist. There were seven extremely clear lines on it, and a special energy was vaguely radiating from it.
artifacts.trivia:
Xiao Yan Exchanged It For Two Tier 8 Medicinal Pills With Three-Colored Pill Lightning.

It was a stone that had eight colors when Cai Lin used her blood to see how many colors would appear.

artifacts.title: Silver Wood
artifacts.introText: Silver Wood is used by the Wind Lightning Pavilion to build different structures.
artifacts.appearance:
Silver Wood is a rare type of wood found in the Lightning Mountain and is said to be very durable even so much so a Dou Huang will have difficulty destroying it. Due to these qualities it is used by the Wind Lightning Pavilion to build different structures.

Even the arena where the Four Pavilion Grand Meeting took place was built by this material but was later thoroughly damaged by the two subsequent strong battles that took place there, which where -

Xiao Yan (1 star Dou Zong) VS Wang Chen (Half step Dou Zong)

Xiao Yan ( 1 star Dou Zong but with help of secret technique he was a 2 star Dou Zong) VS Feng Qing Er (1 star Dou Zong but with help of secret technique she was a 3 star Dou Zong)

All these were strong individual and their battle were able to damage the arena but the Silver-Colored wooden fragments shot out at great speed like a storm. A silver light flickered when the sunlight shot over, causing it to appear extremely beautiful.

artifacts.title: Sky Jade Fruit
artifacts.introText: Sky Jade Fruit can be directly consumed and would be able to let a person’s Dou Qi’s strength be raised by around one star. If it was used to refine medicinal pill, it would definitely be a mysterious pill that could directly raise the strength of a strong Dou Wang should one succeed. This thing belonged to the category of a ‘sky-high price’ outside and was extremely difficult to find. It was really unexpected that there would actually be one of it being spat out within the ‘Book Collection Hall’.
artifacts.appearance: An emerald medicinal ingredient.

artifacts.title: Sky Quiet Poison Code
artifacts.introText: The so-called “Sky Quiet Poison Code” had been created by an elite Dou Sheng called Saint Sky Quiet Poison thousands of years ago. This elite Dou Sheng loved to use poison throughout his life. Hence, he had left behind a scroll containing the refinement methods of various mysterious poisons. Some of the lethal poisons could cause even an elite Dou Zun to become miserable. Although this book possessed a great might, it required one to have researched poisons before and was rather unorthodox.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan Bid And Exchanged It For Two Tier 8 Medicinal Pills With Five Color Pill Lightning.

artifacts.title: Slaughtering Di Ghost Blood Blade
artifacts.introText: Slaughtering Di Ghost Blood Blade is one of the most terrifying weapons in the entire Battle Through the Heavens universe. It serves as the ultimate trump card for the main villain, Hun Tiandi.
artifacts.appearance:
The blood blade was extremely strange. It did not have a hilt the blood light lingering over it seemed to be able to even split this world!

The bright sun in the sky had dimmed as this strange blood blade appeared. The whole world gradually darkened. It appeared as though even the sun, moon and clouds were terrified of that strange blood blade!

artifacts.title: Snake Passion Fruit
artifacts.introText: Snake Passion Fruit, normally found growing in dark places that high-grade Magic Snakes used for copulation, an excessive snake like character. This fruit had an aphrodisiac effect.

artifacts.title: Snake Venom Fruit
artifacts.introText: The Snake Venom Fruit was round and about as big as half a fist. If the dark-green fruit was put beneath the nose, one would smell a sweet and sour tanginess. The Snake Venom Fruit was quite rare, being found only near the lairs of 5th Rank or above snake magical beasts! Due to the fruit’s association with the snake, the fruit’s cold yin element was abundant and as a result, the fruit was frequently used as a mediator for the effects of a medicine.

artifacts.title: Soul Baby Demon Tree
artifacts.introText: The Soul Baby Demon Tree was located in the ancient remains of a Dou Sheng expert that was located in the Beast Bone Mountain Range. The Soul Baby Fruit grows in this tree.
artifacts.appearance: The small tree was grayish silver in color. Its tree branches were entwined like vines. These tree branches would form a strange arc wherever it was extended. If looked at it while standing from afar, one would discover that the shape of these plants were very much like a pregnant woman with a bulging womb. There was a golden light overflowing from the interior of the belly that was formed by the many branches. Two fist size golden fruits were hung within the pregnant woman’s belly like tree branches.

artifacts.title: Soul Baby Fruit
artifacts.introText: The Soul Baby Fruit is a unique treasure that refines a soul. It also possess a great effect towards some Magical Beasts.
artifacts.appearance: The fruits appeared just like a vivid human like baby. A vaguely present fragrance spread from it, causing the soul to involuntarily tremble a little.
artifacts.history: Xiao Yan was searching for it in order to help Yao Lao recover his Essence Spiritual Qi so that Xiao Yan could create a perfect body for him.

artifacts.title: Soul Bag
artifacts.introText: Soul Bag is an item where people from the Hall of Souls keep captured spritual bodies.

artifacts.title: Soul Light Cluster
artifacts.introText: The Soul Light Cluster is a massive concentration of purified Soul Essence created by the Hall of Souls from countless captured souls. It contains extremely pure spiritual energy capable of greatly enhancing spiritual strength and even helping one approach higher soul realms.
artifacts.appearance: It is described as a five-foot-large transparent light cluster suspended by black chains, radiating pure spiritual fluctuations.
artifacts.history: Xiao Yan discovers the Soul Light Cluster after destroying Man Hall which is an important branch of Hall of Souls. It was formed from imprisoned souls used as nourishment by the Hall of Souls. Recognizing its immense value and purity, Yao Lao explains it can strengthen spiritual power and possibly aid Xiao Yan in competing for the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame. Xiao Yan takes the cluster, purifies it of hidden negative emotions and later absorbs it allowing his spiritual strength to advance to the Perfect Heavenly State, greatly enhancing his abilities.
artifacts.trivia: The cluster contained residual emotions like hatred and unwillingness from the souls used to form it, which could affect absorbers.  If one were to randomly absorb them, they would end up warping one’s mind.

artifacts.title: Soul Revival Demon Fruit
artifacts.introText: It was one of the key ingredients in refining of the Yin Yang Life Soul Pill.  This strange fruit is really beneficial to the training of Spiritual Strength.
artifacts.appearance: A fist-sized red-colored fruit. Wave after wave of dense, cold air poured out of the fruit.

artifacts.title: Soul Swallowing Flower
artifacts.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.
artifacts.appearance: A deep-blue flower.

artifacts.title: Soul Testing Bead
artifacts.introText: Donghua - Xiao Yan attempts to hold Soul Testing Beads
artifacts.appearance: A dark-black metal bead from his Storage Ring. The surface of the metal bead was extremely smooth. Moreover, it did not contain the slightest luster. The complete-black color gave it a kind of heaviness.
artifacts.trivia: In donghua it is appeared as golden-black metal beads who weigh 1000Kg to one's soul.

artifacts.title: Space Boat
artifacts.introText: This is a Space Boat used to travel the Wormholes. Its manufacturing process is quite expensive. Each of one costs over a million and an ordinary person really cannot afford to use it.
artifacts.appearance: A palm-sized wooden boat. The wooden boat was faintly emitting a silver glow. This thing hid a thread of an extremely weak spatial strength.

artifacts.title: Space Shuttle Boat
artifacts.introText: This kind of battleship is something that the Gu clan inherited from the ancient times. It is called a Space Shuttle Boat. In terms of its speed, it is likely that even an expert at the peak of the Dou Zun class would not be able to catch up with it. Unfortunately, such a thing is really too rare now.

artifacts.title: Spirit Envoys
artifacts.introText: Spirit Envoys is are used by the Hall of Souls to set up formations. Even Protector Xuan used it to set up the Ten Thousand Soul Swallowing Formation.

artifacts.title: Spiritual Lightning Tablet
artifacts.introText: A thread of their spiritual imprint was stored inside. If they unluckily die one day, this Spiritual Lightning Tablet would also shatter. in this case it can mean only death.

artifacts.title: Spring Blood Crystal
artifacts.introText: Spring Blood Crystal is a key ingredient  in order to refine Nine Yin Yellow Spring Pill.
artifacts.appearance: A palm-sized blood-colored crystal. The middle of the crystal seemed to possess an endless flowing blood, giving it an exceptionally strange appearance.

artifacts.title: Storage Ring
artifacts.introText: Storage Ring was made by a type of uncommon material called “Storage Stone”. The characteristic of this material was that there was a unique small space within it where any lifeless objects could be stored. Though this was extremely convenient, due to the sparsity of the “Storage Stone”, its was extremely precious. The lowest grade “Storage Ring” in only had a space of about three to four square metres, yet it costs almost 100,000 gold. In the Xiao Clan, Xiao Yan had only seen his father and the first Elder own Storage Rings.
artifacts.trivia: Xiao Yan's storage ring was destroyed under high temperature caused by Heavenly Flames.

artifacts.title: Ten Thousand Beast Cauldron
artifacts.introText: Ten Thousand Beast Cauldron is one of the medicinal cauldrons on the Heavenly Cauldron Ranking. This crimson-colored cauldron was naturally not something that belonged to Xiao Yan. It was something that Han Feng had left behind. From the looks of it, this was something the latter had used to refine pills.
artifacts.appearance: The crimson-colored medicinal cauldron was large in size. Its body was covered with different kinds of unique lines. Various life-like fierce beast drawings were carved into it. Their savage large mouths were open, and if one were to place one’s ear close beside it to listen, one would be able to hear some strange roars that were faintly emitted from the medicinal cauldron. These unusual characteristics all indicated that this crimson cauldron was extraordinary.

artifacts.title: Tou She Ancient God’s Jade
artifacts.introText: Tou She Ancient God's Jade is the rumored item left by Tou She Ancient God which is part of key to his inheritance.
artifacts.appearance: An ancient jade piece which emitted a strange glow. Under the shine of the moonlight, the strange lines on the surface of the ancient jade appeared to be breathing. It was bright at times and dim at other times.
artifacts.history:
The Tou She Ancient God’s Jade is related to the mystery of Dou Di. Ever since the ancient times, seldom do any experts manage to breakthrough to the Dou Di class. Those Dou Dis back then all seemed to have vanished overnight. One can only find some remnant information from some ancient text.

The Dou Qi continent is incomparable vast. There are some remains left behind by the ancient experts since ancient times. However, most of these remains are incomplete. Even though this is the case, each time such a remain is discovered, it would stir a large commotion on the continent.
artifacts.trivia:
Complete Tou She Ancient God Jade was divided bewtween Eight Ancient Clans and every ancient clan had one piece until Hun Clan collected all eight pieces.

Tou She Ancient God Jade is the key for the Tou She Ancient God Mansion.

When all eight pieces is collected and they form a complete jade, a location of the Tou She Ancient God Mansion will be revealed.

artifacts.title: Voluptuous Boobs Pill
artifacts.introText: A pill that can only be taken by female cultivators.

artifacts.title: Water Drunken Cloud Immortal Tree
artifacts.introText: This fruit tree was called the Water Drunken Cloud Immortal Tree. The fruit on top of it was called the Water Cloud Fruit. There was an extremely dense water affinity energy within it. This fruit held a potent attraction to some water affinity Magical Beasts. Moreover, the energy within it was vast, mighty, causing the fruit to possess a special drunken liquid within it. The effect of this drunken liquid was fantastic. Even a tier 7 Magical Beast would become drunk and fall asleep after having swallowed it.
artifacts.appearance: This fruit tree was icy-blue in color. It was only around half a foot in size and at its tip sat a fist-sized blue-colored fruit. The surrounding air became much more moist when this fruit appeared. Surging water affinity energy rushed out like water in a flood.

artifacts.title: White Orchard Fruit
artifacts.introText: A middle-grade medicinal herb which usually only grows by the edge of a cliff. There are quite a lot of them. Unfortunately, they are the favorite food of a bird type Mystical Beast so they would usually be eaten once they grow and can be considered as one of the rarer ingredients among the middle-grade medicinal plants. If this matured White Orchard Fruit were to be sold at a medicinal shop, it should be worth around four thousand gold coins.
artifacts.appearance: A white colored plant.

artifacts.title: Xiao Yan/Items
artifacts.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

artifacts.title: Yellow Spring Stone Tablet
artifacts.introText: The Huang Quan Stone Tablet (Yellow Spring Stone Tablet) is one of the most significant treasures of the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe. It serves as a legacy monument left behind by the legendary Demon Saint Huang Quan.
artifacts.appearance:
The tablet was created by the Yellow Spring Demon Saint, an ancient expert who was a "Half-Step Dou Di". It serves as his final resting place and inheritance site, preserved for thousands of years by the Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe. It has been inherited since ancient times. All the knowledge of the Demon Saint Huang Quan is recorded in this stone tablet.

The Huang Quan stone tablet was a key treasure of Nine Serene Deep Ground Python Tribe. There are three Dou Skills inscribed on it. The Yellow Spring Finger and the Yellow Spring Palm are respectively a Tian class low level and a Tian class middle level. They are extremely powerful. However, only the tribal chief and a few Elders can practice them. Even some tribe members only know about the existence of the Huang Quan stone tablet.

While the Finger and Palm techniques are inscribed on the surface (visible as large handprints and symbols), the greatest treasures are hidden deep within. The stone tablet contains its own space guarded by a sliver of the Demon Saint’s consciousness.

To access the highest-level skills, one must possess Heavenly State Spiritual Strength to enter the tablet's spiritual space and withstand the pressure. Hidden in the core of the tablet is the preserved essence blood of the Demon Saint.
artifacts.trivia: For a Dou Sheng like Xiao Yan, refining this blood provides a massive boost to physical strength and Dou Qi levels, as it contains the "Di" aura from an expert who almost ascended.

artifacts.title: Yellow Spring Yin Rock
artifacts.introText: The Yellow Spring Yin Rock has been refined by the dark and cold force in the spring for an uncountable number of years. It is extremely hard, possibly even indestructible.  The interior of this metal chain seemed to be a void that was filled with a dark and cold force.
artifacts.appearance: A dark-black mountain-like outcropping. This mountain-shape was not large. It was only over a hundred feet in size, but the dark and cold force contained within it caused Xiao Yan to involuntarily shudder despite having the protection of a Heavenly Flame.

clans.title: Ao Ba Clan
clans.introText: Ao Ba Clan was one of the three most powerful clan in Wu Tan City.
clans.history: While the Jia Lie Clan was aggressive and openly hostile, the Ao Ba Clan was more opportunistic. They initially sat on the sidelines during the "pill war," waiting to see which side (Xiao or Jia Lie) would fall so they could take over the remains. After the Jia Lie Clan was defeated and the Xiao Clan rose to power, the Ao Ba Clan eventually joined forces with the remnants of the Jia Lie Clan to try and suppress the Xiao Clan while Xiao Yan was away.

clans.title: Bai Clan
clans.introText: Bai Clan is one of the five great clan of the Pill Tower.

clans.title: Cao Clan
clans.introText: Cao Clan is one of the five great clans of the Pill Region. Of course, this clan could not be compared with the declining Ye clan. There seemed to be a never-ending number of talented alchemists in that clan. This caused the reputation of the Cao clan to grow greater. Other than the Dan clan, which kept an extremely low profile, it was likely that the Cao clan was the strongest among the five great clans.

clans.title: Cech Family
clans.introText: The Cech Family were a family in the Jia Ma Empire.
clans.history: A couple dozen years ago, the famous Cech family of Jia Ma Empire enraged Pill King Gu He and was annihilated by 4 Dou Wangs that Gu He sent. Even the Jia Ma Empire’s royalty wouldn’t control the matter!
clans.trivia: The are only mentioned in 2 paragraphs in one chapter.

clans.title: Chen Clan
clans.introText: Chen Clan is one of the two most powerful clans in the Tianhuang City.

clans.title: Dan Clan
clans.introText: Dan Clan is one of the five great clan of the Pill Tower.

clans.title: Eight Ancient Clans
clans.introText: The 8 Ancient Clans are 8 clans from the ancient times in the story (>50,000 years before current at least). They are later known as the 8 Great Clans. They are named so since they had a Dou Di who started the clan and they are his blood descendants. . The Xiao clan entered the 8 Ancient clans because of their ancestor at the peak of Dou Di realm.
clans.appearance:
The Central Plains is not as simple as it seems on the surface. The so-called One Hall One Tower, Two Sects Three Valleys, Four Pavilions is merely a general form of address. Some true top factions are hidden even more deeply than the Gu clan.

Being born within an ancient clan comes with a far greater pressure than other places. There, one’s status is differentiated by the richness of one’s bloodline. 

The members from ancient clans would usually not practice a strengthening technique like the Skyfire Three Mysterious Flame because their clan tattoos were the most powerful Secret Techniques in the world!

Although these Secret Techniques would exhaust one, they would not harm their body even a little. Suffering a backlash from this Secret Technique would never happen. By being in possession of such a mysterious clan tattoo, those other Secret Techniques that relied on exhausting one’s blood or self-mutilation in order to increase one’s strength were not worth mentioning in their eyes.

clans.title: Gu Clan
clans.introText: Gu Clan is one of the most powerful and influential forces in the Dou Qi Continent. They are one of the Eight Ancient Clans, descendants of the Dou Di ancestors.
clans.trivia:
'Gu' means 'Ancient'.

Within the rules of Gu clan, there is a clear rule that one is not allowed to wed outside of the clan!

The adult ceremony of the Gu clan was quite complicated because one was only considered fully grown after one had undergone the adult ceremony of the Gu clan. The younger generation could only be considered a part of the core of the clan after the adult ceremony. Even marriages could only be conducted after one completed the adult ceremony.

Since Gu Yuan became a Dou Di this restored their bloodline and ensured many more years of outstanding cultivators.

clans.title: Gu Zhen
clans.introText: The appearance of this long-haired man was not handsome. It could even be called ordinary. However, it gave one a mysterious convincing feeling.
clans.appearance: The appearance of this long-haired man was not handsome. It could even be called ordinary. However, it gave one a mysterious convincing feeling.
clans.personality: He is carefree and relaxed which puts people on alert. He was the first person Xiao Yan met from the Gu Clan that had a light and gentle personality from the younger generation.
clans.history: Gu Zhen is the first commander of the Black Submerged Army.
clans.trivia:
He let Xiao Yan know that by having sex with an outsider, someone from the Gu Clan could lose their bloodline.

He was one of the many pursuers for Gu Xun Er's hand, but he gave up and accepted Xiao Yan after he reached the Dou Sheng Level.

clans.title: Han Clan
clans.introText: The Han clan was situated on the southern part of Tian Bei City. Opposite it was the Hong Clan, which occupied the northern part. These two clan were like the two overlords of this city, both parties had evenly divided the city into two distinct portions.

clans.title: He Clan
clans.introText: This clan could be considered a prominent clan even in the northwestern region of the empire. Although its reputation could not be compared with the three large clans of the empire, it was not to be underestimated. The greatest reason for this was that the current He clan had a four star elite Dou Wang!

clans.title: Hong Clan
clans.introText: The Hong Clan was one of the minor antagonist Clans during the Back Corner Region Arc in "Battle Through the Heavens."
clans.history: The Hong clan was the strongest clan within the Tian Bei city. Even Han clan is a little inferior to it. The most important reason is that the Hong clan has a little relationship with the Wind Lightning Pavilion. The most outstanding person of this generation, Hong Chen, is someone from the Wind Lightning Pavilion and is highly regarded within it. The Hong clan has relied on this big tree to greatly expand its reputation and influence within these short few years. After all, the Wind Lightning Pavilion can be considered a top tier faction within the entire northern region of the Central Plains. Han clan is far too inferior when compared with it.

clans.title: Hun Clan
clans.introText: Hun Clan is one of the Eight Ancient Clans.
clans.trivia:
In Chinese, 魂 (hún) specifically refers to the "spirit" or "soul."

The only Clan without any female characters in the Novel.

clans.title: Jia Lie Clan
clans.introText: Jia Lie Clan was one of the three most powerful clans of Wu Tan City.
clans.history: It is enemy of the Xiao Clan. Just like Xiao clan they also gain most of there income from markets and are in fierce competition with other two clan (Xiao and Ao Ba) to dominate it.

clans.title: Lei Clan
clans.introText: This article is based on the Official Translations of the Web Novel series! The information and terminology in the article will be based on the source material rather than the Donghua (Anime) or Manhua.

clans.title: Ling Clan
clans.introText: The Ling clan was also one of the eight ancient clans. Although they had gradually shown signs of declining, it should be known that even a dying ancient faction was still more powerful than an ordinary one. Regardless of how much it declined, it could still be ranked among the super factions within the Central Plains.

clans.title: Liu Clan
clans.introText: Liu Clan is one of the two most powerful clan in the Tianhuang City.
clans.history: Liu Clan was in a bad position in the Tianhuang City when Liu Qing became the head of the Liu Clan because they had a problem to control the Wormhole but that was quickly solved when Xiao Yan appeared in the Tianhuang City. With his status as the Tier 7 Alchemist he won the Wormhole for the Liu Clan and Liu Clan became famous in the Tianhuang City as they befriended a Tier 7 Alchemist.

clans.title: Luo Clan
clans.introText: There are many factions within Horizon City and it is extremely chaotic. However, the one that existed for the longest time is this Luo clan. That ‘Wormhole’ is also possessed by the Luo clan. There is an ancestor within the Luo clan whose strength is around that of a five star Dou Zong or so. He is the strongest in this city. If not for the existence of this ancestor, it is likely that the Luo clan would have difficulty controlling this ‘Wormhole’ for so many years. After all, this extremely profitable fat meat is watched by an immense amount of people with envious eyes on a daily basis.
clans.trivia: Luo clan is renowned for trading Monster Cores.

clans.title: Qiu Clan
clans.introText: Qiu Clan is one of the five great clans of the Pill Tower.

clans.title: Shi Clan
clans.introText: The Shi clan was one of the eight ancient clans. Although the Shi clan was not as well-known as the Gu Clan or the Hun clan, it was still one of the eight ancient clans and not an ordinary existence. The Shi clan usually kept a low profile and rarely would news related to them spread, but keeping a low profile did not mean that they were weak. This Shi clan was relatively strong when gauged by their fighting strength. Shi clan Due to their bloodline, their physical bodies are all extremely frightening. They could be comparable to some of the top Magical Beasts within the Magical Beast World .The Shi clan was a lot stronger than the Ling clan, which was the first to disappear. There were many powerful individuals within the clan who possessed an extremely powerful foundation.
clans.trivia: No Shi members are in the Novel.

clans.title: Hun Clan
clans.introText: Hun Clan is one of the Eight Ancient Clans.
clans.trivia:
In Chinese, 魂 (hún) specifically refers to the "spirit" or "soul."

The only Clan without any female characters in the Novel.

clans.title: Tunling Clan
clans.introText: The Tunling Clan (Devouring Spirit Clan) is an extremely mysterious clan during the Ancient Era. According to the records in the ancient books, it had once stirred countless bloody storm over the Dou Qi Continent. It is common knowledge that the inheritance of the Ancient Clans relies on their bloodline strength. If the clan's bloodline strength become exhausted, the clan will be no different from an ordinary person. In summary, every Ancient Clan will have a time when their bloodline becomes exhausted. Of course, the precondition is that the clan does not produce any other elite Dou Di again.

clans.title: Xiao Clan
clans.introText: This was the Most Powerful Clan about  1000 years before the Story's exposition. When  Xiao Yan became a Dou Di he revives the Clan to again become the Most Powerful Clan in the whole Dou Qi Continent.
clans.appearance:
Xiao Yan revives the Xiao Clan which was declined due to exhaustion of Dou Di Bloodline by becoming a Dou Di himself making it the Most Powerful Clan in Dou Qi Continent.

Xiao Clan flag in the Market

After Xiao Yan becomes a Dou Di his Two wives become Dou Di's too giving Xiao Clan two more Dou Di as they are the Clan Ladies being Xiao Yan's wives. And The Clan possess two Young masters with Extra-ordinary Strength. One is Xiao Xiao who becomes a 8 star Dou Sheng after his dad becomes a Dou Di, And is the daughter of Cai Lin, Nine-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python, of the Snake-People with an outstanding Bloodline of Dou Di as their Queen (Cai Lin) became a Dou Di and she has the spirit of the Seven Colored Heaven Swallowing Python accompanying her. So She is a mix of Two Dou Di. Second is Xiao Lin who is the Son of Xiao Yan with Gu Xun Er with the mix of Xiao Yan's Dou Di Bloodline and the Gu Clan's Dou Di Bloodline. Gu Clan being the Second most Powerful and Gu Xun Er being a Dou Di and Most outstanding person to ever born in Gu Clan after 1000 years, Xiao Lin is Naturally Very Strong because of this mixture of Two most Powerful Blood lines.
clans.history:
Xiao Clan was the strongest clan in the Wu Tan City but that all changed when they were attacked by the Misty Cloud Sect and Xiao Zhan was taken as a prisoner by the Hall of Souls. Xiao Clan was at that time almost exterminated by them.

Ao Ba Clan together with the Jia Lie Clan came to Xiao Clan, in order gain their fortune. They believed the Xiao Clan was at its weakest state, thinking that Xiao Yan was dead. But Xiao Yan and Cai Lin came in the last moment and reversed situation. Since Xiao Zhan was no longer present, Xiao Yan was chosen as a new head of the clan.

Xiao Yan ordered Xiao Clan members who could not fight to move from Wu Dan City to a region near the Tagger Desert where the Misty Cloud Sects influence was weaker. The clan members that left will wait for him in Rock Desert City and will be protect by the Desert Metal Mercenary Company which is run by his two older brothers.

When Xiao Yan left the Jia Ma Empire, Xiao Clan was again attacked by the Misty Cloud Sect and if there wasn't help from the Primer Clan, there would be no longer Xiao Clan. Primer Clan moved them to the Jia Ma Sacred City where they were hiding them from the eyes of the Misty Cloud Sect.

When Xiao Yan returned to Jia Ma Empire, Xiao Li brought a mansion in the most bustling area in the middle of the Jia Ma Sacred City. It far exceeded the Xiao clan home in Wu Tan City both in terms of size and style.

After Xiao Yan got rid of the Misty Cloud Sect, he established Yan Alliance lead by the Xiao Clan and from that moment the Xiao Clan became the most prosperous clan in the whole Jia Ma Empire.

When Xiao Yan became a Dou Di, he changed a bloodline of the Xiao Clan and everyone in the Xiao Clan became a person with unprecedent talent. Xiao Clan was no longer a clan only famous in the Jia Ma Empire but in the whole Dou Qi Continent because of existence of one person and that person is Flame Di Xiao Yan.
clans.trivia: If one didn’t reach Dou Zhe by the age of 25, the clan would abandon them.

clans.title: Yan Clan
clans.introText: The Yan Clan was a supporting clan during the Hun Clan and Dou Di arc's in "Battle Through the Heavens."
clans.history:
As for the faction with the most Heavenly Flames it should be the Yan clan, which is one of the eight ancient clans. Yan clan should be in possession of four types of Heavenly Flames. Among them, there are two Heavenly Flames in the top ten.

Of course, you should forget about placing your intentions on these Heavenly Flames because they have already added an inherited seal that is stronger than that of the Burning Flame Valley’s Nine Dragon Lightning Flame during their countless years of inheritance. You will not be able to refine and swallow them even if you do obtain them. The exception to this is when Xiao Yan became the Flame Di and can control all Heavenly Flames.
clans.trivia:
'Yan' means 'Fire'.

During the disappearance of the ancient clans they created an alliance between them and Lei and Yao clan.

clans.title: Yao Clan
clans.introText: Yao Clan is one of the Eight Ancient Clans, specialized in alchemy unlike other clans that focus purely on combat power.
clans.appearance:
The Yao clan could be considered a unique ancient clan. Most of its clan members were alchemists, and all of them possessed outstanding pill refinement talent. Thus, the Yao clan created a pill refinement atmosphere. If the ancient clans appear more often in the Central Plains, the reputation of the Pill Tower would end up suffering because of the Yao clan.

After all, if one were to make a true comparison, the inheritance of the Yao clan was more complete. Regardless of how one looked at it, the semi-public nature Pill Tower lacked far behind the Yao clan.

However, the rules of the Yao clan were extremely severe. Only their own clan members could learn their alchemist skills. Any outsider who learned them would end up attracting their murderous intent. This rule had also limited the development of the Yao clan, but this was something that could not be helped. The ancient clans felt arrogant when it came to ordinary people.

The Yao clan specialized in alchemy, possessing the largest alchemist organization in the world. Although the Yao clan would feel some pride in their hearts when dealing with the alchemists from the Central Plains, it must be said that they did indeed have the ability to back up this pride.

Perhaps it was due to their bloodline, but it was extremely easy for those in the Yao clan to learn how to refine medicinal pills. Moreover, the clan did not lack individuals with outstanding training talent. Hence, it might be true that the Yao clan did not have a large number of alchemists with skills equivalent to those alchemist grandmasters quite famous in the Central Plains, but it was not hard to find outstanding individuals within their clan either. Since they were in possession of such capital, they would inevitably feel pride when compared to other alchemists.

Of course, this was merely describing the middle level among the alchemist tier. The Yao clan did not hold much of an advantage in terms of the true alchemists that stood at the top of all alchemists. After all, their bloodline strength might allow them to have an easy time learning alchemist skills, but it was impossible to rely on to reach the peak of the alchemist world. At times, such talent might even become an obstruction to reaching the peak level. This could perhaps be considered a slight disadvantage of the bloodline strength.
clans.trivia:
Yao Chen was a member of the Yao Clan. However, he belonged to the type abandoned by the clan because the Dou Di Bloodline flowing within his body is so thin that it is insignificant and eventually expelled due to the failure of a mission he was performing.

A monument of merit and achievements belonging to the Yao Clan. Only those who have attained great accomplishments within the clan are permitted to freely leave their names upon it. Every member of the Yao Clan regards this as their lifelong ultimate goal. (Donghua)

This Clan was Destroyed by Hun Clan, But has a hope of revival due to Xiao Yan's intervention and helping the Younger Generation escape with Yao Chen. Since Xiao Yan gave Yao Chen Origin Qi, once he advances to a  Dou Di the clan will return to its former glory.

clans.title: Ye Clan
clans.introText: This Ye clan was one of the other three large clans in the north-eastern region. Although its strength was slightly weaker than the flourishing Mo clan, after many years of accumulation, the Ye clan’s strength could not be underestimated.

clans.title: Ye Clan (Pill Tower)
clans.introText: Being able to enter the Elders seat of the Pill Tower is not something that an ordinary faction could achieve. The Pill Region is filled with all sorts of people. Many powerful factions on the continent possess a branch at that place. However, on the whole, there are five large clans related to the Pill Tower. The Ye clan is one of them. However, the current Ye clan is already declining. It has ended up as the weakest of the five large clans. Two years ago, they even lost an Elder’s seat in the Pill Tower. If this continues, it is likely that they will remain the weakest of the five large clans and will sooner or later be replaced by other factions.
